from __future__ import annotations

import logging
import math
import uuid
from datetime import datetime
from typing import List, Optional, Union

from fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, HTTPException, Query, status
from pydantic import BaseModel, ConfigDict, Field
from sqlalchemy import func, select, or_
from sqlalchemy.ext.asyncio import AsyncSession
from sqlalchemy.orm import selectinload

from backend.src.api.dependencies.rbac import UserContext, get_current_user
from backend.src.core.database import get_db_session
from backend.src.models.identity import Group, GroupRole, Role, User, UserGroup
from backend.src.models.rbac import (
    EntityType,
    PermissionAction,
    PermissionEffect,
    PermissionRule,
    ResourceType,
)
from backend.src.services.audit.audit_service import record_audit_event

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)

router = APIRouter(prefix="/groups", tags=["Groups"])


class GroupCreateRequest(BaseModel):
    name: str = Field(..., min_length=2, max_length=100)
    description: Optional[str] = None
    is_active: bool = True
    role_ids: List[uuid.UUID] = Field(default_factory=list)
    user_ids: List[uuid.UUID] = Field(default_factory=list)


class GroupUpdateRequest(BaseModel):
    name: Optional[str] = Field(None, min_length=2, max_length=100)
    description: Optional[str] = None
    is_active: Optional[bool] = None


class GroupRoleUpdateRequest(BaseModel):
    role_ids: List[uuid.UUID]


class GroupMembersUpdateRequest(BaseModel):
    user_ids: List[uuid.UUID]


class GroupMemberItem(BaseModel):
    id: uuid.UUID
    username: str
    full_name: str
    email: str
    status: str
    assigned_at: Optional[datetime] = None

    model_config = ConfigDict(from_attributes=True)


class GroupResponse(BaseModel):
    id: uuid.UUID
    name: str
    description: Optional[str] = None
    is_active: bool
    user_count: int = 0
    role_count: int = 0
    roles: List[str] = Field(default_factory=list)
    role_ids: List[uuid.UUID] = Field(default_factory=list)
    created_at: datetime
    updated_at: datetime

    model_config = ConfigDict(from_attributes=True)

    total: int
    page: int
    page_size: int
    total_pages: int

@router.get(
    "",
    response_model=Union[PaginatedGroupResponse, List[GroupResponse]],
    summary="List groups (supports pagination and search)",
)
async def list_groups(
    page: Optional[int] = Query(None, ge=1, description="Page number (1-based)"),
    page_size: int = Query(10, ge=1, le=100, description="Items per page"),
    search: Optional[str] = Query(None, description="Search by name or description"),
    is_active: Optional[bool] = Query(None, description="Filter by active status"),
    user_ctx: UserContext = Depends(get_current_user),
    db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db_session),
) -> Union[PaginatedGroupResponse, List[GroupResponse]]:
    stmt = (
        select(Group)
        .options(
            selectinload(Group.roles).selectinload(GroupRole.role),
            selectinload(Group.users),
        )
        .order_by(Group.name.asc())
    )

    if search:
        s = f"%{search.strip()}%"
        stmt = stmt.where(or_(Group.name.ilike(s), Group.description.ilike(s)))
    if is_active is not None:
        stmt = stmt.where(Group.is_active == is_active)

    if page is not None:
        # Count total
        count_stmt = select(func.count(Group.id))
        if search:
            s = f"%{search.strip()}%"
            count_stmt = count_stmt.where(or_(Group.name.ilike(s), Group.description.ilike(s)))
        if is_active is not None:
            count_stmt = count_stmt.where(Group.is_active == is_active)
        total = (await db.execute(count_stmt)).scalar() or 0

        stmt = stmt.offset((page - 1) * page_size).limit(page_size)
        res = await db.execute(stmt)
        groups = res.scalars().all()

        items = []
        for g in groups:
            r_names = [gr.role.name for gr in g.roles if gr.role]
            r_ids = [gr.role_id for gr in g.roles]
            items.append(
                GroupResponse(
                    id=g.id,
                    name=g.name,
                    description=g.description,
                    is_active=g.is_active,
                    user_count=len(g.users),
                    role_count=len(r_ids),
                    roles=r_names,
                    role_ids=r_ids,
                    created_at=g.created_at,
                    updated_at=g.updated_at,
                )
            )

        total_pages = math.ceil(total / page_size) if total > 0 else 1
        return PaginatedGroupResponse(
            items=items,
            total=total,
            page=page,
            page_size=page_size,
            total_pages=total_pages,
        )

    # Return list if page not requested
    res = await db.execute(stmt)
    groups = res.scalars().all()
    results = []
    for g in groups:
        r_names = [gr.role.name for gr in g.roles if gr.role]
        r_ids = [gr.role_id for gr in g.roles]
        results.append(
            GroupResponse(
                id=g.id,
                name=g.name,
                description=g.description,
                is_active=g.is_active,
                user_count=len(g.users),
                role_count=len(r_ids),
                roles=r_names,
                role_ids=r_ids,
                created_at=g.created_at,
                updated_at=g.updated_at,
            )
        )
    return results


@router.post(
    "",
    response_model=GroupResponse,
    status_code=status.HTTP_201_CREATED,
    summary="Create a new user group",
)
async def create_group(
    payload: GroupCreateRequest,
    user_ctx: UserContext = Depends(get_current_user),
    db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db_session),
) -> GroupResponse:
    if not user_ctx.is_superadmin:
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=status.HTTP_403_FORBIDDEN,
            detail="Only SuperAdmin can create groups",
        )

    # Check unique name
    existing = (await db.execute(select(Group).where(Group.name == payload.name))).scalar_one_or_none()
    if existing:
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=status.HTTP_409_CONFLICT,
            detail=f"Group with name '{payload.name}' already exists",
        )

    new_group = Group(
        id=uuid.uuid4(),
        name=payload.name,
        description=payload.description,
        is_active=payload.is_active,
    )
    db.add(new_group)
    await db.flush()

    # Assign roles
    assigned_roles = []
    for rid in payload.role_ids:
        role = await db.get(Role, rid)
        if role:
            gr = GroupRole(group_id=new_group.id, role_id=role.id, assigned_by=user_ctx.user_id)
            db.add(gr)
            assigned_roles.append(role.name)

    # Assign users
    user_count = 0
    for uid in payload.user_ids:
        u = await db.get(User, uid)
        if u:
            ug = UserGroup(group_id=new_group.id, user_id=u.id, assigned_by=user_ctx.user_id)
            db.add(ug)
            user_count += 1

    await record_audit_event(
        session=db,
        actor_username=user_ctx.user.username,
        actor_id=user_ctx.user_id,
        action="CREATE_GROUP",
        entity_type=EntityType.DATABASE,
        entity_id=new_group.id,
        diff_jsonb={
            "name": new_group.name,
            "roles": assigned_roles,
            "user_count": user_count,
        },
        flush=True,
    )
    await db.flush()

    return GroupResponse(
        id=new_group.id,
        name=new_group.name,
        description=new_group.description,
        is_active=new_group.is_active,
        user_count=user_count,
        role_count=len(assigned_roles),
        roles=assigned_roles,
        role_ids=payload.role_ids,
        created_at=new_group.created_at,
        updated_at=new_group.updated_at,
    )


@router.get(

async def get_group(

@router.put(
    "/{group_id}",
    response_model=GroupResponse,
    summary="Update group details",
)
async def update_group(
    group_id: uuid.UUID,
    payload: GroupUpdateRequest,
    user_ctx: UserContext = Depends(get_current_user),
    db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db_session),
) -> GroupResponse:
    if not user_ctx.is_superadmin:
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=status.HTTP_403_FORBIDDEN,
            detail="Only SuperAdmin can update groups",
        )

    g = await db.get(Group, group_id)
    if not g:
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=status.HTTP_404_NOT_FOUND,
            detail="Group not found",
        )

    diff = {}
    if payload.name is not None and payload.name != g.name:
        existing = (await db.execute(select(Group).where(Group.name == payload.name, Group.id != group_id))).scalar_one_or_none()
        if existing:
            raise HTTPException(
                status_code=status.HTTP_409_CONFLICT,
                detail=f"Group with name '{payload.name}' already exists",
            )
        diff["old_name"] = g.name
        diff["new_name"] = payload.name
        g.name = payload.name

    if payload.description is not None:
        diff["description"] = payload.description
        g.description = payload.description

    if payload.is_active is not None:
        diff["is_active"] = payload.is_active
        g.is_active = payload.is_active

    await record_audit_event(
        session=db,
        actor_username=user_ctx.user.username,
        actor_id=user_ctx.user_id,
        action="UPDATE_GROUP",
        entity_type=EntityType.DATABASE,
        entity_id=g.id,
        diff_jsonb=diff,
        flush=True,
    )
    await db.flush()

    return await get_group(group_id=group_id, user_ctx=user_ctx, db=db)


@router.delete(
    "/{group_id}",
    status_code=status.HTTP_204_NO_CONTENT,
    summary="Delete group",
)
async def delete_group(
    group_id: uuid.UUID,
    user_ctx: UserContext = Depends(get_current_user),
    db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db_session),
) -> None:
    if not user_ctx.is_superadmin:
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=status.HTTP_403_FORBIDDEN,
            detail="Only SuperAdmin can delete groups",
        )

    g = await db.get(Group, group_id)
    if not g:
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=status.HTTP_404_NOT_FOUND,
            detail="Group not found",
        )

    await record_audit_event(
        session=db,
        actor_username=user_ctx.user.username,
        actor_id=user_ctx.user_id,
        action="DELETE_GROUP",
        entity_type=EntityType.DATABASE,
        entity_id=g.id,
        diff_jsonb={"deleted_group": g.name},
        flush=True,
    )
    await db.delete(g)
    await db.flush()


@router.get(
    "/{group_id}/members",
    response_model=List[GroupMemberItem],
    summary="List members of a group",
)
async def get_group_members(
    group_id: uuid.UUID,
    user_ctx: UserContext = Depends(get_current_user),
    db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db_session),
) -> List[GroupMemberItem]:
    g = await db.get(Group, group_id)
    if not g:
        raise HTTPException(

            detail="Group not found",
        )

    stmt = (
        select(User, UserGroup.assigned_at)
        .join(UserGroup, UserGroup.user_id == User.id)
        .where(UserGroup.group_id == group_id)

    return [

            username=u.username,
            full_name=u.full_name,
            email=u.email,
            status=u.status.value,

        )
        for u, assigned_at in rows
    ]


@router.put(
    "/{group_id}/members",
    response_model=List[GroupMemberItem],
    summary="Bulk update group members",
)
async def update_group_members(
    group_id: uuid.UUID,
    payload: GroupMembersUpdateRequest,
    user_ctx: UserContext = Depends(get_current_user),
    db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db_session),
) -> List[GroupMemberItem]:
    if not user_ctx.is_superadmin:
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=status.HTTP_403_FORBIDDEN,
            detail="Only SuperAdmin can manage group members",
        )

    g = await db.get(Group, group_id)
    if not g:
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=status.HTTP_404_NOT_FOUND,
            detail="Group not found",
        )

    # Delete existing memberships
    del_stmt = select(UserGroup).where(UserGroup.group_id == group_id)
    existing_members = (await db.execute(del_stmt)).scalars().all()
    for em in existing_members:
        await db.delete(em)
    await db.flush()

    # Add new memberships
    for uid in payload.user_ids:
        u = await db.get(User, uid)
        if u:
            ug = UserGroup(group_id=group_id, user_id=uid, assigned_by=user_ctx.user_id)
            db.add(ug)

    await record_audit_event(
        session=db,
        actor_username=user_ctx.user.username,
        actor_id=user_ctx.user_id,
        action="UPDATE_GROUP_MEMBERS",
        entity_type=EntityType.DATABASE,
        entity_id=group_id,
        diff_jsonb={"group_name": g.name, "member_count": len(payload.user_ids)},
        flush=True,
    )
    await db.flush()

    return await get_group_members(group_id=group_id, user_ctx=user_ctx, db=db)

        )

        session=db,

        actor_id=user_ctx.user_id,
        action="UPDATE_GROUP_ROLES",
        entity_type=EntityType.DATABASE,
        entity_id=group_id,
        diff_jsonb={"group_name": g.name, "roles": assigned_role_names},
        flush=True,
    )
    await db.flush()

    return await get_group_roles(group_id=group_id, user_ctx=user_ctx, db=db)

@router.post(
    "/{group_id}/permissions/bulk",
    response_model=List[dict],
    summary="Bulk update direct permissions for group",
)
async def bulk_update_group_permissions(
    group_id: uuid.UUID,
    payload: BulkGroupPermissionsRequest,
    user_ctx: UserContext = Depends(get_current_user),
    db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db_session),
) -> List[dict]:
    if not user_ctx.is_superadmin:
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=status.HTTP_403_FORBIDDEN,
            detail="Only SuperAdmin can manage group permissions",
        )

    g = await db.get(Group, group_id)
    if not g:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=status.HTTP_404_NOT_FOUND, detail="Group not found")

    # Clear existing direct resource permissions for this group
    del_stmt = select(PermissionRule).where(
        PermissionRule.group_id == group_id,
        PermissionRule.resource_type.in_([ResourceType.DATABASE, ResourceType.SCHEMA, ResourceType.TABLE]),
    )
    old_rules = (await db.execute(del_stmt)).scalars().all()
    for rule in old_rules:
        await db.delete(rule)
    await db.flush()

    created_rules = []
    for item in payload.permissions:
        rule = PermissionRule(
            id=uuid.uuid4(),
            group_id=group_id,
            resource_type=item.resource_type,
            resource_id=item.resource_id,
            action=item.action,
            effect=item.effect,
        )
        db.add(rule)
        created_rules.append(rule)

    await record_audit_event(
        session=db,
        actor_username=user_ctx.user.username,
        actor_id=user_ctx.user_id,
        action="UPDATE_GROUP_PERMISSIONS",
        entity_type=EntityType.DATABASE,
        entity_id=group_id,
        diff_jsonb={"group_name": g.name, "rules_count": len(payload.permissions)},
        flush=True,
    )
    await db.flush()

    return await get_group_permissions(group_id=group_id, user_ctx=user_ctx, db=db)

from __future__ import annotations

import logging

from fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, HTTPException, status
from sqlalchemy.ext.asyncio import AsyncSession

from backend.src.api.dependencies.rbac import UserContext, get_current_user
from backend.src.core.database import get_db_session

    BulkIngestionResponse,
)

    bulk_ingestion_service,
)

@router.post(
    "/bulk",
    response_model=BulkIngestionResponse,
    status_code=status.HTTP_200_OK,
    summary="Bulk metadata ingestion with batch upsert and automatic versioning",
)
async def bulk_ingest_metadata(
    payload: BulkIngestionRequest,
    user_ctx: UserContext = Depends(get_current_user),
    db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db_session),
) -> BulkIngestionResponse:
    """
    Ingests metadata batches for tables and columns using PostgreSQL batch upsert.
    Preserves human-curated approved descriptions, soft-deletes missing entities,
    and automatically triggers TableVersion snapshots and SchemaChangeLog entries.
    """
    try:
        response = await bulk_ingestion_service.ingest_bulk_metadata(
            session=db,
            payload=payload,
            actor_id=user_ctx.user.id,
            actor_username=user_ctx.user.username,
        )
        return response
    except ValueError as exc:
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=status.HTTP_404_NOT_FOUND,
            detail=str(exc),
        ) from exc

from __future__ import annotations

import logging
import uuid
from datetime import datetime
from typing import List, Optional

from fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, HTTPException, Query, Response, status
from pydantic import BaseModel, ConfigDict, Field
from sqlalchemy import select
from sqlalchemy.ext.asyncio import AsyncSession

from backend.src.api.dependencies.rbac import UserContext, get_current_user
from backend.src.core.database import get_db_session
from backend.src.models.identity import Group, Role, User
from backend.src.models.rbac import (
    EntityType,
    PermissionAction,
    PermissionEffect,
    PermissionRule,
    ResourceType,
)
from backend.src.services.audit.audit_service import record_audit_event
from backend.src.services.rbac.category_service import CategoryService

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)

router = APIRouter(prefix="/permissions", tags=["Permissions"])


class PermissionRuleCreateRequest(BaseModel):
    role_id: Optional[uuid.UUID] = None
    user_id: Optional[uuid.UUID] = None
    group_id: Optional[uuid.UUID] = None
    resource_type: ResourceType
    resource_id: Optional[uuid.UUID] = None
    action: PermissionAction
    effect: PermissionEffect = PermissionEffect.ALLOW


class PermissionRuleResponse(BaseModel):
    id: uuid.UUID
    role_id: Optional[uuid.UUID] = None
    user_id: Optional[uuid.UUID] = None
    group_id: Optional[uuid.UUID] = None
    resource_type: ResourceType
    resource_id: Optional[uuid.UUID] = None
    action: PermissionAction
    effect: PermissionEffect
    created_at: datetime

    model_config = ConfigDict(from_attributes=True)


class EffectivePermissionCheckResponse(BaseModel):
    entity_type: EntityType
    entity_id: uuid.UUID
    action: PermissionAction
    effect: PermissionEffect


@router.post(
    "",
    response_model=PermissionRuleResponse,
    status_code=status.HTTP_201_CREATED,
    summary="Grant a permission rule to a role, user, or group",
)
async def grant_permission_rule(
    payload: PermissionRuleCreateRequest,
    user_ctx: UserContext = Depends(get_current_user),
    db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db_session),
) -> PermissionRuleResponse:
    """
    Grants a fine-grained permission rule (ALLOW or DENY) to a role, user, or group across
    Global, Database, Schema, Table, Column, or Category resources.
    Atomically records an immutable AuditLog event in the current transaction.
    """
    if not payload.role_id and not payload.user_id and not payload.group_id:
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=status.HTTP_400_BAD_REQUEST,
            detail="At least one of role_id, user_id, or group_id must be provided.",
        )

    # Verify target existence
    if payload.role_id:
        role = await db.get(Role, payload.role_id)
        if not role:
            raise HTTPException(
                status_code=status.HTTP_404_NOT_FOUND,
                detail=f"Role '{payload.role_id}' not found.",
            )
    if payload.user_id:
        user = await db.get(User, payload.user_id)
        if not user:
            raise HTTPException(
                status_code=status.HTTP_404_NOT_FOUND,
                detail=f"User '{payload.user_id}' not found.",
            )
    if payload.group_id:
        group = await db.get(Group, payload.group_id)
        if not group:
            raise HTTPException(
                status_code=status.HTTP_404_NOT_FOUND,
                detail=f"Group '{payload.group_id}' not found.",
            )

    rule = PermissionRule(
        id=uuid.uuid4(),
        role_id=payload.role_id,
        user_id=payload.user_id,
        group_id=payload.group_id,
        resource_type=payload.resource_type,
        resource_id=payload.resource_id,
        action=payload.action,
        effect=payload.effect,
    )
    db.add(rule)
    await db.flush()

    # Determine audit entity_type and entity_id
    if payload.resource_type in (
        ResourceType.DATABASE,
        ResourceType.SCHEMA,
        ResourceType.TABLE,
        ResourceType.COLUMN,
    ):
        audit_entity_type = EntityType(payload.resource_type.value)
    else:
        audit_entity_type = EntityType.DATABASE

    audit_entity_id = (
        payload.resource_id
        if payload.resource_id is not None
        else (payload.role_id or payload.user_id or payload.group_id)
    )

    # Atomically record audit log
    await record_audit_event(
        session=db,
        actor_username=user_ctx.user.username,
        actor_id=user_ctx.user_id,
        action="GRANT_PERMISSION",
        entity_type=audit_entity_type,
        entity_id=audit_entity_id,
        diff_jsonb={
            "rule_id": str(rule.id),
            "role_id": str(rule.role_id) if rule.role_id else None,
            "user_id": str(rule.user_id) if rule.user_id else None,
            "group_id": str(rule.group_id) if rule.group_id else None,
            "resource_type": rule.resource_type.value,
            "resource_id": str(rule.resource_id) if rule.resource_id else None,
            "action": rule.action.value,
            "effect": rule.effect.value,
        },
        flush=True,
    )

    return PermissionRuleResponse.model_validate(rule)


@router.get(
    "",
    response_model=List[PermissionRuleResponse],
    summary="List and filter permission rules",
)
async def list_permissions(
    role_id: Optional[uuid.UUID] = Query(None, description="Filter by assigned role ID"),
    user_id: Optional[uuid.UUID] = Query(None, description="Filter by assigned user ID"),
    group_id: Optional[uuid.UUID] = Query(None, description="Filter by assigned group ID"),
    resource_type: Optional[ResourceType] = Query(None, description="Filter by resource type"),
    resource_id: Optional[uuid.UUID] = Query(None, description="Filter by resource ID"),
    action: Optional[PermissionAction] = Query(None, description="Filter by permission action"),
    effect: Optional[PermissionEffect] = Query(None, description="Filter by permission effect"),
    user_ctx: UserContext = Depends(get_current_user),
    db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db_session),
) -> List[PermissionRuleResponse]:
    """
    Retrieves and filters active permission rules.
    """
    stmt = select(PermissionRule)

    if role_id is not None:
        stmt = stmt.where(PermissionRule.role_id == role_id)
    if user_id is not None:
        stmt = stmt.where(PermissionRule.user_id == user_id)
    if group_id is not None:
        stmt = stmt.where(PermissionRule.group_id == group_id)
    if resource_type is not None:
        stmt = stmt.where(PermissionRule.resource_type == resource_type)
    if resource_id is not None:
        stmt = stmt.where(PermissionRule.resource_id == resource_id)
    if action is not None:
        stmt = stmt.where(PermissionRule.action == action)
    if effect is not None:
        stmt = stmt.where(PermissionRule.effect == effect)

    stmt = stmt.order_by(PermissionRule.created_at.desc())
    result = await db.execute(stmt)
    rules = result.scalars().all()
    return [PermissionRuleResponse.model_validate(r) for r in rules]

    summary="Revoke a permission rule",
)
async def revoke_permission_rule(
    rule_id: uuid.UUID,
    user_ctx: UserContext = Depends(get_current_user),
    db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db_session),
) -> Response:
    """
    Revokes a permission rule by UUID.
    Atomically records an immutable AuditLog event in the current transaction.
    """
    rule = await db.get(PermissionRule, rule_id)
    if not rule:
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=status.HTTP_404_NOT_FOUND,
            detail=f"Permission rule '{rule_id}' not found.",
        )

    if rule.resource_type in (
        ResourceType.DATABASE,
        ResourceType.SCHEMA,
        ResourceType.TABLE,
        ResourceType.COLUMN,
    ):
        audit_entity_type = EntityType(rule.resource_type.value)
    else:
        audit_entity_type = EntityType.DATABASE

    audit_entity_id = (
        rule.resource_id
        if rule.resource_id is not None
        else (rule.role_id or rule.user_id or rule.group_id)
    )

    # Atomically record audit log
    await record_audit_event(
        session=db,
        actor_username=user_ctx.user.username,
        actor_id=user_ctx.user_id,
        action="REVOKE_PERMISSION",
        entity_type=audit_entity_type,
        entity_id=audit_entity_id,
        diff_jsonb={
            "revoked_rule_id": str(rule.id),
            "role_id": str(rule.role_id) if rule.role_id else None,
            "user_id": str(rule.user_id) if rule.user_id else None,
            "group_id": str(rule.group_id) if rule.group_id else None,
            "resource_type": rule.resource_type.value,
            "resource_id": str(rule.resource_id) if rule.resource_id else None,
            "action": rule.action.value,
            "effect": rule.effect.value,
        },
        flush=True,
    )

    await db.delete(rule)
    await db.flush()

    return Response(status_code=status.HTTP_204_NO_CONTENT)


@router.get(
    "/check",
    response_model=EffectivePermissionCheckResponse,
    summary="Evaluate effective permission for an entity",
)
async def check_effective_permission(
    entity_type: EntityType = Query(..., description="Target entity type (DATABASE, SCHEMA, TABLE, COLUMN)"),
    entity_id: uuid.UUID = Query(..., description="Target entity UUID"),
    action: PermissionAction = Query(PermissionAction.VIEW_METADATA, description="Action to evaluate"),
    user_ctx: UserContext = Depends(get_current_user),
    db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db_session),
) -> EffectivePermissionCheckResponse:
    """
    Evaluates effective permissions for the authenticated user on a target resource,
    incorporating dual-dimension inheritance and DENY precedence.
    """
    effect = await CategoryService.resolve_effective_permission(
        session=db,
        user_ctx=user_ctx,
        entity_type=entity_type,
        entity_id=entity_id,
        action=action,
    )

    return EffectivePermissionCheckResponse(
        entity_type=entity_type,
        entity_id=entity_id,
        action=action,
        effect=effect,
    )

)

    CatalogColumn,
    CatalogTable,
    DatabaseSchema,
    LifecycleStatus,
)

    PermissionAction,
    PermissionEffect,
    PermissionRule,
)

    ClassificationReport,
    CompletenessReport,
    ReportRefreshResponse,
)

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)

router = APIRouter(prefix="/reports", tags=["Executive Reporting"])


async def require_reports_permission(
    user_ctx: UserContext = Depends(get_current_user),
    db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db_session),
) -> UserContext:
    """
    Enforces that the user has EXPORT_REPORTS permission or superadmin role.
    Explicit DENY overrides ALLOW.
    """
    if user_ctx.is_superadmin:
        return user_ctx

    perm_stmt = select(PermissionRule.effect).where(
        user_rule_matches(user_ctx),
        PermissionRule.action == PermissionAction.EXPORT_REPORTS,
    )
    res = await db.execute(perm_stmt)
    effects = set(res.scalars().all())
    if PermissionEffect.DENY in effects or PermissionEffect.DENY.value in effects:
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=status.HTTP_403_FORBIDDEN,
            detail="Forbidden: User explicitly denied reporting access.",
        )
    if PermissionEffect.ALLOW not in effects and PermissionEffect.ALLOW.value not in effects:
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=status.HTTP_403_FORBIDDEN,
            detail="Forbidden: User lacks EXPORT_REPORTS permission.",
        )

    return user_ctx


@router.get(
    "/completeness",
    response_model=CompletenessReport,
    summary="Fast metadata completeness report with optional connection filtering",
)
async def get_completeness_report(
    connection_ids: Optional[List[uuid.UUID]] = Query(None, description="Filter by database connection IDs"),
    exclude_low_row_tables: bool = Query(False, description="Exclude low-row/empty tables (< 10 rows)"),
    user_ctx: UserContext = Depends(require_reports_permission),
    db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db_session),
) -> CompletenessReport:
    """
    Returns aggregated metadata completeness metrics across all registered databases or filtered ones.
    """
    return await report_service.get_metadata_completeness(
        db,
        connection_ids=connection_ids,
        exclude_low_row_tables=exclude_low_row_tables,
    )


@router.get(
    "/classification-distribution",
    response_model=ClassificationReport,
    summary="Classification & PII breakdown metrics across all connected databases",
)
@router.get(
    "/classification",
    response_model=ClassificationReport,
    include_in_schema=False,
)
async def get_classification_distribution_report(
    connection_ids: Optional[List[uuid.UUID]] = Query(None, description="Filter by database connection IDs"),
    exclude_low_row_tables: bool = Query(False, description="Exclude low-row/empty tables (< 10 rows)"),
    user_ctx: UserContext = Depends(require_reports_permission),
    db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db_session),
) -> ClassificationReport:
    """
    Returns security classification and PII distribution metrics across all catalog columns or filtered ones.
    """
    return await report_service.get_classification_distribution(
        db,
        connection_ids=connection_ids,
        exclude_low_row_tables=exclude_low_row_tables,
    )


@router.post(
    "/refresh",
    response_model=ReportRefreshResponse,
    summary="Trigger non-blocking concurrent refresh of all reporting materialized views",
)
async def refresh_reporting_views(
    user_ctx: UserContext = Depends(require_reports_permission),
) -> ReportRefreshResponse:
    """
    Triggers REFRESH MATERIALIZED VIEW CONCURRENTLY for mv_metadata_completeness and
    mv_classification_distribution, ensuring zero read disruption for active dashboard users.
    """
    refreshed = await report_service.refresh_all_materialized_views_concurrently()
    return ReportRefreshResponse(
        status="SUCCESS",
        message="Materialized views refreshed concurrently.",
        refreshed_views=list(refreshed.keys()),
    )


@router.get(
    "/export",
    summary="Export enterprise data dictionary and executive reporting summary to XLSX, CSV, or JSON",
)
async def export_reports(
    format: str = Query("json", pattern="^(json|csv|xlsx)$"),
    connection_ids: Optional[List[uuid.UUID]] = Query(None, description="Filter by database connection IDs"),
    exclude_low_row_tables: bool = Query(False, description="Exclude low-row/empty tables (< 10 rows)"),
    user_ctx: UserContext = Depends(require_reports_permission),
    db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db_session),
):
    """
    Exports executive reporting summary and enterprise data dictionary in XLSX, CSV (UTF-8 BOM), or JSON.
    Guarded by EXPORT_REPORTS permission.
    """
    completeness = await report_service.get_metadata_completeness(
        db,
        connection_ids=connection_ids,
        exclude_low_row_tables=exclude_low_row_tables,
    )
    classification = await report_service.get_classification_distribution(
        db,
        connection_ids=connection_ids,
        exclude_low_row_tables=exclude_low_row_tables,
    )

    # 1. Fetch Data Dictionary Tables
    table_stmt = (
        select(
            DatabaseConnection.database_name,
            DatabaseSchema.name.label("schema_name"),
            CatalogTable.name.label("table_name"),
            CatalogTable.table_type,
            CatalogTable.row_count_estimate,
            CatalogTable.size_bytes,
            CatalogTable.owner,
            CatalogTable.source_description,
            CatalogTable.approved_description,
            CatalogTable.description_source,
        )
        .join(DatabaseSchema, DatabaseSchema.id == CatalogTable.schema_id)
        .join(DatabaseConnection, DatabaseConnection.id == DatabaseSchema.connection_id)
        .where(CatalogTable.status != LifecycleStatus.DELETED)
    )
    if connection_ids:
        table_stmt = table_stmt.where(DatabaseConnection.id.in_(connection_ids))
    if exclude_low_row_tables:
        table_stmt = table_stmt.where(func.coalesce(CatalogTable.row_count_estimate, 0) >= 10)
    table_stmt = table_stmt.order_by(
        DatabaseConnection.database_name.asc(),
        DatabaseSchema.name.asc(),
        CatalogTable.name.asc(),
    )
    table_res = await db.execute(table_stmt)
    tables_data = table_res.all()

    # 2. Fetch Data Dictionary Columns
    col_stmt = (
        select(
            DatabaseConnection.database_name,
            DatabaseSchema.name.label("schema_name"),
            CatalogTable.name.label("table_name"),
            CatalogColumn.ordinal_position,
            CatalogColumn.name.label("column_name"),
            CatalogColumn.data_type,
            CatalogColumn.collation,
            CatalogColumn.is_primary_key,
            CatalogColumn.is_foreign_key,
            CatalogColumn.is_nullable,
            CatalogColumn.classification_level,
            CatalogColumn.source_description,
            CatalogColumn.approved_description,
            CatalogColumn.description_source,
        )
        .join(CatalogTable, CatalogTable.id == CatalogColumn.table_id)
        .join(DatabaseSchema, DatabaseSchema.id == CatalogTable.schema_id)
        .join(DatabaseConnection, DatabaseConnection.id == DatabaseSchema.connection_id)
        .where(
            CatalogColumn.status != LifecycleStatus.DELETED,
            CatalogTable.status != LifecycleStatus.DELETED,
        )
    )
    if connection_ids:
        col_stmt = col_stmt.where(DatabaseConnection.id.in_(connection_ids))
    if exclude_low_row_tables:
        col_stmt = col_stmt.where(func.coalesce(CatalogTable.row_count_estimate, 0) >= 10)
    col_stmt = col_stmt.order_by(
        DatabaseConnection.database_name.asc(),
        DatabaseSchema.name.asc(),
        CatalogTable.name.asc(),
        CatalogColumn.ordinal_position.asc(),
    )
    col_res = await db.execute(col_stmt)
    columns_data = col_res.all()

    # Format 1: XLSX (Multi-Sheet Styled RTL Excel Workbook)
    if format == "xlsx":
        wb = Workbook()

        header_font = Font(name="Tahoma", size=10, bold=True, color="FFFFFF")
        title_font = Font(name="Tahoma", size=13, bold=True, color="0F172A")
        section_font = Font(name="Tahoma", size=11, bold=True, color="1E293B")
        cell_font = Font(name="Tahoma", size=9)
        header_fill = PatternFill(start_color="1E293B", end_color="1E293B", fill_type="solid")
        subheader_fill = PatternFill(start_color="334155", end_color="334155", fill_type="solid")
        zebra_fill = PatternFill(start_color="F8FAFC", end_color="F8FAFC", fill_type="solid")

        thin_border = Border(
            left=Side(style="thin", color="CBD5E1"),
            right=Side(style="thin", color="CBD5E1"),
            top=Side(style="thin", color="CBD5E1"),
            bottom=Side(style="thin", color="CBD5E1"),
        )
        align_center = Alignment(horizontal="center", vertical="center")
        align_right = Alignment(horizontal="right", vertical="center")

        # --- Sheet 1: ط®ظ„ط§طµظ‡ ظ…ط¯غŒط±غŒطھغŒ ---
        ws1 = wb.active
        ws1.title = "ط®ظ„ط§طµظ‡ ظ…ط¯غŒط±غŒطھغŒ"
        ws1.sheet_view.rightToLeft = True

        ws1.cell(row=1, column=1, value="ع¯ط²ط§ط±ط´ ط®ظ„ط§طµظ‡ ط­ط§ع©ظ…غŒطھ ط¯ط§ط¯ظ‡ ظˆ ع©غŒظپغŒطھ ظ…طھط§ط¯غŒطھط§ ط³ط§ط²ظ…ط§ظ†غŒ").font = title_font

        # Overall Metrics
        ws1.cell(row=3, column=1, value="ط´ط§ط®طµ ع©ظ„غŒط¯غŒ ط­ط§ع©ظ…غŒطھ ط¯ط§ط¯ظ‡").font = header_font
        ws1.cell(row=3, column=1).fill = header_fill
        ws1.cell(row=3, column=1).alignment = align_center
        ws1.cell(row=3, column=2, value="ظ…ظ‚ط¯ط§ط±").font = header_font
        ws1.cell(row=3, column=2).fill = header_fill
        ws1.cell(row=3, column=2).alignment = align_center

        kpis = [
            ("ط¯ط±طµط¯ ع©ظ„غŒ ظ…ط³طھظ†ط¯ط³ط§ط²غŒ ظ…طھط§ط¯غŒطھط§", f"{completeness.overall_completeness_pct}%"),
            ("طھط¹ط¯ط§ط¯ ع©ظ„ ظ¾ط§غŒع¯ط§ظ‡â€Œظ‡ط§غŒ ط¯ط§ط¯ظ‡ طھط­طھ ظ¾ظˆط´ط´", completeness.total_databases),
            ("طھط¹ط¯ط§ط¯ ع©ظ„ ط¬ط¯ط§ظˆظ„ ط´ظ†ط§ط³ط§غŒغŒ ط´ط¯ظ‡", completeness.total_tables),
            ("طھط¹ط¯ط§ط¯ ع©ظ„ ط³طھظˆظ†â€Œظ‡ط§ ظˆ ظپغŒظ„ط¯ظ‡ط§", completeness.total_columns),
            ("طھط¹ط¯ط§ط¯ ط³طھظˆظ†â€Œظ‡ط§غŒ ط¯ط§ط±ط§غŒ ط·ط¨ظ‚ظ‡â€Œط¨ظ†ط¯غŒ ط§ظ…ظ†غŒطھغŒ", classification.total_classified_columns),
        ]
        curr_row = 4
        for label, val in kpis:
            c1 = ws1.cell(row=curr_row, column=1, value=label)
            c2 = ws1.cell(row=curr_row, column=2, value=val)

        db_headers = ["ظ†ط§ظ… ظ¾ط§غŒع¯ط§ظ‡ ط¯ط§ط¯ظ‡", "طھط¹ط¯ط§ط¯ ع©ظ„ ط¬ط¯ط§ظˆظ„", "ط¬ط¯ط§ظˆظ„ ط¯ط§ط±ط§غŒ ط´ط±ط­", "ط¬ط¯ط§ظˆظ„ ط¯ط§ط±ط§غŒ ظ…ط§ظ„ع©", "ط¯ط±طµط¯ طھع©ظ…غŒظ„ ظ…طھط§ط¯غŒطھط§"]

            cell.fill = subheader_fill
            cell.alignment = align_center
            cell.border = thin_border

        curr_row += 1
        for db_item in completeness.database_breakdown:
            ws1.cell(row=curr_row, column=1, value=db_item.database_name).alignment = align_right
            ws1.cell(row=curr_row, column=2, value=db_item.table_count).alignment = align_center
            ws1.cell(row=curr_row, column=3, value=db_item.tables_with_desc).alignment = align_center
            ws1.cell(row=curr_row, column=4, value=db_item.tables_with_owner).alignment = align_center
            ws1.cell(row=curr_row, column=5, value=f"{db_item.completeness_pct}%").alignment = align_center
            for col_idx in range(1, 6):
                c = ws1.cell(row=curr_row, column=col_idx)
                c.font = cell_font
                c.border = thin_border
            curr_row += 1

        # Classification Breakdown
        curr_row += 2
        ws1.cell(row=curr_row, column=1, value="طھظˆط²غŒط¹ ط³ط·ظˆط­ ظ…ط­ط±ظ…ط§ظ†ع¯غŒ ظˆ ط¯ط§ط¯ظ‡â€Œظ‡ط§غŒ ط­ط³ط§ط³ (PII / Confidential)").font = section_font
        curr_row += 1
        class_headers = ["ط³ط·ط­ ظ…ط­ط±ظ…ط§ظ†ع¯غŒ", "طھط¹ط¯ط§ط¯ ط³طھظˆظ†â€Œظ‡ط§", "طھط¹ط¯ط§ط¯ ط¬ط¯ط§ظˆظ„ ط¯ط±ع¯غŒط±"]
        for col_idx, h in enumerate(class_headers, start=1):
            cell = ws1.cell(row=curr_row, column=col_idx, value=h)
            cell.font = header_font
            cell.fill = subheader_fill
            cell.alignment = align_center
            cell.border = thin_border

        curr_row += 1
        for c_item in classification.breakdown:
            ws1.cell(row=curr_row, column=1, value=c_item.classification_level).alignment = align_center
            ws1.cell(row=curr_row, column=2, value=c_item.column_count).alignment = align_center
            ws1.cell(row=curr_row, column=3, value=c_item.affected_table_count).alignment = align_center
            for col_idx in range(1, 4):
                c = ws1.cell(row=curr_row, column=col_idx)
                c.font = cell_font
                c.border = thin_border
            curr_row += 1

        # --- Sheet 2: ظپط±ظ‡ظ†ع¯ ط¯ط§ط¯ظ‡ ط¬ط¯ط§ظˆظ„ ---
        ws2 = wb.create_sheet(title="ظپط±ظ‡ظ†ع¯ ط¯ط§ط¯ظ‡ ط¬ط¯ط§ظˆظ„")

        tbl_headers = [
            "ظ†ط§ظ… ظ¾ط§غŒع¯ط§ظ‡ ط¯ط§ط¯ظ‡",
            "ظ†ط§ظ… ط§ط³ع©غŒظ…ط§",
            "ظ†ط§ظ… ط¬ط¯ظˆظ„",
            "ظ†ظˆط¹ ط´غŒط،",
            "طھط¹ط¯ط§ط¯ ط±ع©ظˆط±ط¯ (طھط®ظ…غŒظ†غŒ)",
            "ط­ط¬ظ… (ظ…ع¯ط§ط¨ط§غŒطھ)",
            "ظ…ط§ظ„ع© ط³ط§ط²ظ…ط§ظ†غŒ",
            "طھظˆط¶غŒط­ط§طھ ظ…ط¨ط¯ط£ (Source)",
            "طھظˆط¶غŒط­ط§طھ ظ…طµظˆط¨ ط­ط§ع©ظ…غŒطھغŒ (Approved)",
            "ظ…ظ†ط¨ط¹ ط´ط±ط­ (Description Source)",

            cell = ws2.cell(row=1, column=col_idx, value=h)
            cell.font = header_font
            cell.fill = header_fill
            cell.alignment = align_center
            cell.border = thin_border

        for r_idx, t in enumerate(tables_data, start=2):

            ws2.cell(row=r_idx, column=8, value=t.source_description or "-").alignment = align_right
            ws2.cell(row=r_idx, column=9, value=t.approved_description or "-").alignment = align_right
            ws2.cell(row=r_idx, column=10, value=getattr(t, "description_source", "SOURCE_DB") or "SOURCE_DB").alignment = align_center

                c = ws2.cell(row=r_idx, column=c_idx)
                c.font = cell_font
                c.border = thin_border
                if r_idx % 2 == 0:
                    c.fill = zebra_fill

        # --- Sheet 3: ظپط±ظ‡ظ†ع¯ ط¯ط§ط¯ظ‡ ط³طھظˆظ†ظ‡ط§ ---
        ws3 = wb.create_sheet(title="ظپط±ظ‡ظ†ع¯ ط¯ط§ط¯ظ‡ ط³طھظˆظ†ظ‡ط§")
        ws3.sheet_view.rightToLeft = True

        col_headers = [
            "ظ†ط§ظ… ظ¾ط§غŒع¯ط§ظ‡ ط¯ط§ط¯ظ‡",
            "ظ†ط§ظ… ط§ط³ع©غŒظ…ط§",
            "ظ†ط§ظ… ط¬ط¯ظˆظ„",
            "طھط±طھغŒط¨ ظپغŒظ„ط¯",
            "ظ†ط§ظ… ط³طھظˆظ†",
            "ظ†ظˆط¹ ط¯ط§ط¯ظ‡",
            "Collation",
            "ظ†ظˆط¹ ع©ظ„غŒط¯",
            "ظ¾ط°غŒط±ط´ طھظ‡غŒ (Nullable)",
            "ط³ط·ط­ ظ…ط­ط±ظ…ط§ظ†ع¯غŒ",
            "طھظˆط¶غŒط­ط§طھ ظ…ط¨ط¯ط£ (Source)",
            "طھظˆط¶غŒط­ط§طھ ظ…طµظˆط¨ ط­ط§ع©ظ…غŒطھغŒ (Approved)",
            "ظ…ظ†ط¨ط¹ ط´ط±ط­ (Description Source)",
        ]
        for col_idx, h in enumerate(col_headers, start=1):
            cell = ws3.cell(row=1, column=col_idx, value=h)
            cell.font = header_font
            cell.fill = header_fill
            cell.alignment = align_center
            cell.border = thin_border

        for r_idx, c in enumerate(columns_data, start=2):
            clevel = c.classification_level.value if hasattr(c.classification_level, "value") else str(c.classification_level)
            key_type = "PK" if c.is_primary_key else ("FK" if c.is_foreign_key else "-")
            nullable_str = "ط¨ظ„ظ‡" if c.is_nullable else "ط®غŒط±"

            ws3.cell(row=r_idx, column=1, value=c.database_name).alignment = align_right
            ws3.cell(row=r_idx, column=2, value=c.schema_name).alignment = align_right
            ws3.cell(row=r_idx, column=3, value=c.table_name).alignment = align_right
            ws3.cell(row=r_idx, column=4, value=c.ordinal_position).alignment = align_center
            ws3.cell(row=r_idx, column=5, value=c.column_name).alignment = align_right
            ws3.cell(row=r_idx, column=6, value=c.data_type).alignment = align_center
            ws3.cell(row=r_idx, column=7, value=c.collation or "-").alignment = align_center
            ws3.cell(row=r_idx, column=8, value=key_type).alignment = align_center
            ws3.cell(row=r_idx, column=9, value=nullable_str).alignment = align_center
            ws3.cell(row=r_idx, column=10, value=clevel).alignment = align_center
            ws3.cell(row=r_idx, column=11, value=c.source_description or "-").alignment = align_right
            ws3.cell(row=r_idx, column=12, value=c.approved_description or "-").alignment = align_right
            ws3.cell(row=r_idx, column=13, value=getattr(c, "description_source", "SOURCE_DB") or "SOURCE_DB").alignment = align_center
            for c_idx in range(1, 14):
                cell_item = ws3.cell(row=r_idx, column=c_idx)
                cell_item.font = cell_font
                cell_item.border = thin_border
                if r_idx % 2 == 0:
                    cell_item.fill = zebra_fill

        # Auto-fit column widths across all sheets
        for sheet in (ws1, ws2, ws3):
            for col in sheet.columns:
                max_len = 0
                col_letter = get_column_letter(col[0].column)
                for cell in col:
                    val_str = str(cell.value or "")
                    if len(val_str) > max_len:
                        max_len = len(val_str)
                sheet.column_dimensions[col_letter].width = min(max(max_len + 4, 12), 50)

        out_stream = io.BytesIO()
        wb.save(out_stream)
        xlsx_bytes = out_stream.getvalue()

        return Response(
            content=xlsx_bytes,
            media_type="application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet",
            headers={"Content-Disposition": "attachment; filename=enterprise_data_dictionary.xlsx"},
        )

    # Format 2: CSV (UTF-8 with BOM for Excel compatibility)
    if format == "csv":
        output = io.StringIO()
        writer = csv.writer(output)

        writer.writerow(["=== ط®ظ„ط§طµظ‡ ظ…ط¯غŒط±غŒطھغŒ ط­ط§ع©ظ…غŒطھ ط¯ط§ط¯ظ‡ ==="])
        writer.writerow(["ط´ط§ط®طµ ط­ط§ع©ظ…غŒطھ ط¯ط§ط¯ظ‡", "ظ…ظ‚ط¯ط§ط±"])
        writer.writerow(["ط¯ط±طµط¯ ع©ظ„غŒ طھع©ظ…غŒظ„ ظ…طھط§ط¯غŒطھط§", f"{completeness.overall_completeness_pct}%"])
        writer.writerow(["طھط¹ط¯ط§ط¯ ع©ظ„ ظ¾ط§غŒع¯ط§ظ‡â€Œظ‡ط§غŒ ط¯ط§ط¯ظ‡", completeness.total_databases])
        writer.writerow(["طھط¹ط¯ط§ط¯ ع©ظ„ ط¬ط¯ط§ظˆظ„", completeness.total_tables])
        writer.writerow(["طھط¹ط¯ط§ط¯ ع©ظ„ ط³طھظˆظ†â€Œظ‡ط§", completeness.total_columns])
        writer.writerow(["طھط¹ط¯ط§ط¯ ط³طھظˆظ†â€Œظ‡ط§غŒ ط¯ط§ط±ط§غŒ ط·ط¨ظ‚ظ‡â€Œط¨ظ†ط¯غŒ", classification.total_classified_columns])
        writer.writerow([])

        writer.writerow(["=== ظˆط¶ط¹غŒطھ ظ…ط³طھظ†ط¯ط³ط§ط²غŒ ظ¾ط§غŒع¯ط§ظ‡â€Œظ‡ط§غŒ ط¯ط§ط¯ظ‡ ==="])

@router.get(
    "/preview",
    summary="Get executive reports data dictionary preview with source and approved descriptions",
)
async def get_report_preview(
    connection_ids: Optional[List[uuid.UUID]] = Query(None, description="Filter by database connection IDs"),
    limit: int = Query(100, ge=1, le=500),
    exclude_low_row_tables: bool = Query(False, description="Exclude low-row/empty tables (< 10 rows)"),
    user_ctx: UserContext = Depends(require_reports_permission),
    db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db_session),
):
    """
    Returns data dictionary preview items with both source and approved descriptions, and description source.
    """
    stmt = (
        select(
            DatabaseConnection.database_name,
            DatabaseSchema.name.label("schema_name"),
            CatalogTable.name.label("table_name"),
            CatalogTable.table_type,
            CatalogTable.row_count_estimate,
            CatalogTable.size_bytes,
            CatalogTable.owner,
            CatalogTable.source_description,
            CatalogTable.approved_description,
            CatalogTable.description_source,
        )
        .join(DatabaseSchema, DatabaseSchema.id == CatalogTable.schema_id)
        .join(DatabaseConnection, DatabaseConnection.id == DatabaseSchema.connection_id)
        .where(CatalogTable.status != LifecycleStatus.DELETED)
    )
    if connection_ids:
        stmt = stmt.where(DatabaseConnection.id.in_(connection_ids))
    if exclude_low_row_tables:
        stmt = stmt.where(func.coalesce(CatalogTable.row_count_estimate, 0) >= 10)
    stmt = stmt.order_by(
        DatabaseConnection.database_name.asc(),
        DatabaseSchema.name.asc(),
        CatalogTable.name.asc(),
    ).limit(limit)

    res = await db.execute(stmt)
    rows = res.all()

    return [
        {
            "database_name": r.database_name,
            "schema_name": r.schema_name,
            "table_name": r.table_name,
            "table_type": r.table_type.value if hasattr(r.table_type, "value") else str(r.table_type),
            "row_count_estimate": r.row_count_estimate,
            "size_bytes": r.size_bytes,
            "owner": r.owner,
            "source_description": r.source_description,
            "approved_description": r.approved_description,
            "description_source": r.description_source,
        }
        for r in rows
    ]

class RoleCreateRequest(BaseModel):
    name: str = Field(..., min_length=2, max_length=100)
    description: Optional[str] = None


class RoleUpdateRequest(BaseModel):
    name: str = Field(..., min_length=2, max_length=100)
    description: Optional[str] = None


class RoleResponse(BaseModel):
    id: uuid.UUID
    name: str
    description: Optional[str] = None
    is_system_role: bool
    user_count: int = 0
    created_at: datetime

    model_config = ConfigDict(from_attributes=True)


class PaginatedRoleResponse(BaseModel):
    items: List[RoleResponse]
    total: int
    page: int
    page_size: int
    total_pages: int


class RolePermissionRuleItem(BaseModel):
    resource_type: ResourceType
    resource_id: Optional[uuid.UUID] = None
    action: PermissionAction
    effect: PermissionEffect = PermissionEffect.ALLOW


class RolePermissionsUpdateRequest(BaseModel):
    permissions: List[RolePermissionRuleItem]


class RoleUserItem(BaseModel):
    id: uuid.UUID
    username: str
    full_name: str
    email: str
    assignment_type: str  # 'DIRECT' | 'VIA_GROUP'
    group_name: Optional[str] = None


async def require_manage_roles(
    user_ctx: UserContext = Depends(get_current_user),
    db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db_session),
) -> UserContext:
    if user_ctx.is_superadmin:
        return user_ctx
    deny_stmt = select(1).where(
        user_rule_matches(user_ctx),
        PermissionRule.action == PermissionAction.MANAGE_ROLES,
        PermissionRule.effect == PermissionEffect.DENY,
    )
    if (await db.execute(deny_stmt)).scalar_one_or_none() is not None:
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=status.HTTP_403_FORBIDDEN,
            detail="Forbidden: Access to manage roles is explicitly denied.",
        )
    allow_stmt = select(1).where(
        user_rule_matches(user_ctx),
        PermissionRule.action == PermissionAction.MANAGE_ROLES,
        PermissionRule.effect == PermissionEffect.ALLOW,
    )
    if (await db.execute(allow_stmt)).scalar_one_or_none() is None:
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=status.HTTP_403_FORBIDDEN,
            detail="Forbidden: User lacks MANAGE_ROLES permission.",
        )
    return user_ctx

@router.get(
    "",
    response_model=Union[PaginatedRoleResponse, List[RoleResponse]],
    summary="List all roles (supports pagination and search)",
)
async def list_roles(
    page: Optional[int] = Query(None, ge=1, description="Page number"),
    page_size: int = Query(10, ge=1, le=100, description="Items per page"),
    search: Optional[str] = Query(None, description="Search role by name or description"),
    user_ctx: UserContext = Depends(get_current_user),
    db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db_session),
) -> Union[PaginatedRoleResponse, List[RoleResponse]]:
    """Lists all roles with count of assigned users."""
    stmt = (
        select(Role, func.count(UserRole.user_id).label("user_count"))
        .outerjoin(UserRole, UserRole.role_id == Role.id)
        .group_by(Role.id)
        .order_by(Role.name.asc())
    )

    if search:
        s = f"%{search.strip()}%"
        stmt = stmt.where(or_(Role.name.ilike(s), Role.description.ilike(s)))

    if page is not None:
        count_stmt = select(func.count(Role.id))
        if search:
            s = f"%{search.strip()}%"
            count_stmt = count_stmt.where(or_(Role.name.ilike(s), Role.description.ilike(s)))
        total = (await db.execute(count_stmt)).scalar() or 0

        stmt = stmt.offset((page - 1) * page_size).limit(page_size)
        res = await db.execute(stmt)
        rows = res.all()

        items = [
            RoleResponse(
                id=role.id,
                name=role.name,
                description=role.description,
                is_system_role=role.is_system_role,
                user_count=ucount,
                created_at=role.created_at,
            )
            for role, ucount in rows
        ]
        total_pages = math.ceil(total / page_size) if total > 0 else 1
        return PaginatedRoleResponse(
            items=items,
            total=total,
            page=page,
            page_size=page_size,
            total_pages=total_pages,
        )

    res = await db.execute(stmt)
    rows = res.all()
    return [
        RoleResponse(
            id=role.id,
            name=role.name,
            description=role.description,
            is_system_role=role.is_system_role,
            user_count=ucount,
            created_at=role.created_at,
        )
        for role, ucount in rows
    ]


@router.post("", response_model=RoleResponse, status_code=status.HTTP_201_CREATED, summary="Create custom role")
async def create_role(
    payload: RoleCreateRequest,
    user_ctx: UserContext = Depends(require_manage_roles),
    db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db_session),
) -> RoleResponse:
    # Check unique name
    stmt = select(Role).where(Role.name == payload.name)
    existing = (await db.execute(stmt)).scalar_one_or_none()
    if existing:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=status.HTTP_409_CONFLICT, detail=f"Role '{payload.name}' already exists")

    new_role = Role(
        id=uuid.uuid4(),
        name=payload.name,
        description=payload.description,
        is_system_role=False,
    )
    db.add(new_role)
    await record_audit_event(
        session=db,
        actor_username=user_ctx.user.username,
        actor_id=user_ctx.user_id,
        action="CREATE_ROLE",
        entity_type=EntityType.ROLE,
        entity_id=new_role.id,
        diff_jsonb={"name": new_role.name, "description": new_role.description},
        flush=True,
    )
    await db.flush()

    return RoleResponse(
        id=new_role.id,
        name=new_role.name,
        description=new_role.description,
        is_system_role=new_role.is_system_role,
        user_count=0,
        created_at=new_role.created_at,
    )

@router.get("/{role_id}/users", response_model=List[RoleUserItem], summary="Get users assigned to a role")
async def get_role_users(
    role_id: uuid.UUID,
    user_ctx: UserContext = Depends(get_current_user),
    db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db_session),
) -> List[RoleUserItem]:
    role = await db.get(Role, role_id)
    if not role:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=status.HTTP_404_NOT_FOUND, detail="Role not found")

    items: List[RoleUserItem] = []

    # Direct assignments
    direct_stmt = (
        select(User)
        .join(UserRole, UserRole.user_id == User.id)
        .where(UserRole.role_id == role_id)
        .order_by(User.full_name.asc())
    )
    direct_users = (await db.execute(direct_stmt)).scalars().all()
    direct_user_ids = set()
    for u in direct_users:
        direct_user_ids.add(u.id)
        items.append(
            RoleUserItem(
                id=u.id,
                username=u.username,
                full_name=u.full_name,
                email=u.email,
                assignment_type="DIRECT",
            )
        )

    # Group assignments
    group_stmt = (
        select(User, GroupRole.group_id)
        .join(UserGroup, UserGroup.user_id == User.id)
        .join(GroupRole, GroupRole.group_id == UserGroup.group_id)
        .where(GroupRole.role_id == role_id)
    )
    group_users = (await db.execute(group_stmt)).all()
    for u, gid in group_users:
        if u.id not in direct_user_ids:
            items.append(
                RoleUserItem(
                    id=u.id,
                    username=u.username,
                    full_name=u.full_name,
                    email=u.email,
                    assignment_type="VIA_GROUP",
                )
            )

    return items


@router.get("/{role_id}/permissions", response_model=List[dict], summary="Get permissions granted to role")
async def get_role_permission_rules(
    role_id: uuid.UUID,
    user_ctx: UserContext = Depends(get_current_user),
    db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db_session),
) -> List[dict]:
    role = await db.get(Role, role_id)
    if not role:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=status.HTTP_404_NOT_FOUND, detail="Role not found")

    stmt = select(PermissionRule).where(PermissionRule.role_id == role_id).order_by(PermissionRule.created_at.desc())
    rules = (await db.execute(stmt)).scalars().all()
    return [
        {
            "id": r.id,
            "role_id": r.role_id,
            "resource_type": r.resource_type.value,
            "resource_id": r.resource_id,
            "action": r.action.value,
            "effect": r.effect.value,
            "created_at": r.created_at,
        }
        for r in rules
    ]


@router.put("/{role_id}/permissions", response_model=List[dict], summary="Update permissions for role")
async def update_role_permissions(
    role_id: uuid.UUID,
    payload: RolePermissionsUpdateRequest,
    user_ctx: UserContext = Depends(require_manage_roles),
    db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db_session),
) -> List[dict]:
    role = await db.get(Role, role_id)
    if not role:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=status.HTTP_404_NOT_FOUND, detail="Role not found")

    # Clear existing permissions
    del_stmt = select(PermissionRule).where(PermissionRule.role_id == role_id)
    old_rules = (await db.execute(del_stmt)).scalars().all()
    for r in old_rules:
        await db.delete(r)
    await db.flush()

    # Add new permissions
    for item in payload.permissions:
        rule = PermissionRule(
            id=uuid.uuid4(),
            role_id=role_id,
            resource_type=item.resource_type,
            resource_id=item.resource_id,
            action=item.action,
            effect=item.effect,
        )
        db.add(rule)

    await record_audit_event(
        session=db,
        actor_username=user_ctx.user.username,
        actor_id=user_ctx.user_id,
        action="UPDATE_ROLE_PERMISSIONS",
        entity_type=EntityType.ROLE,
        entity_id=role_id,
        diff_jsonb={"role_name": role.name, "permissions_count": len(payload.permissions)},
        flush=True,
    )
    await db.flush()

    return await get_role_permission_rules(role_id=role_id, user_ctx=user_ctx, db=db)

from __future__ import annotations

from typing import Optional
from fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, Query
from sqlalchemy.ext.asyncio import AsyncSession

from backend.src.api.dependencies.rbac import UserContext, get_current_user

router = APIRouter(tags=["Search"])


@router.get(
    "/search",
    response_model=SearchResponse,
    summary="Keyset-paginated full-text and trigram search across catalog tables and columns",
)
async def search_catalog(
    q: Optional[str] = Query("", description="Search query string"),
    limit: int = Query(50, ge=1, le=100, description="Max results per page"),
    cursor: Optional[str] = Query(None, description="Base64-encoded keyset cursor"),
    sort_by: str = Query("row_count_desc", pattern="^(row_count_desc|row_count_asc|name_asc)$"),
    min_rows: Optional[int] = Query(None, ge=0, description="Filter tables with row_count_estimate >= min_rows"),
    include_deleted: bool = Query(False, description="Include soft-deleted tables"),
    database: Optional[str] = Query(None, description="Filter by database name"),
    schema: Optional[str] = Query(None, description="Filter by schema name"),
    classification: Optional[str] = Query(None, description="Filter by classification level"),
    status: Optional[str] = Query(None, description="Filter by lifecycle status"),
    tag: Optional[str] = Query(None, description="Filter by tag name"),
    category: Optional[str] = Query(None, description="Filter by category UUID or name"),
    user_ctx: UserContext = Depends(get_current_user),
    db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db_session),
) -> SearchResponse:
    """
    Executes high-performance full-text GIN and trigram similarity search,
    strictly pushed down to PostgreSQL with user RBAC subqueries.
    When q is empty, returns all authorized tables.
    """
    items, page_info = await search_service.search(
        session=db,
        user_ctx=user_ctx,
        query=q,
        limit=limit,
        cursor=cursor,
        sort_by=sort_by,
        min_rows=min_rows,
        include_deleted=include_deleted,
        database_name=database,
        schema_name=schema,
        classification_level=classification,
        lifecycle_status=status,
        tag_name=tag,
        category=category,
    )
    return SearchResponse(items=items, page_info=page_info)

from __future__ import annotations

import logging
from typing import Optional
import uuid

from fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, HTTPException, Query, status
from sqlalchemy import select
from sqlalchemy.ext.asyncio import AsyncSession

from backend.src.core.database import get_db_session

from backend.src.models.statistics import TableStatisticsHistory
from backend.src.schemas.statistics import (
    TableStatisticPoint,
    TableStatisticsHistoryResponse,
)

router = APIRouter(prefix="/tables", tags=["Catalog"])


@router.get(
    "/{table_id}/statistics",
    response_model=TableStatisticsHistoryResponse,
    summary="Time-series statistical history for a table",
)
async def get_table_statistics(
    table_id: uuid.UUID,
    limit: int = Query(30, ge=1, le=100, description="Number of historical points"),
    user_ctx: UserContext = Depends(get_current_user),
    db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db_session),
) -> TableStatisticsHistoryResponse:
    """
    Returns time-series history of estimated row counts and size in bytes
    from table_statistics_history without structural version clutter.
    """
    table = await db.get(CatalogTable, table_id)
    if table is None:
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=status.HTTP_404_NOT_FOUND,
            detail=f"Table with ID '{table_id}' not found.",
        )

    stmt = (
        select(TableStatisticsHistory)
        .where(TableStatisticsHistory.table_id == table_id)
        .order_by(TableStatisticsHistory.recorded_at.desc())
        .limit(limit)
    )
    res = await db.execute(stmt)
    records = list(res.scalars().all())

    data_points = [
        TableStatisticPoint(
            recorded_at=rec.recorded_at,
            row_count_estimate=rec.row_count_estimate,
            size_bytes=rec.size_bytes,
            sync_job_id=rec.sync_job_id,
        )
        for rec in records
    ]

    return TableStatisticsHistoryResponse(
        table_id=table_id,
        data_points=data_points,
    )
