from backend.src.models.catalog import CatalogTable
from backend.src.schemas.versioning import TableVersionItem, VersionDiffResponse
from backend.src.services.catalog.version_service import version_service

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)

router = APIRouter(tags=["Versioning"])


@router.get(
    "/tables/{table_id}/versions",
    response_model=List[TableVersionItem],
    summary="List all historical snapshot versions for a table",
)
async def list_table_versions(
    table_id: uuid.UUID,
    user_ctx: UserContext = Depends(get_current_user),
    db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db_session),
) -> List[TableVersionItem]:
    """
    Returns the complete chronological history of immutable snapshot versions for a table.
    """
    stmt = select(CatalogTable).where(CatalogTable.id == table_id)
    result = await db.execute(stmt)
    table = result.scalar_one_or_none()
    if not table:
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=status.HTTP_404_NOT_FOUND,
            detail=f"Table {table_id} not found",
        )

    versions = await version_service.get_versions(db, table_id)
    return [
        TableVersionItem(
            id=v.id,
            table_id=v.table_id,
            version_num=v.version_num,
            created_by_username=v.creator.username if v.creator else None,
            created_at=v.created_at,
        )
        for v in versions
    ]


@router.get(
    "/tables/{table_id}/versions/compare",
    response_model=VersionDiffResponse,
    summary="Compare two schema snapshot versions side-by-side",
)
async def compare_table_versions(
    table_id: uuid.UUID,
    v1: int = Query(..., ge=1, description="First version number to compare"),
    v2: int = Query(..., ge=1, description="Second version number to compare"),
    user_ctx: UserContext = Depends(get_current_user),
    db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db_session),
) -> VersionDiffResponse:
    """
    Computes a side-by-side structural delta between two versions of a table,
    identifying added columns, removed columns, and modified column attributes.
    """
    try:
        diff = await version_service.compare_versions(
            session=db,
            table_id=table_id,
            v1_num=v1,
            v2_num=v2,
        )
        return VersionDiffResponse(**diff)
    except ValueError as exc:
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=status.HTTP_404_NOT_FOUND,
            detail=str(exc),
        ) from exc

from __future__ import annotations

import logging
from celery import Celery
from kombu import Queue

from backend.src.core.config import settings

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)

# Canonical queue names
QUEUE_PRIORITY = "metadata.priority"
QUEUE_FAST = "metadata.fast"
QUEUE_BULK = "metadata.bulk"

# Initialize Celery app instance
celery_app = Celery(
    "enterprise_datacatalog",
    broker=settings.CELERY_BROKER_URL,
    backend=settings.CELERY_RESULT_BACKEND,
)

# Queue topology definitions
task_queues = (
    Queue(QUEUE_PRIORITY, routing_key=QUEUE_PRIORITY),
    Queue(QUEUE_FAST, routing_key=QUEUE_FAST),
    Queue(QUEUE_BULK, routing_key=QUEUE_BULK),
)

# Task routing mappings
task_routes = {
    "backend.src.services.workers.tasks.execute_metadata_sync_task": {"queue": QUEUE_BULK},
    "backend.src.services.workers.tasks.test_connection_task": {"queue": QUEUE_FAST},
    "backend.src.services.workers.tasks.manual_metadata_sync_task": {"queue": QUEUE_PRIORITY},
}

celery_app.conf.update(
    task_queues=task_queues,
    task_default_queue=QUEUE_BULK,
    task_routes=task_routes,
    task_acks_late=True,
    worker_prefetch_multiplier=1,
    task_time_limit=1800,
    task_soft_time_limit=1500,
    task_serializer="json",
    result_serializer="json",
    accept_content=["json"],
    timezone="UTC",
    enable_utc=True,
    result_expires=86400,
    broker_connection_timeout=1,
    broker_connection_retry=False,
)

# Auto-discover worker tasks
celery_app.autodiscover_tasks(["backend.src.services.workers"])


def is_broker_available(broker_url: str = settings.CELERY_BROKER_URL) -> bool:
    """Checks whether the Celery broker host/port is reachable."""
    import socket
    from urllib.parse import urlparse

    try:
        parsed = urlparse(broker_url)
        host = parsed.hostname or "127.0.0.1"
        port = parsed.port or 6379
        with socket.create_connection((host, port), timeout=0.2):
            return True
    except Exception:
        return False


def has_active_celery_worker(timeout: float = 0.3) -> bool:
    """
    Checks whether the Celery broker is reachable and at least one worker process is actively responding.
    Returns False quickly if Redis broker is down or no worker processes are active.
    """
    if not is_broker_available():
        return False
    try:
        inspect = celery_app.control.inspect(timeout=timeout)
        pings = inspect.ping() if inspect else None
        return bool(pings and len(pings) > 0)
    except Exception as exc:
        logger.debug("Active worker inspection failed: %s", exc)
        return False

from pydantic import model_validator

class Settings(BaseSettings):
    PROJECT_NAME: str = "Enterprise Data Catalog"
    VERSION: str = "1.0.0"
    API_V1_STR: str = "/api/v1"
    ENVIRONMENT: str = "development"

    DATABASE_SYNC_URL: str = "postgresql+psycopg2://postgres:12345678@127.0.0.1:5432/enterprise_datacatalog"

    # Enterprise Connection Pool Settings (Optimized for 160k tables / 800 DBs concurrent access)
    DB_POOL_SIZE: int = 20
    DB_MAX_OVERFLOW: int = 40
    DB_POOL_TIMEOUT: int = 30
    DB_POOL_RECYCLE: int = 1800
    DB_POOL_PRE_PING: bool = True
    DB_ECHO: bool = False

    # Security & Cryptography
    CATALOG_MASTER_KEK: str = "0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef"
    ENCRYPTION_KEY: Optional[str] = None
    JWT_SECRET_KEY: str = "change-this-in-production-to-a-secure-jwt-secret-key"
    SECRET_KEY: Optional[str] = None
    JWT_ALGORITHM: str = "HS256"
    ACCESS_TOKEN_EXPIRE_MINUTES: int = 60

    # Redis & Celery Distributed Broker Configuration
    REDIS_URL: str = "redis://redis:6379/0"
    CELERY_BROKER_URL: str = "redis://redis:6379/0"
    CELERY_RESULT_BACKEND: str = "redis://redis:6379/0"

    model_config = SettingsConfigDict(
        env_file=".env",
        env_file_encoding="utf-8",
        case_sensitive=True,
        extra="ignore",
    )

    @model_validator(mode="after")
    def validate_production_security(self) -> "Settings":
        if self.SECRET_KEY:
            self.JWT_SECRET_KEY = self.SECRET_KEY
        else:
            self.SECRET_KEY = self.JWT_SECRET_KEY

        if self.ENCRYPTION_KEY:
            self.CATALOG_MASTER_KEK = self.ENCRYPTION_KEY
        else:
            self.ENCRYPTION_KEY = self.CATALOG_MASTER_KEK

        env = (self.ENVIRONMENT or "").strip().lower()
        if env in ("production", "prod"):
            insecure_secrets = {
                "change-this-in-production-to-a-secure-jwt-secret-key",
                "secret",
                "changeme",
                "default",
                "",
            }
            if not self.JWT_SECRET_KEY or self.JWT_SECRET_KEY in insecure_secrets or len(self.JWT_SECRET_KEY) < 16:
                raise ValueError(
                    "Production security violation: In production mode, a non-default SECRET_KEY / JWT_SECRET_KEY of at least 16 characters must be configured."
                )

            insecure_keks = {
                "0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef",
                "",
            }
            if not self.CATALOG_MASTER_KEK or self.CATALOG_MASTER_KEK in insecure_keks:
                raise ValueError(
                    "Production security violation: In production mode, a non-default ENCRYPTION_KEY / CATALOG_MASTER_KEK (64 hex characters) must be configured."
                )

        return self

from __future__ import annotations

from typing import Dict, List, Tuple

MONTH_NAMES: Dict[str, int] = {
    "JAN": 1, "FEB": 2, "MAR": 3, "APR": 4, "MAY": 5, "JUN": 6,
    "JUL": 7, "AUG": 8, "SEP": 9, "OCT": 10, "NOV": 11, "DEC": 12,
}

DOW_NAMES: Dict[str, int] = {
    "SUN": 0, "MON": 1, "TUE": 2, "WED": 3, "THU": 4, "FRI": 5, "SAT": 6,
}

FIELD_BOUNDS: List[Tuple[str, int, int]] = [
    ("minute", 0, 59),
    ("hour", 0, 23),
    ("day of month", 1, 31),
    ("month", 1, 12),
    ("day of week", 0, 7),
]


def _parse_token(token: str, name_map: Dict[str, int]) -> int:
    token_upper = token.upper()
    if token_upper in name_map:
        return name_map[token_upper]
    if not token.isdigit():
        raise ValueError(f"Invalid integer value: '{token}'")
    return int(token)


def _validate_cron_field(field_str: str, field_name: str, min_val: int, max_val: int, name_map: Dict[str, int]) -> None:
    if not field_str:
        raise ValueError(f"Field '{field_name}' cannot be empty")

    items = field_str.split(",")
    for item in items:
        if not item:
            raise ValueError(f"Empty element in field '{field_name}'")

        # Step expression: either */step or range/step
        if "/" in item:
            parts = item.split("/")
            if len(parts) != 2:
                raise ValueError(f"Invalid step expression '{item}' in field '{field_name}'")
            base, step_str = parts[0], parts[1]
            if not step_str.isdigit():
                raise ValueError(f"Step '{step_str}' must be a positive integer in field '{field_name}'")
            step = int(step_str)
            if step < 1:
                raise ValueError(f"Step '{step}' must be >= 1 in field '{field_name}'")

            if base == "*":
                continue
            item = base

        if item == "*":
            continue

        if "-" in item:
            range_parts = item.split("-")
            if len(range_parts) != 2:
                raise ValueError(f"Invalid range expression '{item}' in field '{field_name}'")
            start = _parse_token(range_parts[0], name_map)
            end = _parse_token(range_parts[1], name_map)
            if not (min_val <= start <= max_val) or not (min_val <= end <= max_val):
                raise ValueError(
                    f"Range values '{item}' must be between {min_val} and {max_val} in field '{field_name}'"
                )
            if start > end:
                raise ValueError(f"Range start '{start}' must be <= end '{end}' in field '{field_name}'")
        else:
            val = _parse_token(item, name_map)
            if not (min_val <= val <= max_val):
                raise ValueError(
                    f"Value '{val}' out of range [{min_val}, {max_val}] in field '{field_name}'"
                )


def validate_cron_expression(expression: str) -> None:
    """
    Rigorously validates standard 5-part cron syntax:
    `<minute> <hour> <day of month> <month> <day of week>`.

    Raises:
        ValueError: If the cron expression does not contain exactly 5 valid fields.
    """
    if not isinstance(expression, str) or not expression.strip():
        raise ValueError("Cron expression must be a non-empty string")

    fields = expression.strip().split()
    if len(fields) != 5:
        raise ValueError(
            f"Invalid cron expression: '{expression}'. Expected exactly 5 whitespace-separated fields, got {len(fields)}."
        )

    for i, (field_name, min_v, max_v) in enumerate(FIELD_BOUNDS):
        name_map = {}
        if field_name == "month":
            name_map = MONTH_NAMES
        elif field_name == "day of week":
            name_map = DOW_NAMES

        try:
            _validate_cron_field(fields[i], field_name, min_v, max_v, name_map)
        except ValueError as exc:
            raise ValueError(f"Invalid cron field '{fields[i]}' for {field_name}: {str(exc)}") from exc

from collections.abc import AsyncGenerator
from contextlib import asynccontextmanager
import time
from typing import Any, Dict

from sqlalchemy import text
from sqlalchemy.ext.asyncio import (
    AsyncEngine,
    AsyncSession,
    async_sessionmaker,
    create_async_engine,
)

from backend.src.core.config import settings

# Enterprise-grade async engine pool configuration for high concurrency
engine: AsyncEngine = create_async_engine(
    settings.DATABASE_URL,
    echo=settings.DB_ECHO,
    future=True,
    pool_size=settings.DB_POOL_SIZE,
    max_overflow=settings.DB_MAX_OVERFLOW,
    pool_timeout=settings.DB_POOL_TIMEOUT,
    pool_recycle=settings.DB_POOL_RECYCLE,
    pool_pre_ping=settings.DB_POOL_PRE_PING,
)

async_session_factory: async_sessionmaker[AsyncSession] = async_sessionmaker(
    bind=engine,
    class_=AsyncSession,
    expire_on_commit=False,
    autocommit=False,
    autoflush=False,
)


async def get_db_session() -> AsyncGenerator[AsyncSession, None]:
    """
    FastAPI dependency yielding a transactional AsyncSession.
    Automatically commits changes when the request handler finishes cleanly.
    Automatically rolls back transaction if an unhandled exception is raised.
    Always closes the session in finally to release connection back to pool.
    """
    async with async_session_factory() as session:
        try:
            yield session
            await session.commit()
        except Exception:
            await session.rollback()
            raise
        finally:
            await session.close()


@asynccontextmanager
async def get_session_context() -> AsyncGenerator[AsyncSession, None]:
    """
    Async context manager for background tasks, CLI commands, and worker jobs.
    Usage:
        async with get_session_context() as session:
            await session.execute(...)
    """
    async with async_session_factory() as session:
        try:
            yield session
            await session.commit()
        except Exception:
            await session.rollback()
            raise
        finally:
            await session.close()


async def check_database_health() -> Dict[str, Any]:
    """
    Lightweight health check probe measuring connection latency and database version.
    Returns structured diagnostic dictionary.
    """
    start_time = time.perf_counter()
    async with engine.connect() as conn:
        result = await conn.execute(text("SELECT version();"))
        version_str: str = str(result.scalar_one())
    elapsed_ms = (time.perf_counter() - start_time) * 1000.0

    return {
        "status": "HEALTHY",
        "database_version": version_str,
        "latency_ms": round(elapsed_ms, 2),
        "pool_size": engine.pool.size(),
        "checked_out_connections": engine.pool.checkedout(),
        "overflow_connections": engine.pool.overflow(),
    }


async def dispose_engine() -> None:
    """Disposes all connection pool sockets cleanly during application shutdown."""
    await engine.dispose()

from __future__ import annotations

import uuid
from datetime import datetime
from typing import Any, Dict, List, Optional
from pydantic import BaseModel, ConfigDict, Field, field_validator

from backend.src.schemas.pagination import KeysetPageInfo


class AuditLogItem(BaseModel):
    model_config = ConfigDict(from_attributes=True)

    id: uuid.UUID
    actor_id: Optional[uuid.UUID] = None
    actor_username: str
    ip_address: Optional[str] = None
    user_agent: Optional[str] = None
    action: str
    entity_type: str
    entity_id: uuid.UUID
    diff_jsonb: Dict[str, Any] = Field(default_factory=dict)
    created_at: datetime

    @field_validator("ip_address", mode="before")
    @classmethod
    def convert_ip_address(cls, v: Any) -> Optional[str]:
        if v is None:
            return None
        return str(v)

    @field_validator("entity_type", mode="before")
    @classmethod
    def convert_entity_type(cls, v: Any) -> str:
        if hasattr(v, "value"):
            return str(v.value)
        return str(v)


class AuditLogResponse(BaseModel):
    model_config = ConfigDict(from_attributes=True)

    items: List[AuditLogItem]
    page_info: KeysetPageInfo

class TagItem(BaseModel):

    model_config = ConfigDict(from_attributes=True)

    id: uuid.UUID
    entity_type: str = Field(..., description="TABLE or COLUMN")
    name: str
    database_name: str
    schema_name: str
    table_name: Optional[str] = None
    table_type: Optional[str] = "TABLE"
    source_description: Optional[str] = None
    approved_description: Optional[str] = None
    effective_description: Optional[str] = None
    rank: float
    classification_level: Optional[str] = None
    status: str
    row_count_estimate: Optional[int] = 0
    size_bytes: Optional[int] = 0
    tags: List[TagItem] = Field(default_factory=list)
    description_drift_detected: bool = False


class SearchResponse(BaseModel):
    model_config = ConfigDict(from_attributes=True)

    items: List[SearchHit]
    page_info: KeysetPageInfo

    model_config = ConfigDict(from_attributes=True)

    schema_id: uuid.UUID
    name: str
    table_type: str
    collation: Optional[str] = None
    row_count_estimate: int
    size_bytes: int
    source_description: Optional[str] = None

from __future__ import annotations

import base64
import json
import uuid
from datetime import datetime
from typing import Any, Dict, List, Optional, Tuple, Union

from sqlalchemy import and_, or_, select
from sqlalchemy.ext.asyncio import AsyncSession

from backend.src.models.audit import AuditLog
from backend.src.models.rbac import EntityType
from backend.src.schemas.audit import AuditLogItem, AuditLogResponse
from backend.src.schemas.pagination import KeysetPageInfo


def encode_cursor(created_at: datetime, item_id: uuid.UUID) -> str:
    """Encodes created_at timestamp and UUID into an opaque Base64 keyset cursor."""
    payload = {
        "created_at": created_at.isoformat(),
        "id": str(item_id),
    }
    raw = json.dumps(payload).encode("utf-8")
    return base64.urlsafe_b64encode(raw).decode("utf-8")


def decode_cursor(cursor_str: str) -> Tuple[datetime, uuid.UUID]:
    """Decodes an opaque Base64 keyset cursor into (created_at, uuid)."""
    raw = base64.urlsafe_b64decode(cursor_str.encode("utf-8")).decode("utf-8")
    payload = json.loads(raw)
    val = datetime.fromisoformat(payload["created_at"])
    return val, uuid.UUID(payload["id"])


class AuditQueryService:
    """
    Enterprise Keyset-Paginated Audit Query Service.
    Enforces deterministic keyset pagination (created_at DESC, id DESC),
    multi-column filtering (actor, entity type, entity ID, action, timestamp range),
    and partition-pruned query execution using composite B-Tree indexes.
    """

    @classmethod
    async def query_audit_logs(
        cls,
        session: AsyncSession,
        entity_type: Optional[Union[EntityType, str]] = None,
        entity_id: Optional[Union[uuid.UUID, str]] = None,
        actor_id: Optional[Union[uuid.UUID, str]] = None,
        actor_username: Optional[str] = None,
        action: Optional[str] = None,
        start_time: Optional[datetime] = None,
        end_time: Optional[datetime] = None,
        limit: int = 50,
        cursor: Optional[str] = None,
    ) -> AuditLogResponse:
        """
        Executes partition-pruned, keyset-paginated query against audit_logs.
        Returns AuditLogResponse adhering to the OpenAPI schema.
        """
        bounded_limit = max(1, min(limit, 200))
        stmt = select(AuditLog)
        filters = []

        if entity_type is not None:
            resolved_et = (
                EntityType(entity_type)
                if isinstance(entity_type, str)
                else entity_type
            )
            filters.append(AuditLog.entity_type == resolved_et)

        if entity_id is not None:
            resolved_eid = (
                uuid.UUID(entity_id) if isinstance(entity_id, str) else entity_id
            )
            filters.append(AuditLog.entity_id == resolved_eid)

        if actor_id is not None:
            resolved_aid = (
                uuid.UUID(actor_id) if isinstance(actor_id, str) else actor_id
            )
            filters.append(AuditLog.actor_id == resolved_aid)

        if actor_username is not None:
            filters.append(AuditLog.actor_username == actor_username)

        if action is not None:
            filters.append(AuditLog.action == action)

        if start_time is not None:
            filters.append(AuditLog.created_at >= start_time)

        if end_time is not None:
            filters.append(AuditLog.created_at <= end_time)

        if cursor is not None:
            cursor_dt, cursor_uuid = decode_cursor(cursor)
            filters.append(
                or_(
                    AuditLog.created_at < cursor_dt,
                    and_(
                        AuditLog.created_at == cursor_dt,
                        AuditLog.id < cursor_uuid,
                    ),
                )
            )

        if filters:
            stmt = stmt.where(and_(*filters))

        # Deterministic keyset sort
        stmt = stmt.order_by(AuditLog.created_at.desc(), AuditLog.id.desc()).limit(
            bounded_limit + 1
        )

        result = await session.execute(stmt)
        records = list(result.scalars().all())

        has_next_page = len(records) > bounded_limit
        items = records[:bounded_limit]

        next_cursor: Optional[str] = None
        if has_next_page and items:
            next_cursor = encode_cursor(items[-1].created_at, items[-1].id)

        items_dto = [AuditLogItem.model_validate(r) for r in items]
        page_info = KeysetPageInfo(
            has_next_page=has_next_page,
            next_cursor=next_cursor,
            limit=bounded_limit,
        )

        return AuditLogResponse(items=items_dto, page_info=page_info)

from __future__ import annotations

import base64
import json
import uuid
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from typing import Any, Dict, List, Optional, Tuple, Union

from sqlalchemy import and_, event, or_, select
from sqlalchemy.ext.asyncio import AsyncSession
from sqlalchemy.orm import Session

from backend.src.models.audit import AuditLog
from backend.src.models.rbac import EntityType


def _session_before_flush_listener(
    session: Session, flush_context: Any, instances: Any
) -> None:
    """SQLAlchemy before_flush hook that appends queued audit entries to the session."""
    pending: Optional[List[AuditLog]] = session.info.get("pending_audit_events")
    if pending:
        while pending:
            entry = pending.pop(0)
            session.add(entry)


def _encode_cursor(created_at: datetime, item_id: uuid.UUID) -> str:
    """Encodes created_at timestamp and entity UUID into an opaque Base64 keyset cursor."""
    payload = {
        "val": created_at.isoformat(),
        "id": str(item_id),
    }
    raw = json.dumps(payload).encode("utf-8")
    return base64.urlsafe_b64encode(raw).decode("utf-8")


def _decode_cursor(cursor_str: str) -> Tuple[datetime, uuid.UUID]:
    """Decodes an opaque Base64 keyset cursor into (created_at, uuid)."""
    raw = base64.urlsafe_b64decode(cursor_str.encode("utf-8")).decode("utf-8")
    payload = json.loads(raw)
    val = datetime.fromisoformat(payload["val"])
    return val, uuid.UUID(payload["id"])


async def record_audit_event(
    session: AsyncSession,
    actor_username: str,
    action: str,
    entity_type: Union[EntityType, str],
    entity_id: Union[uuid.UUID, str],
    actor_id: Optional[Union[uuid.UUID, str]] = None,
    ip_address: Optional[str] = None,
    user_agent: Optional[str] = None,
    diff_jsonb: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None,
    event_id: Optional[uuid.UUID] = None,
    created_at: Optional[datetime] = None,
    flush: bool = False,
) -> AuditLog:
    """
    Persists an immutable AuditLog record in the active database transaction.
    Automatically assigns to current month partition based on created_at timestamp.
    Guarantees strict atomicity: rolls back if surrounding transaction fails.
    """
    # Normalize entity_type
    if isinstance(entity_type, str):
        resolved_entity_type = EntityType(entity_type)
    else:
        resolved_entity_type = entity_type

    # Normalize UUIDs
    resolved_entity_id = (
        uuid.UUID(entity_id) if isinstance(entity_id, str) else entity_id
    )
    resolved_actor_id = (
        uuid.UUID(actor_id)
        if isinstance(actor_id, str)
        else actor_id
    )

    log_entry = AuditLog(
        id=event_id or uuid.uuid4(),
        created_at=created_at or datetime.now(timezone.utc),
        actor_id=resolved_actor_id,
        actor_username=actor_username,
        ip_address=ip_address,
        user_agent=user_agent,
        action=action,
        entity_type=resolved_entity_type,
        entity_id=resolved_entity_id,
        diff_jsonb=diff_jsonb if diff_jsonb is not None else {},
    )

    session.add(log_entry)

    if flush:
        await session.flush()

    return log_entry


class AuditService:
    """
    Core Enterprise Audit Logging Service providing session flush hooks,
    transactional event recording, and keyset-paginated audit trail queries.
    """

    @classmethod
    def attach_session_hook(cls, session: Union[AsyncSession, Session]) -> None:
        """
        Attaches the before_flush audit listener to the provided session.
        Idempotent: will not attach multiple duplicate listeners to the same session.
        """
        sync_sess: Session = (
            session.sync_session
            if isinstance(session, AsyncSession)
            else session
        )
        if not sync_sess.info.get("_audit_hook_attached"):
            event.listen(sync_sess, "before_flush", _session_before_flush_listener)
            sync_sess.info["_audit_hook_attached"] = True

    @classmethod
    def queue_audit_event(
        cls,
        session: Union[AsyncSession, Session],
        actor_username: str,
        action: str,
        entity_type: Union[EntityType, str],
        entity_id: Union[uuid.UUID, str],
        actor_id: Optional[Union[uuid.UUID, str]] = None,
        ip_address: Optional[str] = None,
        user_agent: Optional[str] = None,
        diff_jsonb: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None,
        event_id: Optional[uuid.UUID] = None,
        created_at: Optional[datetime] = None,
    ) -> AuditLog:
        """
        Queues an AuditLog to be materialized during the next session.flush()
        via the attached session before_flush listener.
        """
        cls.attach_session_hook(session)
        sync_sess: Session = (
            session.sync_session
            if isinstance(session, AsyncSession)
            else session
        )

        # Normalize entity_type
        if isinstance(entity_type, str):
            resolved_entity_type = EntityType(entity_type)
        else:
            resolved_entity_type = entity_type

        # Normalize UUIDs
        resolved_entity_id = (
            uuid.UUID(entity_id) if isinstance(entity_id, str) else entity_id
        )
        resolved_actor_id = (
            uuid.UUID(actor_id)
            if isinstance(actor_id, str)
            else actor_id
        )

        log_entry = AuditLog(
            id=event_id or uuid.uuid4(),
            created_at=created_at or datetime.now(timezone.utc),
            actor_id=resolved_actor_id,
            actor_username=actor_username,
            ip_address=ip_address,
            user_agent=user_agent,
            action=action,
            entity_type=resolved_entity_type,
            entity_id=resolved_entity_id,
            diff_jsonb=diff_jsonb if diff_jsonb is not None else {},
        )

        sync_sess.add(log_entry)
        pending_list: List[AuditLog] = sync_sess.info.setdefault(
            "pending_audit_events", []
        )
        pending_list.append(log_entry)
        return log_entry

    @classmethod
    async def record_event(
        cls,
        session: AsyncSession,
        actor_username: str,
        action: str,
        entity_type: Union[EntityType, str],
        entity_id: Union[uuid.UUID, str],
        actor_id: Optional[Union[uuid.UUID, str]] = None,
        ip_address: Optional[str] = None,
        user_agent: Optional[str] = None,
        diff_jsonb: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None,
        event_id: Optional[uuid.UUID] = None,
        created_at: Optional[datetime] = None,
        flush: bool = False,
    ) -> AuditLog:
        """Delegates directly to record_audit_event."""
        return await record_audit_event(
            session=session,
            actor_username=actor_username,
            action=action,
            entity_type=entity_type,
            entity_id=entity_id,
            actor_id=actor_id,
            ip_address=ip_address,
            user_agent=user_agent,
            diff_jsonb=diff_jsonb,
            event_id=event_id,
            created_at=created_at,
            flush=flush,
        )

    @classmethod
    async def query_audit_logs(
        cls,
        session: AsyncSession,
        entity_type: Optional[Union[EntityType, str]] = None,
        entity_id: Optional[Union[uuid.UUID, str]] = None,
        actor_id: Optional[Union[uuid.UUID, str]] = None,
        actor_username: Optional[str] = None,
        action: Optional[str] = None,
        start_time: Optional[datetime] = None,
        end_time: Optional[datetime] = None,
        limit: int = 50,
        cursor: Optional[str] = None,
    ) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """
        Executes partition-pruned, keyset-paginated query against audit_logs.
        Complies strictly with OpenAPI KeysetPageInfo and AuditLogResponse schema.
        """
        bounded_limit = max(1, min(limit, 200))
        stmt = select(AuditLog)

        filters = []

        if entity_type is not None:
            res_et = (
                EntityType(entity_type)
                if isinstance(entity_type, str)
                else entity_type
            )
            filters.append(AuditLog.entity_type == res_et)

        if entity_id is not None:
            res_eid = (
                uuid.UUID(entity_id) if isinstance(entity_id, str) else entity_id
            )
            filters.append(AuditLog.entity_id == res_eid)

        if actor_id is not None:
            res_aid = (
                uuid.UUID(actor_id) if isinstance(actor_id, str) else actor_id
            )
            filters.append(AuditLog.actor_id == res_aid)

        if actor_username is not None:
            filters.append(AuditLog.actor_username == actor_username)

        if action is not None:
            filters.append(AuditLog.action == action)

        if start_time is not None:
            filters.append(AuditLog.created_at >= start_time)

        if end_time is not None:
            filters.append(AuditLog.created_at <= end_time)

        if cursor is not None:
            cursor_dt, cursor_uuid = _decode_cursor(cursor)
            filters.append(
                or_(
                    AuditLog.created_at < cursor_dt,
                    and_(
                        AuditLog.created_at == cursor_dt,
                        AuditLog.id < cursor_uuid,
                    ),
                )
            )

        if filters:
            stmt = stmt.where(and_(*filters))

        stmt = stmt.order_by(AuditLog.created_at.desc(), AuditLog.id.desc()).limit(
            bounded_limit + 1
        )

        result = await session.execute(stmt)
        records = list(result.scalars().all())

        has_next_page = len(records) > bounded_limit
        items = records[:bounded_limit]

        end_cursor: Optional[str] = None
        if items:
            end_cursor = _encode_cursor(items[-1].created_at, items[-1].id)

        items_payload = [
            {
                "id": str(r.id),
                "actor_id": str(r.actor_id) if r.actor_id else None,
                "actor_username": r.actor_username,
                "ip_address": str(r.ip_address) if r.ip_address else None,
                "user_agent": r.user_agent,
                "action": r.action,
                "entity_type": (
                    r.entity_type.value
                    if hasattr(r.entity_type, "value")
                    else str(r.entity_type)
                ),
                "entity_id": str(r.entity_id),
                "diff_jsonb": r.diff_jsonb,
                "created_at": r.created_at.isoformat() if r.created_at else None,
            }
            for r in items
        ]

        return {
            "items": items_payload,
            "page_info": {
                "has_next_page": has_next_page,
                "end_cursor": end_cursor,
            },
        }

from __future__ import annotations

import uuid
from datetime import datetime, timedelta, timezone
from typing import Any, Dict, List, Optional, Union

import jwt
from argon2 import PasswordHasher, Type
from argon2.exceptions import InvalidHash, VerificationError, VerifyMismatchError
from sqlalchemy import or_, select
from sqlalchemy.ext.asyncio import AsyncSession

from backend.src.core.config import settings
from backend.src.models.identity import Role, User, UserRole, UserStatus


class AuthError(Exception):
    """Base exception for authentication and token validation failures."""

    pass


class InvalidCredentialsError(AuthError):
    """Raised when authentication credentials (username/password) are invalid."""

    pass


class InactiveUserError(AuthError):
    """Raised when an authenticated user's account is SUSPENDED or DEACTIVATED."""

    pass


class InvalidTokenError(AuthError):
    """Raised when a JWT signature is invalid, forged, or the token payload is malformed."""

    pass


class TokenExpiredError(AuthError):
    """Raised when a JWT has expired."""

    pass


class JWTAuthService:
    """
    Production-grade Identity & JWT Authentication Service.

    Provides:
    - Argon2id password hashing and verification complying with RFC 9106.
    - JWT token generation with comprehensive enterprise claims (sub, username, email, roles, is_superadmin, exp, iat, jti).
    - Cryptographic signature validation and expiration enforcement.
    - Asynchronous user authentication against PostgreSQL database with status validation (ACTIVE vs SUSPENDED/DEACTIVATED).
    """

    def __init__(
        self,
        secret_key: str = settings.JWT_SECRET_KEY,
        algorithm: str = settings.JWT_ALGORITHM,
        access_token_expire_minutes: int = settings.ACCESS_TOKEN_EXPIRE_MINUTES,
        time_cost: int = 3,
        memory_cost: int = 65536,
        parallelism: int = 4,
        hash_len: int = 32,
        salt_len: int = 16,
    ) -> None:
        self.secret_key = secret_key
        self.algorithm = algorithm
        self.access_token_expire_minutes = access_token_expire_minutes
        self._password_hasher = PasswordHasher(
            time_cost=time_cost,
            memory_cost=memory_cost,
            parallelism=parallelism,
            hash_len=hash_len,
            salt_len=salt_len,
            type=Type.ID,
        )

    def hash_password(self, password: str) -> str:
        """
        Hashes a plaintext password using Argon2id.

        Args:
            password: The plaintext password string to hash.

        Returns:
            str: An RFC 9106 compliant Argon2id password hash string.
        """
        if not password:
            raise ValueError("Password cannot be empty")
        return self._password_hasher.hash(password)

    def verify_password(self, plain_password: str, hashed_password: str) -> bool:
        """
        Verifies a plaintext password against an Argon2id hash.
        Performs constant-time comparison to prevent timing attacks.

        Args:
            plain_password: The plaintext password.
            hashed_password: The stored Argon2id hash.

        Returns:
            bool: True if password matches hash, False otherwise.
        """
        if not plain_password or not hashed_password:
            return False
        try:
            return self._password_hasher.verify(hashed_password, plain_password)
        except (VerifyMismatchError, VerificationError, InvalidHash):
            return False

    def check_needs_rehash(self, hashed_password: str) -> bool:
        """
        Determines whether the password hash needs to be updated to match current
        hasher parameters.
        """
        try:
            return self._password_hasher.check_needs_rehash(hashed_password)
        except Exception:
            return True

    def create_access_token(
        self,
        data: Dict[str, Any],
        expires_delta: Optional[timedelta] = None,
    ) -> str:
        """
        Issues an encoded JWT access token with standard enterprise claims.

        Args:
            data: Custom claims payload (e.g., sub, username, email, roles, is_superadmin).
            expires_delta: Optional custom token expiration duration.

        Returns:
            str: Encoded JWT token string.
        """
        to_encode = data.copy()
        now = datetime.now(timezone.utc)

        if expires_delta is not None:
            expire = now + expires_delta
        else:
            expire = now + timedelta(minutes=self.access_token_expire_minutes)

        to_encode.setdefault("iat", int(now.timestamp()))
        to_encode.setdefault("nbf", int(now.timestamp()))
        to_encode.setdefault("jti", str(uuid.uuid4()))
        to_encode["exp"] = int(expire.timestamp())

        if "sub" in to_encode and isinstance(to_encode["sub"], uuid.UUID):
            to_encode["sub"] = str(to_encode["sub"])

        encoded_jwt = jwt.encode(
            payload=to_encode,
            key=self.secret_key,
            algorithm=self.algorithm,
        )
        return encoded_jwt

    def decode_token(self, token: str) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """
        Decodes and validates a JWT access token's cryptographic signature and expiration.

        Args:
            token: Encoded JWT token string.

        Returns:
            Dict[str, Any]: Decoded payload claims dictionary.

        Raises:
            TokenExpiredError: If the token has passed its expiration time.
            InvalidTokenError: If the signature is forged, invalid, or the payload is corrupt.
        """
        try:
            payload = jwt.decode(
                token,
                self.secret_key,
                algorithms=[self.algorithm],
                options={
                    "require": ["exp", "iat"],
                    "verify_exp": True,
                    "verify_iat": True,
                },
            )
            return payload
        except jwt.ExpiredSignatureError as exc:
            raise TokenExpiredError("JWT token has expired") from exc
        except (jwt.InvalidSignatureError, jwt.DecodeError, jwt.InvalidTokenError, Exception) as exc:
            raise InvalidTokenError(f"Invalid JWT token: {str(exc)}") from exc

    def validate_token(self, token: str) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """Alias for decode_token."""
        return self.decode_token(token)

    def extract_user_id(self, token: str) -> uuid.UUID:
        """
        Extracts and parses the user ID UUID from the token's 'sub' claim.
        """
        claims = self.decode_token(token)
        sub = claims.get("sub")
        if not sub:
            raise InvalidTokenError("Token missing 'sub' subject claim")
        try:
            return uuid.UUID(str(sub))
        except (ValueError, TypeError) as exc:
            raise InvalidTokenError(f"Invalid user ID in 'sub' claim: {sub}") from exc

    async def get_user_roles(
        self, session: AsyncSession, user_id: uuid.UUID
    ) -> List[str]:
        """
        Queries all active roles assigned to a user.

        Args:
            session: SQLAlchemy AsyncSession.
            user_id: User UUID.

        Returns:
            List[str]: Alphabetically sorted list of role names.
        """
        stmt = (
            select(Role.name)
            .join(UserRole, UserRole.role_id == Role.id)
            .where(UserRole.user_id == user_id)
            .order_by(Role.name.asc())
        )
        result = await session.execute(stmt)
        return list(result.scalars().all())

    async def authenticate_user(
        self,
        session: AsyncSession,
        username_or_email: str,
        password: str,
    ) -> User:
        """
        Authenticates a user by username or email and validates their password against
        the stored Argon2id hash. Validates that the account status is ACTIVE.

        Args:
            session: SQLAlchemy AsyncSession.
            username_or_email: The user's username or email address.
            password: The raw password provided during login.

        Returns:
            User: The authenticated active User model instance.

        Raises:
            InvalidCredentialsError: If user does not exist or password does not match.
            InactiveUserError: If user status is SUSPENDED or DEACTIVATED.
        """
        stmt = select(User).where(
            or_(User.username == username_or_email, User.email == username_or_email)
        )
        result = await session.execute(stmt)
        user = result.scalar_one_or_none()

        if user is None:
            raise InvalidCredentialsError("Invalid username or password")

        if not self.verify_password(password, user.hashed_password):
            raise InvalidCredentialsError("Invalid username or password")

        if user.status != UserStatus.ACTIVE:
            raise InactiveUserError(
                f"User account '{user.username}' is not active (status: {user.status.value})"
            )

        return user

    async def issue_token_for_user(
        self,
        session: Optional[AsyncSession],
        user: User,
        roles: Optional[List[str]] = None,
        expires_delta: Optional[timedelta] = None,
    ) -> str:
        """
        Constructs user claims and issues a signed JWT access token.
        If roles is None and a session is provided, queries the database for user roles.

        Args:
            session: Optional SQLAlchemy AsyncSession to fetch roles.
            user: User model instance.
            roles: Optional list of role names.
            expires_delta: Optional token expiration duration.

        Returns:
            str: Signed JWT access token.
        """
        effective_roles: List[str] = []
        if roles is not None:
            effective_roles = roles
        elif session is not None:
            effective_roles = await self.get_user_roles(session, user.id)

        claims = {
            "sub": str(user.id),
            "username": user.username,
            "email": user.email,
            "roles": effective_roles,
            "is_superadmin": user.is_superadmin,
        }
        return self.create_access_token(data=claims, expires_delta=expires_delta)


auth_service: JWTAuthService = JWTAuthService()


def hash_password(password: str) -> str:
    return auth_service.hash_password(password)


def verify_password(plain_password: str, hashed_password: str) -> bool:
    return auth_service.verify_password(plain_password, hashed_password)


def create_access_token(
    data: Dict[str, Any], expires_delta: Optional[timedelta] = None
) -> str:
    return auth_service.create_access_token(data, expires_delta=expires_delta)


def decode_jwt_token(token: str) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    return auth_service.decode_token(token)


async def authenticate_user(
    session: AsyncSession, username_or_email: str, password: str
) -> User:
    return await auth_service.authenticate_user(session, username_or_email, password)

class CursorData(dict):
    """Cursor dictionary that also supports unpacking like a 2-tuple (val, id)."""

    def __iter__(self):
        yield self.get("name") or self.get("val", "")
        yield uuid.UUID(str(self["id"]))

    @property
    def val(self) -> str:
        return str(self.get("val", ""))

    @property
    def id(self) -> uuid.UUID:
        return uuid.UUID(str(self["id"]))

    @property
    def name(self) -> str:
        return str(self.get("name", self.get("val", "")))

    @property
    def rows(self) -> int:
        return int(self.get("rows", 0))


def encode_cursor(
    sort_val: Any,
    row_id: uuid.UUID,
    name: Optional[str] = None,
    row_count: Optional[int] = None,
    sort_by: str = "row_count_desc",
) -> str:
    """Encodes a sort value, UUID, name and row count into an opaque URL-safe Base64 cursor."""
    row_name = name or (str(sort_val) if not isinstance(sort_val, (int, float)) else "")
    row_cnt = row_count if row_count is not None else (
        int(sort_val) if isinstance(sort_val, (int, float)) or (isinstance(sort_val, str) and sort_val.isdigit()) else 0
    )
    payload = {
        "val": str(row_cnt) if "row_count" in sort_by else row_name,
        "id": str(row_id),
        "name": row_name,
        "rows": row_cnt,
        "sort": sort_by,
    }
    return base64.b64encode(json.dumps(payload).encode("utf-8")).decode("utf-8")


def decode_cursor(cursor_str: str) -> CursorData:
    """Decodes a Base64 keyset cursor into CursorData."""
    raw = base64.b64decode(cursor_str.encode("utf-8")).decode("utf-8")
    data = json.loads(raw)
    return CursorData(data)


class SearchService:
    """
    High-performance Search and Keyset Navigation Service.
    Enforces PostgreSQL GIN to_tsquery and pg_trgm similarity with SQL-pushed RBAC.
    """

    async def search(
        self,
        session: AsyncSession,
        user_ctx: UserContext,
        query: Optional[str] = "",
        limit: int = 50,
        cursor: Optional[str] = None,
        sort_by: str = "row_count_desc",
        min_rows: Optional[int] = None,
        include_deleted: bool = False,
        database_name: Optional[str] = None,
        schema_name: Optional[str] = None,
        classification_level: Optional[str] = None,
        lifecycle_status: Optional[str] = None,
        tag_name: Optional[str] = None,
        category: Optional[str] = None,
    ) -> Tuple[List[Dict[str, Any]], Dict[str, Any]]:
        """
        Executes keyset-paginated search across catalog tables filtered directly in SQL by RBAC.
        When query is empty or omitted, returns all authorized tables ordered deterministically.
        """
        clean_query = (query or "").strip()

        stmt: Select = (
            select(
                CatalogTable,
                DatabaseSchema.name.label("schema_name"),
                DatabaseConnection.database_name.label("database_name"),
            )
            .join(DatabaseSchema, DatabaseSchema.id == CatalogTable.schema_id)
            .join(DatabaseConnection, DatabaseConnection.id == DatabaseSchema.connection_id)
        )

        if clean_query:
            ts_query_expr = func.plainto_tsquery("english", clean_query)
            ts_match = CatalogTable.search_vector.op("@@")(ts_query_expr)
            trgm_match = CatalogTable.name.ilike(f"%{clean_query}%")
            rank_expr = func.coalesce(
                func.ts_rank(CatalogTable.search_vector, ts_query_expr), 0.0
            ) + func.similarity(CatalogTable.name, clean_query)
            stmt = stmt.add_columns(rank_expr.label("rank_score")).where(or_(ts_match, trgm_match))
        else:
            stmt = stmt.add_columns(func.cast(0.0, Float).label("rank_score"))

        # Soft-delete filter
        if not include_deleted:
            stmt = stmt.where(CatalogTable.status != LifecycleStatus.DELETED)

        # Filters
        if database_name:
            stmt = stmt.where(
                or_(
                    DatabaseConnection.name == database_name,
                    and_(
                        DatabaseConnection.database_name.ilike(f"%{database_name}%"),
                        ~select(DatabaseConnection.id).where(DatabaseConnection.name == database_name).exists(),
                    ),
                )
            )
        if schema_name:
            stmt = stmt.where(DatabaseSchema.name.ilike(f"%{schema_name}%"))
        if lifecycle_status:
            try:
                stmt = stmt.where(CatalogTable.status == LifecycleStatus(lifecycle_status))
            except Exception:
                pass

        if classification_level:
            # Filter tables containing at least one column with matching classification
            col_class_subq = (
                select(1)
                .where(
                    CatalogColumn.table_id == CatalogTable.id,
                    CatalogColumn.classification_level == ClassificationLevel(classification_level),
                )
            )
            stmt = stmt.where(col_class_subq.exists())

        if tag_name:
            # Filter tables with matching tag name
            tag_subq = (
                select(1)
                .join(Tag, Tag.id == TagAssignment.tag_id)
                .where(
                    TagAssignment.entity_type == EntityType.TABLE,
                    TagAssignment.entity_id == CatalogTable.id,
                    Tag.name.ilike(tag_name),
                )
            )
            stmt = stmt.where(tag_subq.exists())

        if category:
            cat_id: Optional[uuid.UUID] = None
            try:
                cat_id = uuid.UUID(category)
            except ValueError:
                cat_lookup_stmt = select(Category.id).where(Category.name.ilike(category.strip()))
                cat_lookup_res = await session.execute(cat_lookup_stmt)
                cat_id = cat_lookup_res.scalar_one_or_none()

            if cat_id:
                descendant_cat_ids = await CategoryService.get_descendant_category_ids(session, cat_id)
                cat_subq = (
                    select(1)
                    .where(
                        CategoryAssignment.entity_type == EntityType.TABLE,
                        CategoryAssignment.entity_id == CatalogTable.id,
                        CategoryAssignment.category_id.in_(descendant_cat_ids),
                    )
                )
                stmt = stmt.where(cat_subq.exists())
            else:
                stmt = stmt.where(or_())

        if min_rows is not None:
            stmt = stmt.where(func.coalesce(CatalogTable.row_count_estimate, 0) >= min_rows)

        # Apply SQL-pushed RBAC filter
        rbac_filter = build_table_rbac_filter(user_ctx=user_ctx, action=PermissionAction.VIEW_METADATA)
        stmt = rbac_filter(stmt)

        # Keyset pagination condition based on sort_by
        coalesced_rows = func.coalesce(CatalogTable.row_count_estimate, 0)
        if cursor:
            try:
                cur_data = decode_cursor(cursor)
                cur_id = uuid.UUID(str(cur_data["id"]))
                cur_name = str(cur_data.get("name") or cur_data.get("val", ""))
                cur_rows = int(cur_data.get("rows", 0)) if "rows" in cur_data else (
                    int(cur_data["val"]) if str(cur_data.get("val", "")).isdigit() else 0
                )

                if sort_by == "row_count_desc":
                    stmt = stmt.where(
                        or_(
                            coalesced_rows < cur_rows,
                            and_(
                                coalesced_rows == cur_rows,
                                CatalogTable.name > cur_name,
                            ),
                            and_(
                                coalesced_rows == cur_rows,
                                CatalogTable.name == cur_name,
                                CatalogTable.id > cur_id,
                            ),
                        )
                    )
                elif sort_by == "row_count_asc":
                    stmt = stmt.where(
                        or_(
                            coalesced_rows > cur_rows,
                            and_(
                                coalesced_rows == cur_rows,
                                CatalogTable.name > cur_name,
                            ),
                            and_(
                                coalesced_rows == cur_rows,
                                CatalogTable.name == cur_name,
                                CatalogTable.id > cur_id,
                            ),
                        )
                    )
                else:  # name_asc
                    stmt = stmt.where(
                        or_(
                            CatalogTable.name > cur_name,
                            and_(CatalogTable.name == cur_name, CatalogTable.id > cur_id),
                        )
                    )
            except Exception:
                # Invalid cursor format fallback -> ignore cursor
                pass

        # Deterministic sorting for keyset cursor pagination
        if sort_by == "row_count_desc":
            stmt = stmt.order_by(
                coalesced_rows.desc(),
                CatalogTable.name.asc(),
                CatalogTable.id.asc(),
            ).limit(limit + 1)
        elif sort_by == "row_count_asc":
            stmt = stmt.order_by(
                coalesced_rows.asc(),
                CatalogTable.name.asc(),
                CatalogTable.id.asc(),
            ).limit(limit + 1)
        else:  # name_asc
            stmt = stmt.order_by(
                CatalogTable.name.asc(),
                CatalogTable.id.asc(),
            ).limit(limit + 1)

        result = await session.execute(stmt)
        rows = result.all()

        has_next_page = len(rows) > limit
        selected_rows = rows[:limit] if has_next_page else rows

        table_ids = [row[0].id for row in selected_rows]

        # Batch load tags for these tables
        tags_by_table: Dict[uuid.UUID, List[Dict[str, Any]]] = {tid: [] for tid in table_ids}
        if table_ids:
            tag_stmt = (
                select(TagAssignment.entity_id, Tag.id, Tag.name, Tag.color)
                .join(Tag, Tag.id == TagAssignment.tag_id)
                .where(
                    TagAssignment.entity_type == EntityType.TABLE,
                    TagAssignment.entity_id.in_(table_ids),
                )
            )
            tag_res = await session.execute(tag_stmt)
            for eid, tid, tname, tcolor in tag_res.all():
                if eid in tags_by_table:
                    tags_by_table[eid].append({"id": tid, "name": tname, "color": tcolor})

        items: List[Dict[str, Any]] = []
        for row in selected_rows:
            tbl: CatalogTable = row[0]
            schema_name_val: str = row[1]
            db_name_val: str = row[2]
            rank_val: float = float(row[3]) if row[3] is not None else 0.0

            items.append(
                {
                    "id": tbl.id,
                    "entity_type": "TABLE",
                    "name": tbl.name,
                    "database_name": db_name_val,
                    "schema_name": schema_name_val,
                    "table_name": None,
                    "table_type": tbl.table_type.value,
                    "source_description": tbl.source_description,
                    "approved_description": tbl.approved_description,
                    "effective_description": tbl.effective_description,
                    "rank": round(rank_val, 4),
                    "classification_level": None,
                    "status": tbl.status.value,
                    "row_count_estimate": tbl.row_count_estimate,
                    "size_bytes": tbl.size_bytes,
                    "tags": tags_by_table.get(tbl.id, []),
                    "description_drift_detected": bool(tbl.description_drift_detected),
                }
            )

        next_cursor = None
        if has_next_page and selected_rows:
            last_table: CatalogTable = selected_rows[-1][0]
            next_cursor = encode_cursor(
                sort_val=last_table.name,
                row_id=last_table.id,
                name=last_table.name,
                row_count=last_table.row_count_estimate,
                sort_by=sort_by,
            )

        page_info = {
            "has_next_page": has_next_page,
            "next_cursor": next_cursor,
            "limit": limit,
        }

        return items, page_info

    async def list_tables_by_schema(
        self,
        session: AsyncSession,
        schema_id: uuid.UUID,
        user_ctx: UserContext,
        limit: int = 50,
        cursor: Optional[str] = None,
        missing_descriptions_only: bool = False,
    ) -> Tuple[List[Dict[str, Any]], Dict[str, Any]]:
        """
        Keyset-paginated listing of tables within a specific schema.
        Filtered directly in SQL using RBAC subqueries.
        """
        stmt: Select = (
            select(CatalogTable)
            .where(
                CatalogTable.schema_id == schema_id,
                CatalogTable.status != LifecycleStatus.DELETED,
            )
        )

        if missing_descriptions_only:
            stmt = stmt.where(
                or_(
                    CatalogTable.effective_description.is_(None),
                    CatalogTable.effective_description == "",
                )
            )

        rbac_filter = build_table_rbac_filter(user_ctx=user_ctx, action=PermissionAction.VIEW_METADATA)
        stmt = rbac_filter(stmt)

        if cursor:
            try:
                cursor_val, cursor_id = decode_cursor(cursor)
                stmt = stmt.where(
                    or_(
                        CatalogTable.name > cursor_val,
                        and_(CatalogTable.name == cursor_val, CatalogTable.id > cursor_id),
                    )
                )
            except Exception:
                pass

        stmt = stmt.order_by(CatalogTable.name.asc(), CatalogTable.id.asc()).limit(limit + 1)

        result = await session.execute(stmt)
        tables = result.scalars().all()

        has_next_page = len(tables) > limit
        selected_tables = tables[:limit] if has_next_page else tables

        table_ids = [t.id for t in selected_tables]
        tags_by_table: Dict[uuid.UUID, List[Dict[str, Any]]] = {tid: [] for tid in table_ids}
        if table_ids:
            tag_stmt = (
                select(TagAssignment.entity_id, Tag.id, Tag.name, Tag.color)
                .join(Tag, Tag.id == TagAssignment.tag_id)
                .where(
                    TagAssignment.entity_type == EntityType.TABLE,
                    TagAssignment.entity_id.in_(table_ids),
                )
            )
            tag_res = await session.execute(tag_stmt)
            for eid, tid, tname, tcolor in tag_res.all():
                if eid in tags_by_table:
                    tags_by_table[eid].append({"id": tid, "name": tname, "color": tcolor})

        items = [
            {
                "id": t.id,
                "schema_id": t.schema_id,
                "name": t.name,
                "table_type": t.table_type.value,
                "row_count_estimate": t.row_count_estimate,
                "size_bytes": t.size_bytes,
                "source_description": t.source_description,
                "approved_description": t.approved_description,
                "effective_description": t.effective_description,
                "ai_suggested_description": t.ai_suggested_description,
                "description_source": t.description_source,
                "curated_by_id": t.curated_by_id,
                "curated_by_username": t.curated_by_username,
                "curated_at": t.curated_at,
                "owner": t.owner,
                "status": t.status.value,
                "tags": tags_by_table.get(t.id, []),
                "description_drift_detected": bool(t.description_drift_detected),
            }
            for t in selected_tables
        ]

        next_cursor = None
        if has_next_page and selected_tables:
            last = selected_tables[-1]
            next_cursor = encode_cursor(last.name, last.id)

        page_info = {
            "has_next_page": has_next_page,
            "next_cursor": next_cursor,
            "limit": limit,
        }

        return items, page_info

    async def get_table_details(
        self,
        session: AsyncSession,
        table_id: uuid.UUID,
        user_ctx: UserContext,
    ) -> Optional[Dict[str, Any]]:
        """
        Retrieves table details including columns and active tags, verified against RBAC.
        Returns None if table does not exist or user lacks VIEW_METADATA permission.
        """
        stmt = (
            select(
                CatalogTable,
                DatabaseSchema.name.label("schema_name"),
                DatabaseConnection.database_name.label("database_name"),
                DatabaseConnection.collation.label("collation"),
            )
            .join(DatabaseSchema, DatabaseSchema.id == CatalogTable.schema_id)
            .join(DatabaseConnection, DatabaseConnection.id == DatabaseSchema.connection_id)
            .where(
                CatalogTable.id == table_id,
                CatalogTable.status != LifecycleStatus.DELETED,
            )
            .options(
                selectinload(CatalogTable.columns),
            )
        )

        rbac_filter = build_table_rbac_filter(user_ctx=user_ctx, action=PermissionAction.VIEW_METADATA)
        stmt = rbac_filter(stmt)

        result = await session.execute(stmt)
        row = result.first()
        if not row:
            return None

        tbl: CatalogTable = row[0]
        schema_name: str = row[1]
        database_name: str = row[2]
        database_collation: Optional[str] = row[3]

        # Fetch tags assigned to this table
        tag_stmt = (
            select(Tag)
            .join(TagAssignment, TagAssignment.tag_id == Tag.id)
            .where(
                TagAssignment.entity_type == EntityType.TABLE,
                TagAssignment.entity_id == table_id,
            )
        )
        tag_result = await session.execute(tag_stmt)
        table_tags = [
            {"id": tag.id, "name": tag.name, "color": tag.color, "description": tag.description}
            for tag in tag_result.scalars().all()
        ]

        # Fetch categories assigned to this table
        cat_stmt = (
            select(Category.name)
            .join(CategoryAssignment, CategoryAssignment.category_id == Category.id)
            .where(
                CategoryAssignment.entity_type == EntityType.TABLE,
                CategoryAssignment.entity_id == table_id,
            )
        )
        cat_result = await session.execute(cat_stmt)
        categories = list(cat_result.scalars().all())

        # Fetch tags for each column in this table
        col_ids = [col.id for col in tbl.columns if col.status != LifecycleStatus.DELETED]
        col_tags_map: Dict[uuid.UUID, List[Dict[str, Any]]] = {cid: [] for cid in col_ids}
        if col_ids:
            col_tag_stmt = (
                select(TagAssignment.entity_id, Tag.id, Tag.name, Tag.color)
                .join(Tag, Tag.id == TagAssignment.tag_id)
                .where(
                    TagAssignment.entity_type == EntityType.COLUMN,
                    TagAssignment.entity_id.in_(col_ids),
                )
            )
            col_tag_res = await session.execute(col_tag_stmt)
            for eid, tid, tname, tcolor in col_tag_res.all():
                if eid in col_tags_map:
                    col_tags_map[eid].append({"id": tid, "name": tname, "color": tcolor})

        columns_data = [
            {
                "id": col.id,
                "table_id": col.table_id,
                "name": col.name,
                "ordinal_position": col.ordinal_position,
                "data_type": col.data_type,
                "raw_data_type": col.raw_data_type,
                "collation": col.collation,
                "is_nullable": col.is_nullable,
                "is_primary_key": col.is_primary_key,
                "is_foreign_key": col.is_foreign_key,
                "default_value": col.default_value,
                "source_description": col.source_description,
                "approved_description": col.approved_description,
                "effective_description": col.effective_description,
                "ai_suggested_description": col.ai_suggested_description,
                "description_source": col.description_source,
                "curated_by_id": col.curated_by_id,
                "curated_by_username": col.curated_by_username,
                "curated_at": col.curated_at,
                "classification_level": col.classification_level.value,
                "status": col.status.value,
                "tags": col_tags_map.get(col.id, []),
            }
            for col in tbl.columns
            if col.status != LifecycleStatus.DELETED
        ]

        return {
            "id": tbl.id,
            "schema_id": tbl.schema_id,
            "schema_name": schema_name,
            "database_name": database_name,
            "name": tbl.name,
            "collation": database_collation,
            "table_type": tbl.table_type.value,
            "row_count_estimate": tbl.row_count_estimate,
            "size_bytes": tbl.size_bytes,
            "source_description": tbl.source_description,
            "approved_description": tbl.approved_description,
            "effective_description": tbl.effective_description,
            "ai_suggested_description": tbl.ai_suggested_description,
            "description_source": tbl.description_source,
            "curated_by_id": tbl.curated_by_id,
            "curated_by_username": tbl.curated_by_username,
            "curated_at": tbl.curated_at,
            "owner": tbl.owner,
            "status": tbl.status.value,
            "columns": columns_data,
            "tags": table_tags,
            "categories": categories,
            "custom_properties": tbl.custom_properties or {},
        }
