from __future__ import annotations

import logging
from typing import Any, Dict, List, Optional, Tuple
import uuid

from sqlalchemy import desc, func, select, text
from sqlalchemy.ext.asyncio import AsyncSession
from sqlalchemy.orm import selectinload

from backend.src.models.catalog import CatalogColumn, CatalogTable, LifecycleStatus
from backend.src.models.identity import User
from backend.src.models.versioning import SchemaChangeLog, SchemaChangeType, TableVersion

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)


class VersionService:
    """
    Enterprise Schema Snapshotting, Versioning, and Structural Diff Calculation Engine.
    Guarantees immutable historical snapshots, monotonic version incrementing,
    and granular column delta detection (added, dropped/removed, modified types).
    """

    async def create_snapshot(
        self, session: AsyncSession, table_id: uuid.UUID
    ) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """
        Generates a complete, deterministic JSONB snapshot of a catalog table and its
        currently active columns.
        """
        table_stmt = (
            select(CatalogTable)
            .where(CatalogTable.id == table_id)
            .execution_options(populate_existing=True)
        )
        table_result = await session.execute(table_stmt)
        table = table_result.scalar_one_or_none()
        if not table:
            raise ValueError(f"Table with ID {table_id} does not exist.")

        col_stmt = (
            select(CatalogColumn)
            .where(
                CatalogColumn.table_id == table_id,
                CatalogColumn.status != LifecycleStatus.DELETED,
            )
            .execution_options(populate_existing=True)
            .order_by(CatalogColumn.ordinal_position.asc())
        )
        col_result = await session.execute(col_stmt)
        columns = list(col_result.scalars().all())

        table_type_str = (
            table.table_type.value
            if hasattr(table.table_type, "value")
            else str(table.table_type)
        )
        status_str = (
            table.status.value
            if hasattr(table.status, "value")
            else str(table.status)
        )

        columns_data = []
        for col in columns:
            cls_level = (
                col.classification_level.value
                if hasattr(col.classification_level, "value")
                else str(col.classification_level)
            )
            col_status = (
                col.status.value
                if hasattr(col.status, "value")
                else str(col.status)
            )
            columns_data.append(
                {
                    "id": str(col.id),
                    "name": col.name,
                    "ordinal_position": col.ordinal_position,
                    "data_type": col.data_type,
                    "raw_data_type": col.raw_data_type,
                    "is_nullable": col.is_nullable,
                    "is_primary_key": col.is_primary_key,
                    "is_foreign_key": col.is_foreign_key,
                    "default_value": col.default_value,
                    "source_description": col.source_description,
                    "classification_level": cls_level,
                    "status": col_status,
                }
            )

        return {
            "table_id": str(table.id),
            "name": table.name,
            "table_type": table_type_str,
            "row_count_estimate": table.row_count_estimate,
            "size_bytes": table.size_bytes,
            "source_description": table.source_description,
            "owner": table.owner,
            "status": status_str,
            "columns": columns_data,
        }

    def compute_column_deltas(
        self, v1_snapshot: Dict[str, Any], v2_snapshot: Dict[str, Any]
    ) -> List[Dict[str, Any]]:
        """
        Computes granular structural column deltas between two snapshots.
        Detects COLUMN_ADDED, COLUMN_REMOVED, and TYPE_CHANGED.
        """
        v1_cols = {col["name"]: col for col in v1_snapshot.get("columns", [])}
        v2_cols = {col["name"]: col for col in v2_snapshot.get("columns", [])}

        deltas: List[Dict[str, Any]] = []

        # 1. Added columns (present in v2, absent in v1)
        for name, col in v2_cols.items():
            if name not in v1_cols:
                deltas.append(
                    {
                        "change_type": "COLUMN_ADDED",
                        "column_name": name,
                        "old_value": None,
                        "new_value": col,
                    }
                )

        # 2. Removed columns (present in v1, absent in v2)
        for name, col in v1_cols.items():
            if name not in v2_cols:
                deltas.append(
                    {
                        "change_type": "COLUMN_REMOVED",
                        "column_name": name,
                        "old_value": col,
                        "new_value": None,
                    }
                )

        # 3. Modified columns (present in both)
        for name, col1 in v1_cols.items():
            if name in v2_cols:
                col2 = v2_cols[name]
                # Check data type changes
                if (
                    col1.get("data_type") != col2.get("data_type")
                    or col1.get("raw_data_type") != col2.get("raw_data_type")
                ):
                    deltas.append(
                        {
                            "change_type": "TYPE_CHANGED",
                            "column_name": name,
                            "old_value": {
                                "data_type": col1.get("data_type"),
                                "raw_data_type": col1.get("raw_data_type"),
                            },
                            "new_value": {
                                "data_type": col2.get("data_type"),
                                "raw_data_type": col2.get("raw_data_type"),
                            },
                        }
                    )
                # Check nullability changes
                elif col1.get("is_nullable") != col2.get("is_nullable"):
                    deltas.append(
                        {
                            "change_type": "NULLABILITY_CHANGED",
                            "column_name": name,
                            "old_value": {"is_nullable": col1.get("is_nullable")},
                            "new_value": {"is_nullable": col2.get("is_nullable")},
                        }
                    )

        return deltas

    def compute_diff(
        self, v1_snapshot: Dict[str, Any], v2_snapshot: Dict[str, Any]
    ) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """
        Generates side-by-side comparison payload conforming to OpenAPI VersionDiffResponse.
        Categorizes differences into added_columns, removed_columns, and modified_columns.
        """
        v1_cols = {col["name"]: col for col in v1_snapshot.get("columns", [])}
        v2_cols = {col["name"]: col for col in v2_snapshot.get("columns", [])}

        added = [col for name, col in v2_cols.items() if name not in v1_cols]
        removed = [col for name, col in v1_cols.items() if name not in v2_cols]
        modified = []

        for name, col1 in v1_cols.items():
            if name in v2_cols:
                col2 = v2_cols[name]
                diffs_v1 = {}
                diffs_v2 = {}
                # Compare attributes
                for attr in [
                    "data_type",
                    "raw_data_type",
                    "is_nullable",
                    "is_primary_key",
                    "is_foreign_key",
                    "default_value",
                    "classification_level",
                ]:
                    if col1.get(attr) != col2.get(attr):
                        diffs_v1[attr] = col1.get(attr)
                        diffs_v2[attr] = col2.get(attr)

                if diffs_v1 or diffs_v2:
                    modified.append(
                        {
                            "column_name": name,
                            "v1_attributes": diffs_v1,
                            "v2_attributes": diffs_v2,
                        }
                    )

        return {
            "added_columns": added,
            "removed_columns": removed,
            "modified_columns": modified,
        }

    async def get_latest_version(
        self, session: AsyncSession, table_id: uuid.UUID
    ) -> Optional[TableVersion]:
        """Returns the most recent TableVersion record for a table."""
        stmt = (
            select(TableVersion)
            .where(TableVersion.table_id == table_id)
            .order_by(desc(TableVersion.version_num))
            .limit(1)
        )
        result = await session.execute(stmt)
        return result.scalar_one_or_none()

    async def capture_version(
        self,
        session: AsyncSession,
        table_id: uuid.UUID,
        actor_id: Optional[uuid.UUID] = None,
        actor_username: Optional[str] = None,
    ) -> TableVersion:
        """
        Unconditionally captures a new TableVersion snapshot, incrementing version_num
        and recording SchemaChangeLog records if a previous version existed.
        """
        latest = await self.get_latest_version(session, table_id)
        next_version_num = (latest.version_num + 1) if latest else 1

        snapshot = await self.create_snapshot(session, table_id)

        version = TableVersion(
            id=uuid.uuid4(),
            table_id=table_id,
            version_num=next_version_num,
            snapshot_jsonb=snapshot,
            created_by=actor_id,
        )
        session.add(version)
        await session.flush()

        # If previous version exists, log the schema changes
        if latest:
            deltas = self.compute_column_deltas(latest.snapshot_jsonb, snapshot)
            for delta in deltas:
                raw_type = delta["change_type"]
                enum_type = (
                    SchemaChangeType.COLUMN_DROPPED
                    if raw_type == "COLUMN_REMOVED"
                    else SchemaChangeType(raw_type)
                )
                log = SchemaChangeLog(
                    id=uuid.uuid4(),
                    table_id=table_id,
                    version_id=version.id,
                    change_type=enum_type,
                    column_name=delta["column_name"],
                    old_value=delta["old_value"],
                    new_value=delta["new_value"],
                    actor_id=actor_id,
                )
                session.add(log)
            await session.flush()

        return version

    async def capture_version_if_changed(
        self,
        session: AsyncSession,
        table_id: uuid.UUID,
        actor_id: Optional[uuid.UUID] = None,
        actor_username: Optional[str] = None,
    ) -> Optional[TableVersion]:
        """
        Captures a new TableVersion snapshot only if structural column differences exist
        compared to the latest recorded snapshot. If no changes exist, returns None.
        """
        latest = await self.get_latest_version(session, table_id)
        current_snapshot = await self.create_snapshot(session, table_id)

        if not latest:
            # First version
            version = TableVersion(
                id=uuid.uuid4(),
                table_id=table_id,
                version_num=1,
                snapshot_jsonb=current_snapshot,
                created_by=actor_id,
            )
            session.add(version)
            await session.flush()
            return version

        deltas = self.compute_column_deltas(
            latest.snapshot_jsonb, current_snapshot
        )
        if not deltas:
            # No structural schema changes
            return None

        next_version_num = latest.version_num + 1
        version = TableVersion(
            id=uuid.uuid4(),
            table_id=table_id,
            version_num=next_version_num,
            snapshot_jsonb=current_snapshot,
            created_by=actor_id,
        )
        session.add(version)
        await session.flush()

        for delta in deltas:
            raw_type = delta["change_type"]
            enum_type = (
                SchemaChangeType.COLUMN_DROPPED
                if raw_type == "COLUMN_REMOVED"
                else SchemaChangeType(raw_type)
            )
            log = SchemaChangeLog(
                id=uuid.uuid4(),
                table_id=table_id,
                version_id=version.id,
                change_type=enum_type,
                column_name=delta["column_name"],
                old_value=delta["old_value"],
                new_value=delta["new_value"],
                actor_id=actor_id,
            )
            session.add(log)

        await session.flush()
        return version

    async def capture_versions_batch(
        self,
        session: AsyncSession,
        table_ids: List[uuid.UUID],
        actor_id: Optional[uuid.UUID] = None,
        actor_username: Optional[str] = None,
    ) -> List[TableVersion]:
        """
        High-performance batch version capture for multiple tables.
        Executes exactly 3 bulk queries regardless of table count:
        1. Fetch latest version per table using DISTINCT ON.
        2. Fetch all tables.
        3. Fetch all active columns for all tables.
        Assembles snapshots in memory and persists newly created versions and deltas.
        """
        if not table_ids:
            return []

        # 1. Fetch latest versions for all tables in one query
        latest_versions_stmt = text("""
            SELECT DISTINCT ON (table_id) id, table_id, version_num, snapshot_jsonb
            FROM table_versions
            WHERE table_id = ANY(CAST(:table_ids AS uuid[]))
            ORDER BY table_id, version_num DESC;
        """)
        latest_res = await session.execute(latest_versions_stmt, {"table_ids": table_ids})
        latest_by_table: Dict[uuid.UUID, Any] = {}
        for row in latest_res.fetchall():
            latest_by_table[row[1]] = row

        # 2. Fetch all tables in one query
        tables_stmt = (
            select(CatalogTable)
            .where(CatalogTable.id.in_(table_ids))
            .execution_options(populate_existing=True)
        )
        tables_res = await session.execute(tables_stmt)
        tables_by_id = {t.id: t for t in tables_res.scalars().all()}

        # 3. Fetch all active columns for all tables in one query
        cols_stmt = (
            select(CatalogColumn)
            .where(
                CatalogColumn.table_id.in_(table_ids),
                CatalogColumn.status != LifecycleStatus.DELETED,
            )
            .execution_options(populate_existing=True)
            .order_by(CatalogColumn.table_id, CatalogColumn.ordinal_position.asc())
        )
        cols_res = await session.execute(cols_stmt)
        cols_by_table: Dict[uuid.UUID, List[CatalogColumn]] = {t_id: [] for t_id in table_ids}
        for col in cols_res.scalars().all():
            if col.table_id in cols_by_table:
                cols_by_table[col.table_id].append(col)

        # 4. Process each table in memory
        versions_created: List[TableVersion] = []
        logs_created: List[SchemaChangeLog] = []

        for tbl_id in table_ids:
            table = tables_by_id.get(tbl_id)
            if not table:
                continue

            columns = cols_by_table.get(tbl_id, [])
            table_type_str = (
                table.table_type.value
                if hasattr(table.table_type, "value")
                else str(table.table_type)
            )
            status_str = (
                table.status.value
                if hasattr(table.status, "value")
                else str(table.status)
            )

            columns_data = []
            for col in columns:
                cls_level = (
                    col.classification_level.value
                    if hasattr(col.classification_level, "value")
                    else str(col.classification_level)
                )
                col_status = (
                    col.status.value
                    if hasattr(col.status, "value")
                    else str(col.status)
                )
                columns_data.append(
                    {
                        "id": str(col.id),
                        "name": col.name,
                        "ordinal_position": col.ordinal_position,
                        "data_type": col.data_type,
                        "raw_data_type": col.raw_data_type,
                        "collation": col.collation,
                        "is_nullable": col.is_nullable,
                        "is_primary_key": col.is_primary_key,
                        "is_foreign_key": col.is_foreign_key,
                        "default_value": col.default_value,
                        "source_description": col.source_description,
                        "classification_level": cls_level,
                        "status": col_status,
                    }
                )

            current_snapshot = {
                "table_id": str(table.id),
                "name": table.name,
                "table_type": table_type_str,
                "row_count_estimate": table.row_count_estimate,
                "size_bytes": table.size_bytes,
                "source_description": table.source_description,
                "owner": table.owner,
                "status": status_str,
                "columns": columns_data,
            }

            latest_row = latest_by_table.get(tbl_id)
            if not latest_row:
                new_version = TableVersion(
                    id=uuid.uuid4(),
                    table_id=tbl_id,
                    version_num=1,
                    snapshot_jsonb=current_snapshot,
                    created_by=actor_id,
                )
                versions_created.append(new_version)
            else:
                latest_v_num = latest_row[2]
                latest_snapshot = latest_row[3]
                deltas = self.compute_column_deltas(latest_snapshot, current_snapshot)
                if not deltas:
                    continue

                new_version = TableVersion(
                    id=uuid.uuid4(),
                    table_id=tbl_id,
                    version_num=latest_v_num + 1,
                    snapshot_jsonb=current_snapshot,
                    created_by=actor_id,
                )
                versions_created.append(new_version)

                for delta in deltas:
                    raw_type = delta["change_type"]
                    enum_type = (
                        SchemaChangeType.COLUMN_DROPPED
                        if raw_type == "COLUMN_REMOVED"
                        else SchemaChangeType(raw_type)
                    )
                    log = SchemaChangeLog(
                        id=uuid.uuid4(),
                        table_id=tbl_id,
                        version_id=new_version.id,
                        change_type=enum_type,
                        column_name=delta["column_name"],
                        old_value=delta["old_value"],
                        new_value=delta["new_value"],
                        actor_id=actor_id,
                    )
                    logs_created.append(log)

        if versions_created:
            session.add_all(versions_created)
        if logs_created:
            session.add_all(logs_created)
        await session.flush()

        return versions_created

    async def get_versions(
        self, session: AsyncSession, table_id: uuid.UUID
    ) -> List[TableVersion]:
        """Returns all historical version snapshots for a table ordered by version_num."""
        stmt = (
            select(TableVersion)
            .options(selectinload(TableVersion.creator))
            .where(TableVersion.table_id == table_id)
            .order_by(TableVersion.version_num.asc())
        )
        result = await session.execute(stmt)
        return list(result.scalars().all())

    async def compare_versions(
        self,
        session: AsyncSession,
        table_id: uuid.UUID,
        v1_num: int,
        v2_num: int,
    ) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """
        Compares two specific schema snapshot versions of a table side-by-side.
        Raises ValueError if the table or requested version numbers are not found.
        """
        stmt_tbl = select(CatalogTable).where(CatalogTable.id == table_id)
        tbl_res = await session.execute(stmt_tbl)
        if not tbl_res.scalar_one_or_none():
            raise ValueError(f"Table {table_id} not found.")

        stmt = select(TableVersion).where(
            TableVersion.table_id == table_id,
            TableVersion.version_num.in_([v1_num, v2_num]),
        )
        result = await session.execute(stmt)
        versions_by_num = {v.version_num: v for v in result.scalars().all()}

        if v1_num not in versions_by_num:
            raise ValueError(f"Version {v1_num} not found for table {table_id}.")
        if v2_num not in versions_by_num:
            raise ValueError(f"Version {v2_num} not found for table {table_id}.")

        v1 = versions_by_num[v1_num]
        v2 = versions_by_num[v2_num]

        diff_payload = self.compute_diff(v1.snapshot_jsonb, v2.snapshot_jsonb)
        return {
            "table_id": table_id,
            "v1_num": v1_num,
            "v2_num": v2_num,
            "added_columns": diff_payload["added_columns"],
            "removed_columns": diff_payload["removed_columns"],
            "modified_columns": diff_payload["modified_columns"],
        }

    async def get_table_change_logs(
        self, session: AsyncSession, table_id: uuid.UUID
    ) -> List[SchemaChangeLog]:
        """Returns all recorded schema change log entries for a table."""
        stmt = (
            select(SchemaChangeLog)
            .where(SchemaChangeLog.table_id == table_id)
            .order_by(SchemaChangeLog.created_at.desc())
        )
        result = await session.execute(stmt)
        return list(result.scalars().all())

def mask_credentials(credentials: Dict[str, Any]) -> Dict[str, str]:
    """Replaces secret values with asterisks to prevent credential leakage."""
    masked: Dict[str, str] = {}
    for key, value in credentials.items():
        lower_k = key.lower()
        if any(secret_term in lower_k for secret_term in ["pass", "secret", "key", "token", "cert", "credential"]):
            masked[key] = "********"
        else:
            masked[key] = str(value)
    return masked


class ConnectionService:
    """
    Enterprise Database Connection Registry Service.

    - Protects database secrets via AES-256-GCM Envelope Encryption (unique DEK per connection).
    - Enforces 5-part cron syntax validation on sync schedules.
    - Atomically emits immutable AuditLog records in PostgreSQL.
    - Decrypts credentials strictly transiently in memory during connection test pings.
    """

    def __init__(self, crypto_service: Optional[EnvelopeEncryptionService] = None) -> None:
        self.crypto = crypto_service or EnvelopeEncryptionService()

    def serialize_response(
        self,
        connection: DatabaseConnection,
        category_id: Optional[uuid.UUID] = None,
        category_name: Optional[str] = None,
    ) -> ConnectionResponse:
        """Converts DatabaseConnection ORM entity into ConnectionResponse with masked credentials."""
        # Decrypt transiently in memory to extract keys and mask secret values
        try:
            creds = self.crypto.decrypt_credentials(
                bytes(connection.encrypted_dek), bytes(connection.encrypted_credentials)
            )
            masked = mask_credentials(creds)
        except Exception:
            masked = {"credentials": "â€¢â€¢â€¢â€¢â€¢â€¢â€¢â€¢"}

        sync_resp = None
        if "sync_schedule" in connection.__dict__ and connection.sync_schedule is not None:
            sync_resp = SyncScheduleResponse.model_validate(connection.sync_schedule)

        eff_cat_id = category_id if category_id is not None else getattr(connection, "_category_id", None)
        eff_cat_name = category_name if category_name is not None else getattr(connection, "_category_name", None)

        return ConnectionResponse(
            id=connection.id,
            name=connection.name,
            engine_type=connection.engine_type,
            host=connection.host,
            port=connection.port,
            database_name=connection.database_name,
            default_schema=connection.default_schema,
            collation=connection.collation,
            owner=connection.owner,
            is_active=connection.is_active,
            category_id=eff_cat_id,
            category_name=eff_cat_name,
            custom_params=connection.custom_params or {},
            masked_credentials=masked,
            sync_schedule=sync_resp,
            created_at=connection.created_at,
            updated_at=connection.updated_at,
        )

    async def create_connection(
        self,
        session: AsyncSession,
        request: ConnectionCreateRequest,
        actor_username: str,
        actor_id: Optional[uuid.UUID] = None,
    ) -> DatabaseConnection:
        """
        Registers a new database connection with envelope-encrypted credentials and audit logging.
        """
        # 1. Validate cron expression if provided
        if request.cron_expression:
            validate_cron_expression(request.cron_expression)

        # 2. Encrypt credentials with unique ephemeral DEK
        enc_dek, enc_creds = self.crypto.encrypt_credentials(request.credentials)

        connection_id = uuid.uuid4()
        connection = DatabaseConnection(
            id=connection_id,
            name=request.name,
            engine_type=request.engine_type,
            host=request.host,
            port=request.port,
            database_name=request.database_name,
            default_schema=request.default_schema,
            owner=request.owner or actor_username,
            kek_version=1,
            encrypted_dek=enc_dek,
            encrypted_credentials=enc_creds,
            custom_params=request.custom_params or {},
            is_active=True,
        )
        session.add(connection)

        # 3. Create SyncSchedule if requested
        if request.cron_expression:
            schedule = SyncSchedule(
                id=uuid.uuid4(),
                connection_id=connection_id,
                cron_expression=request.cron_expression.strip(),
                is_enabled=True,
            )
            session.add(schedule)
            connection.sync_schedule = schedule
        else:
            connection.sync_schedule = None

        # 4. Handle Category Assignment (enforce leaf category)
        cat_name: Optional[str] = None
        if request.category_id:
            cat = await session.get(Category, request.category_id)
            if not cat:
                raise ValueError("ط¯ط³طھظ‡â€Œط¨ظ†ط¯غŒ / ظ…ظˆط¶ظˆط¹ ط§ظ†طھط®ط§ط¨â€Œط´ط¯ظ‡ غŒط§ظپطھ ظ†ط´ط¯.")
            child_count_stmt = select(func.count(Category.id)).where(Category.parent_id == request.category_id)
            child_count = (await session.execute(child_count_stmt)).scalar() or 0
            if child_count > 0:
                raise ValueError("ظپظ‚ط· ط¨ط±ع¯â€Œظ‡ط§غŒ ط¯ط±ط®طھ ظ…ظˆط¶ظˆط¹ط§طھ (ط¯ط³طھظ‡â€Œط¨ظ†ط¯غŒâ€Œظ‡ط§غŒ ط¨ط¯ظˆظ† ط²غŒط±ظ…ط¬ظ…ظˆط¹ظ‡) ظ‚ط§ط¨ظ„ ط§ظ†طھط³ط§ط¨ ط¨ظ‡ ظ¾ط§غŒع¯ط§ظ‡â€Œط¯ط§ط¯ظ‡ ظ‡ط³طھظ†ط¯.")
            assignment = CategoryAssignment(
                id=uuid.uuid4(),
                category_id=request.category_id,
                entity_type=EntityType.DATABASE,
                entity_id=connection_id,
            )
            session.add(assignment)
            cat_name = cat.name

        connection._category_id = request.category_id
        connection._category_name = cat_name

        await session.flush()

        # 5. Record immutable audit log entry in the same transaction
        await record_audit_event(
            session=session,
            actor_username=actor_username,
            actor_id=actor_id,
            action="CREATE_CONNECTION",
            entity_type=EntityType.DATABASE,
            entity_id=connection_id,
            diff_jsonb={
                "name": connection.name,
                "engine_type": connection.engine_type.value,
                "host": connection.host,
                "port": connection.port,
                "database_name": connection.database_name,
                "has_schedule": request.cron_expression is not None,
                "category_id": str(request.category_id) if request.category_id else None,
            },
            flush=True,
        )

        return connection

    async def get_connection(
        self, session: AsyncSession, connection_id: uuid.UUID
    ) -> Optional[DatabaseConnection]:
        """Retrieves connection by ID including sync_schedule and category assignment."""
        stmt = (
            select(DatabaseConnection)
            .where(DatabaseConnection.id == connection_id)
            .options(selectinload(DatabaseConnection.sync_schedule))
        )
        result = await session.execute(stmt)
        conn = result.scalar_one_or_none()
        if conn is not None:
            assign_stmt = (
                select(CategoryAssignment.category_id, Category.name)
                .join(Category, Category.id == CategoryAssignment.category_id)
                .where(
                    CategoryAssignment.entity_id == connection_id,
                    CategoryAssignment.entity_type == EntityType.DATABASE,
                )
            )
            assign_res = await session.execute(assign_stmt)
            row = assign_res.first()
            if row is not None:
                conn._category_id = row[0]
                conn._category_name = row[1]
            else:
                conn._category_id = None
                conn._category_name = None
        return conn

    async def list_connections(
        self,
        session: AsyncSession,
        is_active: Optional[bool] = None,
        search: Optional[str] = None,
        engine_type: Optional[Any] = None,
        host: Optional[str] = None,
        owner: Optional[str] = None,
    ) -> List[DatabaseConnection]:
        """Lists registered database connections with their assigned leaf category and optional search/filter criteria."""
        stmt = select(DatabaseConnection).options(
            selectinload(DatabaseConnection.sync_schedule)
        )
        if is_active is not None:
            stmt = stmt.where(DatabaseConnection.is_active == is_active)
        if engine_type is not None:
            stmt = stmt.where(DatabaseConnection.engine_type == engine_type)
        if host is not None and host.strip():
            stmt = stmt.where(DatabaseConnection.host.ilike(f"%{host.strip()}%"))
        if owner is not None and owner.strip():
            stmt = stmt.where(DatabaseConnection.owner.ilike(f"%{owner.strip()}%"))
        if search is not None and search.strip():
            term = f"%{search.strip()}%"
            stmt = stmt.where(
                or_(
                    DatabaseConnection.name.ilike(term),
                    DatabaseConnection.database_name.ilike(term),
                    DatabaseConnection.host.ilike(term),
                    DatabaseConnection.owner.ilike(term),
                )
            )
        stmt = stmt.order_by(DatabaseConnection.name.asc())
        result = await session.execute(stmt)
        connections = list(result.scalars().all())

        # Load category assignments for all connections
        assign_stmt = (
            select(
                CategoryAssignment.entity_id,
                CategoryAssignment.category_id,
                Category.name,
            )
            .join(Category, Category.id == CategoryAssignment.category_id)
            .where(CategoryAssignment.entity_type == EntityType.DATABASE)
        )
        assign_res = await session.execute(assign_stmt)
        cat_map = {row[0]: (row[1], row[2]) for row in assign_res.all()}

        for c in connections:
            if c.id in cat_map:
                c._category_id, c._category_name = cat_map[c.id]
            else:
                c._category_id, c._category_name = None, None

        return connections

    async def test_connection(
        self, session: AsyncSession, connection_id: uuid.UUID
    ) -> Optional[PingResult]:
        """
        Executes a transient dialect ping test for a registered connection.
        Decrypts credentials in memory solely for the duration of the probe.
        """
        connection = await self.get_connection(session, connection_id)
        if connection is None:
            return None

        # Decrypt credentials transiently
        decrypted_creds = self.crypto.decrypt_credentials(
            bytes(connection.encrypted_dek), bytes(connection.encrypted_credentials)
        )

        # Probe dialect connectivity
        return await ping_service.ping(
            engine_type=connection.engine_type,
            host=connection.host,
            port=connection.port,
            database_name=connection.database_name,
            credentials=decrypted_creds,
            custom_params=connection.custom_params or {},
        )

from __future__ import annotations

import asyncio
import logging
import time
from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from typing import Any, Dict, Optional

import asyncpg

from backend.src.models.connections import DatabaseEngine

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)


@dataclass
class PingResult:
    """Structured diagnostic and latency result of a live connection test."""

    success: bool
    latency_ms: float
    dialect: DatabaseEngine
    message: str
    diagnostic_details: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = field(default_factory=dict)
    tested_at: datetime = field(default_factory=lambda: datetime.now(timezone.utc))


class PingService:
    """
    Lightweight asynchronous database dialect ping service.

    Supported dialects:
    - POSTGRESQL: Direct asyncpg protocol handshake executing 'SELECT 1'.
    - MSSQL / MYSQL / ORACLE / CLICKHOUSE: High-performance async socket/driver probe.

    All probes are strictly bounded by asyncio.wait_for with a 5.0-second timeout ceiling.
    Zero unhandled exceptions: all network, credential, or protocol failures return structured diagnostics.
    """

    DEFAULT_TIMEOUT: float = 5.0

    async def ping(
        self,
        engine_type: DatabaseEngine,
        host: str,
        port: int,
        database_name: str,
        credentials: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None,
        custom_params: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None,
        timeout_seconds: float = DEFAULT_TIMEOUT,
    ) -> PingResult:
        """
        Executes a dialect-specific connectivity test within the specified timeout.
        """
        start_time = time.monotonic()
        credentials = credentials or {}
        custom_params = custom_params or {}

        try:
            # Enforce strict 5.0-second timeout ceiling
            return await asyncio.wait_for(
                self._dispatch_dialect_ping(
                    engine_type=engine_type,
                    host=host,
                    port=port,
                    database_name=database_name,
                    credentials=credentials,
                    custom_params=custom_params,
                    start_time=start_time,
                ),
                timeout=timeout_seconds,
            )
        except asyncio.TimeoutError:
            elapsed_ms = round((time.monotonic() - start_time) * 1000, 2)
            logger.warning(
                "Connection test timed out after %.2fms for %s at %s:%s",
                elapsed_ms,
                engine_type.value,
                host,
                port,
            )
            return PingResult(
                success=False,
                latency_ms=elapsed_ms,
                dialect=engine_type,
                message=f"Connection timed out after {timeout_seconds:.1f}s to {host}:{port}",
                diagnostic_details={
                    "error_type": "TimeoutError",
                    "host": host,
                    "port": port,
                    "database_name": database_name,
                    "error": f"Dialect ping exceeded strict {timeout_seconds:.1f}s timeout ceiling.",
                },
                tested_at=datetime.now(timezone.utc),
            )
        except Exception as exc:
            elapsed_ms = round((time.monotonic() - start_time) * 1000, 2)
            logger.error(
                "Unexpected failure testing %s at %s:%s: %s",
                engine_type.value,
                host,
                port,
                exc,
                exc_info=True,
            )
            return PingResult(
                success=False,
                latency_ms=elapsed_ms,
                dialect=engine_type,
                message=f"Connection test error: {str(exc)}",
                diagnostic_details={
                    "error_type": type(exc).__name__,
                    "host": host,
                    "port": port,
                    "database_name": database_name,
                    "error": str(exc),
                },
                tested_at=datetime.now(timezone.utc),
            )

    async def _dispatch_dialect_ping(
        self,
        engine_type: DatabaseEngine,
        host: str,
        port: int,
        database_name: str,
        credentials: Dict[str, Any],
        custom_params: Dict[str, Any],
        start_time: float,
    ) -> PingResult:
        if engine_type == DatabaseEngine.POSTGRESQL:
            return await self._ping_postgresql(
                host=host,
                port=port,
                database_name=database_name,
                credentials=credentials,
                custom_params=custom_params,
                start_time=start_time,
            )
        else:
            return await self._ping_socket_probe(
                engine_type=engine_type,
                host=host,
                port=port,
                database_name=database_name,
                start_time=start_time,
            )

    async def _ping_postgresql(
        self,
        host: str,
        port: int,
        database_name: str,
        credentials: Dict[str, Any],
        custom_params: Dict[str, Any],
        start_time: float,
    ) -> PingResult:
        username = credentials.get("username")
        password = credentials.get("password")
        ssl = custom_params.get("ssl", False)
        if custom_params.get("sslmode") == "require":
            ssl = True

        try:
            conn = await asyncpg.connect(
                host=host,
                port=port,
                user=username,
                password=password,
                database=database_name,
                ssl=ssl,
                timeout=4.5,
            )
            try:
                res = await conn.fetchval("SELECT 1")
                elapsed_ms = round((time.monotonic() - start_time) * 1000, 2)
                return PingResult(
                    success=True,
                    latency_ms=elapsed_ms,
                    dialect=DatabaseEngine.POSTGRESQL,
                    message="Connection successful (SELECT 1 executed)",
                    diagnostic_details={
                        "query": "SELECT 1",
                        "server_version": str(conn.get_server_version()),
                    },
                    tested_at=datetime.now(timezone.utc),
                )
            finally:
                await conn.close()
        except Exception as exc:
            elapsed_ms = round((time.monotonic() - start_time) * 1000, 2)
            return PingResult(
                success=False,
                latency_ms=elapsed_ms,
                dialect=DatabaseEngine.POSTGRESQL,
                message=f"PostgreSQL connection failed: {str(exc)}",
                diagnostic_details={
                    "error_type": type(exc).__name__,
                    "host": host,
                    "port": port,
                    "database_name": database_name,
                    "error": str(exc),
                },
                tested_at=datetime.now(timezone.utc),
            )

    async def _ping_socket_probe(
        self,
        engine_type: DatabaseEngine,
        host: str,
        port: int,
        database_name: str,
        start_time: float,
    ) -> PingResult:
        try:
            reader, writer = await asyncio.open_connection(host=host, port=port)
            writer.close()
            await writer.wait_closed()
            elapsed_ms = round((time.monotonic() - start_time) * 1000, 2)
            return PingResult(
                success=True,
                latency_ms=elapsed_ms,
                dialect=engine_type,
                message=f"Socket probe to {engine_type.value} service succeeded",
                diagnostic_details={
                    "probe_type": "TCP_SOCKET_PROBE",
                    "host": host,
                    "port": port,
                    "database_name": database_name,
                },
                tested_at=datetime.now(timezone.utc),
            )
        except Exception as exc:
            elapsed_ms = round((time.monotonic() - start_time) * 1000, 2)
            return PingResult(
                success=False,
                latency_ms=elapsed_ms,
                dialect=engine_type,
                message=f"{engine_type.value} probe failed: {str(exc)}",
                diagnostic_details={
                    "error_type": type(exc).__name__,
                    "host": host,
                    "port": port,
                    "database_name": database_name,
                    "error": str(exc),
                },
                tested_at=datetime.now(timezone.utc),
            )


ping_service = PingService()

class BaseMetadataConnector(ABC):
    """
    Abstract base class for all metadata connectors.

    Enforces:
    - Ephemeral connection lifecycle using NullPool (0 residual idle connections).
    - Session-level query timeout and read-only protections:
        SET statement_timeout = 30000;
        SET idle_in_transaction_session_timeout = 10000;
        SET SESSION CHARACTERISTICS AS TRANSACTION READ ONLY;
    - Standardized metadata extraction contract.
    """

    STATEMENT_TIMEOUT_MS: int = 30000
    IDLE_TIMEOUT_MS: int = 10000

    def __init__(self, connection_config: Dict[str, Any]) -> None:
        self.config: Dict[str, Any] = connection_config
        self._is_closed: bool = False

    @property
    def is_closed(self) -> bool:
        return self._is_closed

    def get_pool_class(self) -> Type[Pool]:
        """Returns NullPool to guarantee zero residual pooled connections."""
        return NullPool

    def get_session_setup_statements(self) -> List[str]:
        """SQL statements to execute upon acquiring a session to enforce security & timeouts."""
        return [
            f"SET statement_timeout = {self.STATEMENT_TIMEOUT_MS};",
            f"SET idle_in_transaction_session_timeout = {self.IDLE_TIMEOUT_MS};",
            "SET SESSION CHARACTERISTICS AS TRANSACTION READ ONLY;",
        ]

    @abstractmethod
    async def __aenter__(self) -> "BaseMetadataConnector":
        """Establishes ephemeral connection using NullPool with strict timeouts."""
        self._is_closed = False
        return self

    @abstractmethod
    async def __aexit__(self, exc_type, exc_val, exc_tb) -> None:
        """Immediately disconnects and releases TCP socket."""
        self._is_closed = True

    @abstractmethod
    async def test_connection(self) -> ConnectionTestResult:
        """Executes lightweight ping, validating auth, SSL, and read-only mode."""
        pass

    @abstractmethod
    async def extract_schemas(self) -> List[SchemaMetadata]:
        """Lists accessible schemas excluding system/internal schemas."""
        pass

    async def extract_database_collation(self) -> Optional[str]:
        """Extracts default database collation if supported by the engine."""
        return None

    async def discover_databases(self) -> List[str]:
        """Lists accessible non-system databases for this engine."""
        return []

    @classmethod
    async def discover_databases_from_config(cls, config: Dict[str, Any]) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """Classmethod helper to execute discover_databases with a 5.0s timeout."""
        start_time = time.monotonic()
        connector = cls(config)
        try:
            return await asyncio.wait_for(connector._run_database_discovery(start_time), timeout=5.0)
        except asyncio.TimeoutError:
            elapsed_ms = round((time.monotonic() - start_time) * 1000, 2)
            return {
                "success": False,
                "databases": [],
                "latency_ms": elapsed_ms,
                "server_version": None,
                "message": "Database discovery probe timed out after 5.0 seconds.",
            }
        except Exception as exc:
            elapsed_ms = round((time.monotonic() - start_time) * 1000, 2)
            return {
                "success": False,
                "databases": [],
                "latency_ms": elapsed_ms,
                "server_version": None,
                "message": f"Database discovery failed: {str(exc)}",
            }

    async def _run_database_discovery(self, start_time: float) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """Default discovery runner implementation."""
        async with self:
            dbs = await self.discover_databases()
            test_res = await self.test_connection()
            elapsed_ms = round((time.monotonic() - start_time) * 1000, 2)
            return {
                "success": True,
                "databases": dbs,
                "latency_ms": elapsed_ms,
                "server_version": test_res.server_version,
                "message": f"Successfully discovered {len(dbs)} databases.",
            }

    @abstractmethod
    async def extract_schema_metadata(self, schema_name: str) -> SchemaExtractionResult:
        """Bulk extracts tables, columns, constraints, and statistics for a single schema."""
        pass

    async def extract_all_schemas(self) -> List[SchemaExtractionResult]:
        """
        Iterates across all discoverable schemas with schema-level partial failure isolation.
        Captures exceptions per schema without failing remaining schemas.
        """
        schemas = await self.extract_schemas()
        results: List[SchemaExtractionResult] = []

        for schema_meta in schemas:
            try:
                extraction = await self.extract_schema_metadata(schema_meta.name)
                results.append(extraction)
            except Exception as exc:
                pgcode = getattr(exc, "pgcode", None) or getattr(exc, "sqlstate", None) or "EXTRACTION_ERROR"
                logger.error(
                    "Schema extraction failed for schema '%s' with code %s: %s",
                    schema_meta.name,
                    pgcode,
                    exc,
                    exc_info=True,
                )
                results.append(
                    SchemaExtractionResult(
                        schema=schema_meta,
                        tables=[],
                        columns=[],
                        foreign_keys=[],
                        statistics=[],
                        success=False,
                        error_message=str(exc),
                        error_code=str(pgcode),
                    )
                )

        return results

from __future__ import annotations

import asyncio
import logging
import time
from typing import Any, Dict, List, Optional

import httpx

from backend.src.models.connections import DatabaseEngine
from backend.src.services.connectors.base import (
    BaseMetadataConnector,
    ColumnMetadata,
    ConnectionTestResult,
    ForeignKeyMetadata,
    IndexMetadata,
    RoutineMetadata,
    SchemaExtractionResult,
    SchemaMetadata,
    TableMetadata,
    TableStatisticsMetadata,
)
from backend.src.services.connectors.registry import default_connector_registry

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)


class ClickHouseConnector(BaseMetadataConnector):
    """
    Enterprise ClickHouse columnar metadata connector.

    Communicates directly via ClickHouse's high-performance native HTTP JSON interface (port 8123)
    using httpx, with optional clickhouse-connect support. Enforces strict 5.0-second timeouts.
    """

    STATEMENT_TIMEOUT_MS: int = 30000

    def __init__(self, connection_config: Dict[str, Any]) -> None:
        super().__init__(connection_config)
        self._http_client: Optional[httpx.AsyncClient] = None

    def _get_base_url(self) -> str:
        host = self.config.get("host", "127.0.0.1")
        port = int(self.config.get("port", 8123))
        protocol = "https" if self.config.get("ssl") else "http"
        return f"{protocol}://{host}:{port}"

    def _get_auth(self) -> Optional[httpx.BasicAuth]:
        username = self.config.get("username") or self.config.get("user", "default")
        password = self.config.get("password", "")
        return httpx.BasicAuth(username, password)

    async def _query_json(self, sql: str) -> List[Dict[str, Any]]:
        """Executes a SQL query against ClickHouse HTTP interface with JSON output."""
        base_url = self._get_base_url()
        auth = self._get_auth()
        client = self._http_client or httpx.AsyncClient(timeout=10.0)
        should_close = self._http_client is None

        try:
            formatted_sql = f"{sql.strip().rstrip(';')} FORMAT JSON"
            resp = await client.post(
                base_url,
                content=formatted_sql.encode("utf-8"),
                auth=auth,
                headers={"Content-Type": "text/plain"},
            )
            if resp.status_code != 200:
                raise RuntimeError(f"ClickHouse query error ({resp.status_code}): {resp.text.strip()}")
            payload = resp.json()
            return payload.get("data", [])
        finally:
            if should_close:
                await client.aclose()

    async def __aenter__(self) -> "ClickHouseConnector":
        self._is_closed = False
        if self._http_client is None:
            self._http_client = httpx.AsyncClient(timeout=10.0)
        return self

    async def __aexit__(self, exc_type: Any, exc_val: Any, exc_tb: Any) -> None:
        if self._http_client is not None:
            await self._http_client.aclose()
            self._http_client = None
        self._is_closed = True

    async def test_connection(self) -> ConnectionTestResult:
        """5s timeout ping returning SELECT version()."""
        start_time = time.monotonic()
        try:
            return await asyncio.wait_for(self._run_connection_test(start_time), timeout=5.0)
        except asyncio.TimeoutError:
            elapsed_ms = round((time.monotonic() - start_time) * 1000, 2)
            return ConnectionTestResult(
                success=False,
                latency_ms=elapsed_ms,
                dialect="CLICKHOUSE",
                server_version=None,
                message="Connection probe timed out after 5.0 seconds.",
                diagnostic_details={"error_type": "TimeoutError", "timeout_seconds": 5.0},
            )
        except Exception as exc:
            elapsed_ms = round((time.monotonic() - start_time) * 1000, 2)
            return ConnectionTestResult(
                success=False,
                latency_ms=elapsed_ms,
                dialect="CLICKHOUSE",
                server_version=None,
                message=str(exc),
                diagnostic_details={"error_type": type(exc).__name__, "error": str(exc)},
            )

    async def _run_connection_test(self, start_time: float) -> ConnectionTestResult:
        rows = await self._query_json("SELECT version() AS ver, currentDatabase() AS current_db")
        server_ver = rows[0].get("ver") if rows else None
        current_db = rows[0].get("current_db") if rows else ""
        elapsed_ms = round((time.monotonic() - start_time) * 1000, 2)

        return ConnectionTestResult(
            success=True,
            latency_ms=elapsed_ms,
            dialect="CLICKHOUSE",
            server_version=server_ver,
            message=f"Successfully connected to ClickHouse database '{current_db}'.",
            diagnostic_details={
                "version_string": server_ver or "",
                "current_database": current_db,
                "session_read_only": True,
                "tcp_reachable": True,
                "auth_valid": True,
            },
        )

    async def discover_databases(self) -> List[str]:
        """Query SELECT name FROM system.databases excluding internal databases."""
        sql = """
            SELECT name 
            FROM system.databases 
            WHERE name NOT IN ('system', 'INFORMATION_SCHEMA', 'information_schema')
            ORDER BY name
        """
        rows = await self._query_json(sql)
        return [r["name"] for r in rows if "name" in r]

    async def _run_database_discovery(self, start_time: float) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        server_ver = None
        try:
            ver_rows = await self._query_json("SELECT version() AS ver")
            if ver_rows:
                server_ver = ver_rows[0].get("ver")
        except Exception:
            pass

        databases = await self.discover_databases()
        elapsed_ms = round((time.monotonic() - start_time) * 1000, 2)
        return {
            "success": True,
            "databases": databases,
            "latency_ms": elapsed_ms,
            "server_version": server_ver,
            "message": f"Successfully discovered {len(databases)} ClickHouse databases.",
        }

    async def extract_schemas(self) -> List[SchemaMetadata]:
        """Lists discoverable non-system databases."""
        dbs = await self.discover_databases()
        return [SchemaMetadata(name=name) for name in dbs]

    async def extract_schema_metadata(self, schema_name: str) -> SchemaExtractionResult:
        """Extracts ClickHouse tables, columns, statistics, and sorting keys."""
        safe_schema = schema_name.replace("'", "''")

        # 1. Tables & statistics
        tbl_sql = f"""
            SELECT 
                name,
                engine,
                total_rows,
                total_bytes,
                comment
            FROM system.tables
            WHERE database = '{safe_schema}'
            ORDER BY name
        """
        tbl_rows = await self._query_json(tbl_sql)

        tables: List[TableMetadata] = []
        statistics: List[TableStatisticsMetadata] = []
        for r in tbl_rows:
            table_name = r["name"]
            is_view = "View" in r.get("engine", "")
            table_type = "VIEW" if is_view else "TABLE"
            row_count = int(r.get("total_rows") or 0)
            size_bytes = int(r.get("total_bytes") or 0)
            comment = r.get("comment") or None

            tables.append(
                TableMetadata(
                    schema_name=schema_name,
                    name=table_name,
                    table_type=table_type,
                    row_count_estimate=row_count,
                    size_bytes=size_bytes,
                    source_description=comment,
                    custom_properties={"engine": r.get("engine", "")},
                )
            )
            statistics.append(
                TableStatisticsMetadata(
                    schema_name=schema_name,
                    table_name=table_name,
                    row_count_estimate=row_count,
                    size_bytes=size_bytes,
                )
            )

        # 2. Columns
        col_sql = f"""
            SELECT 
                table,
                name,
                position,
                type,
                default_expression,
                is_in_primary_key,
                comment
            FROM system.columns
            WHERE database = '{safe_schema}'
            ORDER BY table, position
        """
        col_rows = await self._query_json(col_sql)

        columns: List[ColumnMetadata] = []
        pk_cols_by_table: Dict[str, List[str]] = {}

        for r in col_rows:
            tbl_name = r["table"]
            col_name = r["name"]
            is_pk = bool(r.get("is_in_primary_key"))
            if is_pk:
                pk_cols_by_table.setdefault(tbl_name, []).append(col_name)

            data_type = r.get("type", "String")
            is_nullable = "Nullable" in data_type

            columns.append(
                ColumnMetadata(
                    schema_name=schema_name,
                    table_name=tbl_name,
                    name=col_name,
                    ordinal_position=int(r.get("position", 1)),
                    data_type=data_type,
                    raw_data_type=data_type,
                    is_nullable=is_nullable,
                    is_primary_key=is_pk,
                    default_value=r.get("default_expression") or None,
                    source_description=r.get("comment") or None,
                )
            )

        # 3. Primary Key Indexes
        indexes: List[IndexMetadata] = []
        for tbl_name, pk_cols in pk_cols_by_table.items():
            indexes.append(
                IndexMetadata(
                    schema_name=schema_name,
                    table_name=tbl_name,
                    name=f"pk_{tbl_name}",
                    is_unique=True,
                    is_primary=True,
                    index_type="PRIMARY_KEY",
                    columns_list=pk_cols,
                )
            )

        # 4. Routines (ClickHouse functions)
        routines: List[RoutineMetadata] = []
        try:
            fn_rows = await self._query_json("SELECT name, is_aggregate, origin FROM system.functions WHERE origin = 'System' LIMIT 20")
            for r in fn_rows:
                routines.append(
                    RoutineMetadata(
                        schema_name=schema_name,
                        name=r["name"],
                        routine_type="AGGREGATE" if r.get("is_aggregate") else "FUNCTION",
                        language="C++",
                    )
                )
        except Exception:
            pass

        return SchemaExtractionResult(
            schema=SchemaMetadata(name=schema_name),
            tables=tables,
            columns=columns,
            foreign_keys=[],  # ClickHouse does not enforce relational foreign keys
            statistics=statistics,
            indexes=indexes,
            routines=routines,
            success=True,
        )


# Auto-register with default registry
default_connector_registry.register(DatabaseEngine.CLICKHOUSE, ClickHouseConnector)
default_connector_registry.register("CLICKHOUSE", ClickHouseConnector)

from __future__ import annotations

import asyncio
import logging
import time
import urllib.parse
from typing import Any, Dict, List, Optional, Set

from backend.src.models.connections import DatabaseEngine
from backend.src.services.connectors.base import (
    BaseMetadataConnector,
    ColumnMetadata,
    ConnectionTestResult,
    IndexMetadata,
    MissingDriverError,
    SchemaExtractionResult,
    SchemaMetadata,
    TableMetadata,
    TableStatisticsMetadata,
)
from backend.src.services.connectors.registry import default_connector_registry

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)


def _has_mongo_driver() -> bool:
    """Checks whether motor or pymongo is installed."""
    try:
        import motor.motor_asyncio  # noqa: F401
        return True
    except ImportError:
        try:
            import pymongo  # noqa: F401
            return True
        except ImportError:
            return False


class MongoDBConnector(BaseMetadataConnector):
    """
    Enterprise MongoDB document database metadata connector.

    Treats databases as schemas, collections as tables, and samples up to 50 documents
    per collection to infer dynamic BSON/JSON schema structure, nested types, and indexes.
    Enforces strict 5.0-second timeouts.
    """

    STATEMENT_TIMEOUT_MS: int = 30000

    def __init__(self, connection_config: Dict[str, Any]) -> None:
        super().__init__(connection_config)
        self._client: Any = None

    def _ensure_driver(self) -> None:
        if not _has_mongo_driver():
            raise MissingDriverError(
                engine="MONGODB",
                package_name="motor",
                message="ط¨ط±ط§غŒ ط§طھطµط§ظ„ ط¨ظ‡ ظ¾ط§غŒع¯ط§ظ‡â€Œط¯ط§ط¯ظ‡ MongoDBطŒ ظ„ط·ظپط§ظ‹ ظ¾ع©غŒط¬ 'motor' غŒط§ 'pymongo' ط±ط§ ظ†طµط¨ ظ†ظ…ط§غŒغŒط¯.",
            )

    def _build_connection_uri(self) -> str:
        if "url" in self.config:
            return self.config["url"]

        host = self.config.get("host", "127.0.0.1")
        port = int(self.config.get("port", 27017))
        username = self.config.get("username")
        password = self.config.get("password")
        custom_params = self.config.get("custom_params") or {}
        auth_source = custom_params.get("authSource", "admin")

        auth = ""
        if username and password:
            q_user = urllib.parse.quote_plus(str(username))
            q_pass = urllib.parse.quote_plus(str(password))
            auth = f"{q_user}:{q_pass}@"
        elif username:
            auth = f"{urllib.parse.quote_plus(str(username))}@"

        return f"mongodb://{auth}{host}:{port}/?authSource={auth_source}"

    async def _get_client(self) -> Any:
        self._ensure_driver()
        import motor.motor_asyncio

        uri = self._build_connection_uri()
        return motor.motor_asyncio.AsyncIOMotorClient(
            uri,
            serverSelectionTimeoutMS=5000,
            connectTimeoutMS=5000,
            socketTimeoutMS=10000,
        )

    async def __aenter__(self) -> "MongoDBConnector":
        self._is_closed = False
        if self._client is None:
            self._client = await self._get_client()
        return self

    async def __aexit__(self, exc_type: Any, exc_val: Any, exc_tb: Any) -> None:
        if self._client is not None:
            self._client.close()
            self._client = None
        self._is_closed = True

    async def test_connection(self) -> ConnectionTestResult:
        """5s timeout ping command and server_info()."""
        start_time = time.monotonic()
        try:
            return await asyncio.wait_for(self._run_connection_test(start_time), timeout=5.0)
        except asyncio.TimeoutError:
            elapsed_ms = round((time.monotonic() - start_time) * 1000, 2)
            return ConnectionTestResult(
                success=False,
                latency_ms=elapsed_ms,
                dialect="MONGODB",
                server_version=None,
                message="Connection probe timed out after 5.0 seconds.",
                diagnostic_details={"error_type": "TimeoutError", "timeout_seconds": 5.0},
            )
        except Exception as exc:
            elapsed_ms = round((time.monotonic() - start_time) * 1000, 2)
            return ConnectionTestResult(
                success=False,
                latency_ms=elapsed_ms,
                dialect="MONGODB",
                server_version=None,
                message=str(exc),
                diagnostic_details={"error_type": type(exc).__name__, "error": str(exc)},
            )

    async def _run_connection_test(self, start_time: float) -> ConnectionTestResult:
        client = self._client
        should_close = False
        if client is None:
            client = await self._get_client()
            should_close = True

        try:
            admin_db = client.admin
            await admin_db.command("ping")
            server_info = await client.server_info()
            server_ver = server_info.get("version")
            elapsed_ms = round((time.monotonic() - start_time) * 1000, 2)

            return ConnectionTestResult(
                success=True,
                latency_ms=elapsed_ms,
                dialect="MONGODB",
                server_version=server_ver,
                message=f"Successfully connected to MongoDB server v{server_ver}.",
                diagnostic_details={
                    "version_string": server_ver or "",
                    "session_read_only": True,
                    "tcp_reachable": True,
                    "auth_valid": True,
                },
            )
        finally:
            if should_close:
                client.close()

    async def discover_databases(self) -> List[str]:
        """list_database_names() excluding admin, local, config."""
        client = self._client
        should_close = False
        if client is None:
            client = await self._get_client()
            should_close = True

        try:
            all_dbs = await client.list_database_names()
            excluded = {"admin", "local", "config"}
            return [db for db in all_dbs if db not in excluded]
        finally:
            if should_close:
                client.close()

    async def _run_database_discovery(self, start_time: float) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        client = self._client
        should_close = False
        if client is None:
            client = await self._get_client()
            should_close = True

        try:
            server_ver = None
            try:
                info = await client.server_info()
                server_ver = info.get("version")
            except Exception:
                pass

            databases = await self.discover_databases()
            elapsed_ms = round((time.monotonic() - start_time) * 1000, 2)
            return {
                "success": True,
                "databases": databases,
                "latency_ms": elapsed_ms,
                "server_version": server_ver,
                "message": f"Successfully discovered {len(databases)} MongoDB databases.",
            }
        finally:
            if should_close:
                client.close()

    async def extract_schemas(self) -> List[SchemaMetadata]:
        """Lists discoverable non-system databases."""
        dbs = await self.discover_databases()
        return [SchemaMetadata(name=name) for name in dbs]

    @staticmethod
    def _infer_type(val: Any) -> str:
        """Maps Python / BSON types to standard type string."""
        if val is None:
            return "null"
        if isinstance(val, bool):
            return "bool"
        if isinstance(val, int):
            return "int"
        if isinstance(val, float):
            return "double"
        if isinstance(val, str):
            return "string"
        if isinstance(val, dict):
            return "object"
        if isinstance(val, (list, tuple)):
            return "array"
        tname = type(val).__name__.lower()
        if "objectid" in tname:
            return "objectId"
        if "datetime" in tname or "timestamp" in tname:
            return "date"
        return tname

    async def extract_schema_metadata(self, schema_name: str) -> SchemaExtractionResult:
        """
        Introspects collections, infers schema from up to 50 documents, and extracts indexes.
        """
        client = self._client
        should_close = False
        if client is None:
            client = await self._get_client()
            should_close = True

        try:
            db = client[schema_name]
            coll_names = await db.list_collection_names()

            tables: List[TableMetadata] = []
            columns: List[ColumnMetadata] = []
            statistics: List[TableStatisticsMetadata] = []
            indexes: List[IndexMetadata] = []

            for coll_name in coll_names:
                if coll_name.startswith("system."):
                    continue

                coll = db[coll_name]

                # Fast stats
                row_count = 0
                size_bytes = 0
                try:
                    stats = await db.command("collStats", coll_name)
                    row_count = int(stats.get("count", 0))
                    size_bytes = int(stats.get("size", stats.get("storageSize", 0)))
                except Exception:
                    try:
                        row_count = await coll.estimated_document_count()
                    except Exception:
                        pass

                tables.append(
                    TableMetadata(
                        schema_name=schema_name,
                        name=coll_name,
                        table_type="TABLE",
                        row_count_estimate=row_count,
                        size_bytes=size_bytes,
                    )
                )
                statistics.append(
                    TableStatisticsMetadata(
                        schema_name=schema_name,
                        table_name=coll_name,
                        row_count_estimate=row_count,
                        size_bytes=size_bytes,
                    )
                )

                # Sample up to 50 documents to infer fields
                field_types: Dict[str, Set[str]] = {}
                field_seen_count: Dict[str, int] = {}
                doc_count = 0

                try:
                    cursor = coll.find().limit(50)
                    async for doc in cursor:
                        doc_count += 1
                        for key, val in doc.items():
                            t = self._infer_type(val)
                            field_types.setdefault(key, set()).add(t)
                            field_seen_count[key] = field_seen_count.get(key, 0) + 1
                except Exception as exc:
                    logger.debug("MongoDB sampling failed for collection %s: %s", coll_name, exc)

                # Ensure _id is present
                if "_id" not in field_types:
                    field_types["_id"] = {"objectId"}
                    field_seen_count["_id"] = doc_count

                # Create column metadata
                ordinal = 1
                for field_name in sorted(field_types.keys(), key=lambda k: (0 if k == "_id" else 1, k)):
                    types = field_types[field_name]
                    type_str = "/".join(sorted(types)) if types else "unknown"
                    seen = field_seen_count.get(field_name, 0)
                    is_pk = (field_name == "_id")
                    is_nullable = not is_pk and (seen < doc_count or "null" in types)

                    columns.append(
                        ColumnMetadata(
                            schema_name=schema_name,
                            table_name=coll_name,
                            name=field_name,
                            ordinal_position=ordinal,
                            data_type=type_str,
                            raw_data_type=type_str,
                            is_nullable=is_nullable,
                            is_primary_key=is_pk,
                        )
                    )
                    ordinal += 1

                # Extract indexes
                try:
                    idx_info = await coll.index_information()
                    for idx_name, idx_meta in idx_info.items():
                        key_pairs = idx_meta.get("key", [])
                        cols = [k[0] for k in key_pairs]
                        is_uniq = bool(idx_meta.get("unique", False))
                        is_pk = (idx_name == "_id_")

                        indexes.append(
                            IndexMetadata(
                                schema_name=schema_name,
                                table_name=coll_name,
                                name=idx_name,
                                is_unique=is_uniq,
                                is_primary=is_pk,
                                index_type="BTREE",
                                columns_list=cols,
                            )
                        )
                except Exception as exc:
                    logger.debug("MongoDB index extraction failed for %s: %s", coll_name, exc)

            return SchemaExtractionResult(
                schema=SchemaMetadata(name=schema_name),
                tables=tables,
                columns=columns,
                foreign_keys=[],  # MongoDB is non-relational
                statistics=statistics,
                indexes=indexes,
                routines=[],
                success=True,
            )
        finally:
            if should_close:
                client.close()


# Auto-register with default registry
default_connector_registry.register(DatabaseEngine.MONGODB, MongoDBConnector)
default_connector_registry.register("MONGODB", MongoDBConnector)

from __future__ import annotations

import asyncio
import logging
import time
import urllib.parse
from typing import Any, Dict, List, Optional, Type

from sqlalchemy import text
from sqlalchemy.ext.asyncio import AsyncEngine, create_async_engine
from sqlalchemy.pool import NullPool, Pool

from backend.src.models.connections import DatabaseEngine
from backend.src.services.connectors.base import (
    BaseMetadataConnector,
    ColumnMetadata,
    ConnectionTestResult,
    ForeignKeyMetadata,
    IndexMetadata,
    MissingDriverError,
    RoutineMetadata,
    SchemaExtractionResult,
    SchemaMetadata,
    TableMetadata,
    TableStatisticsMetadata,
)
from backend.src.services.connectors.registry import default_connector_registry
