class PostgresConnector(BaseMetadataConnector):
    """
    High-performance native PostgreSQL metadata connector.

    Introspects native PostgreSQL system catalogs (pg_catalog) directly,
    bypassing slow ANSI information_schema views. Guarantees zero N+1 queries.
    Uses ephemeral connections with NullPool and strict session timeouts.
    """

    QUERIES: Dict[str, str] = {
        "SCHEMAS": """
            SELECT 
                n.nspname AS schema_name,
                pg_catalog.pg_get_userbyid(n.nspowner) AS owner,
                d.description AS description
            FROM pg_catalog.pg_namespace n
            LEFT JOIN pg_catalog.pg_description d ON d.objoid = n.oid AND d.objsubid = 0
            WHERE n.nspname NOT IN ('pg_catalog', 'information_schema')
              AND n.nspname NOT LIKE 'pg_temp%'
              AND n.nspname NOT LIKE 'pg_toast%'
            ORDER BY n.nspname;
        """,
        "DB_USERS": """
            SELECT 
                r.oid::text AS oid,
                r.rolname AS username,
                r.rolcanlogin AS can_login,
                r.rolsuper AS is_superuser,
                r.rolcreatedb AS can_create_db,
                r.rolcreaterole AS can_create_role,
                r.rolconnlimit AS connection_limit,
                r.rolvaliduntil::text AS valid_until,
                COALESCE(
                    (SELECT array_agg(parent.rolname ORDER BY parent.rolname)
                     FROM pg_catalog.pg_auth_members am
                     JOIN pg_catalog.pg_roles parent ON parent.oid = am.roleid
                     WHERE am.member = r.oid),
                    ARRAY[]::name[]
                ) AS member_of_roles,
                (SELECT COUNT(*)::int FROM pg_catalog.pg_stat_activity sa WHERE sa.usename = r.rolname) AS active_sessions
            FROM pg_catalog.pg_roles r
            WHERE r.rolname NOT LIKE 'pg_%'
            ORDER BY r.rolcanlogin DESC, r.rolname ASC;
        """,
        "TABLES": """
            SELECT 
                c.relname AS table_name,
                CASE c.relkind 
                    WHEN 'r' THEN 'TABLE'
                    WHEN 'v' THEN 'VIEW'
                    WHEN 'm' THEN 'MATERIALIZED_VIEW'
                    WHEN 'p' THEN 'PARTITIONED_TABLE'
                    WHEN 'f' THEN 'EXTERNAL_TABLE'
                    ELSE 'TABLE'
                END AS table_type,
                GREATEST(COALESCE(s.n_live_tup, 0), COALESCE(c.reltuples::bigint, 0), 0) AS row_count_estimate,
                pg_catalog.pg_total_relation_size(c.oid) AS size_bytes,
                d.description AS source_description,
                pg_catalog.pg_get_userbyid(c.relowner) AS owner
            FROM pg_catalog.pg_class c
            JOIN pg_catalog.pg_namespace n ON n.oid = c.relnamespace
            LEFT JOIN pg_catalog.pg_stat_user_tables s ON s.relid = c.oid
            LEFT JOIN pg_catalog.pg_description d ON d.objoid = c.oid AND d.objsubid = 0
            WHERE n.nspname = :schema_name 
              AND c.relkind IN ('r', 'v', 'm', 'p', 'f')
            ORDER BY c.relname;
        """,
        "COLUMNS": """
            SELECT 
                c.relname AS table_name,
                a.attname AS column_name,
                a.attnum AS ordinal_position,
                pg_catalog.format_type(a.atttypid, a.atttypmod) AS data_type,
                t.typname AS raw_data_type,
                CASE WHEN a.attcollation = 0 THEN NULL ELSE col.collname END AS collation,
                NOT a.attnotnull AS is_nullable,
                COALESCE(pk.is_pk, false) AS is_primary_key,
                COALESCE(fk.is_fk, false) AS is_foreign_key,
                pg_catalog.pg_get_expr(ad.adbin, ad.adrelid) AS default_value,
                d.description AS source_description
            FROM pg_catalog.pg_attribute a
            JOIN pg_catalog.pg_class c ON c.oid = a.attrelid
            JOIN pg_catalog.pg_namespace n ON n.oid = c.relnamespace
            JOIN pg_catalog.pg_type t ON t.oid = a.atttypid
            LEFT JOIN pg_catalog.pg_collation col ON col.oid = a.attcollation
            LEFT JOIN pg_catalog.pg_attrdef ad ON ad.adrelid = a.attrelid AND ad.adnum = a.attnum
            LEFT JOIN pg_catalog.pg_description d ON d.objoid = a.attrelid AND d.objsubid = a.attnum
            LEFT JOIN (
                SELECT DISTINCT conrelid, unnest(conkey) AS attnum, true AS is_pk
                FROM pg_catalog.pg_constraint
                WHERE contype = 'p' AND connamespace = (SELECT oid FROM pg_catalog.pg_namespace WHERE nspname = :schema_name)
            ) pk ON pk.conrelid = a.attrelid AND pk.attnum = a.attnum
            LEFT JOIN (
                SELECT DISTINCT conrelid, unnest(conkey) AS attnum, true AS is_fk
                FROM pg_catalog.pg_constraint
                WHERE contype = 'f' AND connamespace = (SELECT oid FROM pg_catalog.pg_namespace WHERE nspname = :schema_name)
            ) fk ON fk.conrelid = a.attrelid AND fk.attnum = a.attnum
            WHERE n.nspname = :schema_name 
              AND c.relkind IN ('r', 'v', 'm', 'p', 'f')
              AND a.attnum > 0 
              AND NOT a.attisdropped
            ORDER BY c.relname, a.attnum;
        """,
        "FOREIGN_KEYS": """
            SELECT
                c.relname AS table_name,
                a.attname AS column_name,
                fn.nspname AS foreign_schema_name,
                fc.relname AS foreign_table_name,
                fa.attname AS foreign_column_name,
                k.conname AS constraint_name
            FROM (
                SELECT
                    con.conname,
                    con.conrelid,
                    con.confrelid,
                    con.conkey[i] AS attnum,
                    con.confkey[i] AS confattnum
                FROM pg_catalog.pg_constraint con
                CROSS JOIN LATERAL generate_subscripts(con.conkey, 1) AS i
                WHERE con.contype = 'f' AND con.connamespace = (SELECT oid FROM pg_catalog.pg_namespace WHERE nspname = :schema_name)
            ) k
            JOIN pg_catalog.pg_class c ON c.oid = k.conrelid
            JOIN pg_catalog.pg_namespace n ON n.oid = c.relnamespace
            JOIN pg_catalog.pg_class fc ON fc.oid = k.confrelid
            JOIN pg_catalog.pg_namespace fn ON fn.oid = fc.relnamespace
            JOIN pg_catalog.pg_attribute a ON a.attrelid = k.conrelid AND a.attnum = k.attnum
            JOIN pg_catalog.pg_attribute fa ON fa.attrelid = k.confrelid AND fa.attnum = k.confattnum
            WHERE n.nspname = :schema_name
            ORDER BY c.relname, k.conname;
        """,
        "STATISTICS": """
            SELECT 
                c.relname AS table_name,
                GREATEST(COALESCE(s.n_live_tup, 0), COALESCE(c.reltuples::bigint, 0), 0)::bigint AS row_count_estimate,
                pg_catalog.pg_total_relation_size(c.oid)::bigint AS size_bytes
            FROM pg_catalog.pg_class c
            JOIN pg_catalog.pg_namespace n ON n.oid = c.relnamespace
            LEFT JOIN pg_catalog.pg_stat_user_tables s ON s.relid = c.oid
            WHERE n.nspname = :schema_name 
              AND c.relkind IN ('r', 'v', 'm', 'p', 'f')
            ORDER BY c.relname;
        """,
        "INDEXES": """
            SELECT
                c.relname AS table_name,
                i.relname AS index_name,
                idx.indisunique AS is_unique,
                idx.indisprimary AS is_primary,
                am.amname AS index_type,
                pg_catalog.pg_get_indexdef(idx.indexrelid) AS definition,
                (
                    SELECT string_agg(a.attname, ', ' ORDER BY array_position(idx.indkey, a.attnum))
                    FROM pg_catalog.pg_attribute a
                    WHERE a.attrelid = c.oid AND a.attnum = ANY(idx.indkey)
                ) AS column_names
            FROM pg_catalog.pg_index idx
            JOIN pg_catalog.pg_class c ON c.oid = idx.indrelid
            JOIN pg_catalog.pg_class i ON i.oid = idx.indexrelid
            JOIN pg_catalog.pg_namespace n ON n.oid = c.relnamespace
            JOIN pg_catalog.pg_am am ON am.oid = i.relam
            WHERE n.nspname = :schema_name
              AND c.relkind IN ('r', 'm', 'p')
            ORDER BY c.relname, i.relname;
        """,
        "ROUTINES": """
            SELECT
                p.proname AS routine_name,
                CASE p.prokind
                    WHEN 'p' THEN 'PROCEDURE'
                    WHEN 'f' THEN 'FUNCTION'
                    ELSE 'FUNCTION'
                END AS routine_type,
                l.lanname AS language,
                pg_catalog.pg_get_function_arguments(p.oid) AS arguments_signature,
                pg_catalog.pg_get_function_result(p.oid) AS return_type,
                d.description AS source_description
            FROM pg_catalog.pg_proc p
            JOIN pg_catalog.pg_namespace n ON n.oid = p.pronamespace
            LEFT JOIN pg_catalog.pg_language l ON l.oid = p.prolang
            LEFT JOIN pg_catalog.pg_description d ON d.objoid = p.oid AND d.objsubid = 0
            WHERE n.nspname = :schema_name
              AND p.prokind IN ('p', 'f')
            ORDER BY p.proname;
        """,
    }

    def __init__(self, connection_config: Dict[str, Any]) -> None:
        super().__init__(connection_config)
        self._engine: Optional[AsyncEngine] = None

    def get_pool_class(self) -> Type[Pool]:
        return NullPool

    def get_connect_args(self) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """Returns connection arguments enforcing 10s TCP handshake/connect timeout."""
        connect_args: Dict[str, Any] = {
            "timeout": 10,
            "connect_timeout": 10,
        }
        custom_params = self.config.get("custom_params") or {}
        sslmode = custom_params.get("sslmode")
        if sslmode:
            connect_args["ssl"] = sslmode if sslmode != "disable" else False
        elif self.config.get("ssl"):
            connect_args["ssl"] = self.config.get("ssl")

        if "application_name" in custom_params:
            connect_args["server_settings"] = {"application_name": custom_params["application_name"]}
        return connect_args

    def build_connection_url(self) -> str:
        """Constructs an asyncpg driver connection URL from config."""
        if "url" in self.config:
            url = self.config["url"]
            if url.startswith("postgresql://"):
                url = url.replace("postgresql://", "postgresql+asyncpg://", 1)
            return url

        host = self.config.get("host", "127.0.0.1")
        port = self.config.get("port", 5432)
        database = self.config.get("database") or self.config.get("database_name", "postgres")
        username = self.config.get("username") or self.config.get("user", "postgres")
        password = self.config.get("password", "")

        quoted_username = urllib.parse.quote_plus(str(username))
        quoted_password = urllib.parse.quote_plus(str(password)) if password else ""
        auth = f"{quoted_username}:{quoted_password}@" if quoted_password else f"{quoted_username}@"

        return f"postgresql+asyncpg://{auth}{host}:{port}/{database}"

    def _create_engine(self) -> AsyncEngine:
        connect_args = dict(self.get_connect_args())
        # asyncpg accepts 'timeout' instead of 'connect_timeout'
        connect_args.pop("connect_timeout", None)
        return create_async_engine(
            self.build_connection_url(),
            poolclass=self.get_pool_class(),
            connect_args=connect_args,
            echo=False,
        )

    async def __aenter__(self) -> "PostgresConnector":
        self._is_closed = False
        if self._engine is None:
            self._engine = self._create_engine()
        return self

    async def __aexit__(self, exc_type: Any, exc_val: Any, exc_tb: Any) -> None:
        if self._engine is not None:
            await self._engine.dispose()
            self._engine = None
        self._is_closed = True

    async def test_connection(self) -> ConnectionTestResult:
        """
        Verifies TCP handshake, authentication, read-only session setup, and server version.
        Guarantees strict 5.0-second timeout ceiling.
        """
        start_time = time.monotonic()
        try:
            return await asyncio.wait_for(self._run_connection_test(start_time), timeout=5.0)
        except asyncio.TimeoutError:
            elapsed_ms = round((time.monotonic() - start_time) * 1000, 2)
            return ConnectionTestResult(
                success=False,
                latency_ms=elapsed_ms,
                dialect="POSTGRESQL",
                server_version=None,
                message="Connection probe timed out after 5.0 seconds.",
                diagnostic_details={"error_type": "TimeoutError", "timeout_seconds": 5.0},
            )
        except Exception as exc:
            elapsed_ms = round((time.monotonic() - start_time) * 1000, 2)
            pgcode = getattr(exc, "pgcode", None) or getattr(exc, "sqlstate", None)
            return ConnectionTestResult(
                success=False,
                latency_ms=elapsed_ms,
                dialect="POSTGRESQL",
                server_version=None,
                message=f"Connection test failed: {str(exc)}",
                diagnostic_details={"error_type": type(exc).__name__, "pgcode": pgcode, "error": str(exc)},
            )

    async def _run_connection_test(self, start_time: float) -> ConnectionTestResult:
        engine = self._engine or self._create_engine()
        should_dispose = self._engine is None
        try:
            async with engine.connect() as conn:
                # Apply read-only session protections
                for stmt in self.get_session_setup_statements():
                    await conn.execute(text(stmt))

                result = await conn.execute(
                    text("SELECT version(), current_setting('server_version'), current_database();")
                )
                row = result.fetchone()
                server_ver = row[1] if row else None
                db_name = row[2] if row else ""

                elapsed_ms = round((time.monotonic() - start_time) * 1000, 2)
                return ConnectionTestResult(
                    success=True,
                    latency_ms=elapsed_ms,
                    dialect="POSTGRESQL",
                    server_version=server_ver,
                    message=f"Successfully connected to PostgreSQL database '{db_name}'.",
                    diagnostic_details={
                        "version_string": row[0] if row else "",
                        "database": db_name,
                        "session_read_only": True,
                        "tcp_reachable": True,
                        "auth_valid": True,
                        "read_only_supported": True,
                        "statement_timeout_ms": self.STATEMENT_TIMEOUT_MS,
                        "ssl_active": False,
                    },
                )
        finally:
            if should_dispose:
                await engine.dispose()

    async def extract_database_collation(self) -> Optional[str]:
        """Extracts the connected database's default collation."""
        engine = self._engine or self._create_engine()
        should_dispose = self._engine is None
        try:
            async with engine.connect() as conn:
                for stmt in self.get_session_setup_statements():
                    await conn.execute(text(stmt))
                result = await conn.execute(
                    text("SELECT datcollate FROM pg_database WHERE datname = current_database()")
                )
                row = result.fetchone()
                return str(row[0]) if row and row[0] else None
        except Exception as exc:
            logger.debug("Database collation extraction failed: %s", exc)
            return None
        finally:
            if should_dispose:
                await engine.dispose()

    async def extract_schemas(self) -> List[SchemaMetadata]:
        """Lists accessible schemas excluding internal system schemas."""
        engine = self._engine or self._create_engine()
        should_dispose = self._engine is None
        try:
            async with engine.connect() as conn:
                for stmt in self.get_session_setup_statements():
                    await conn.execute(text(stmt))

                result = await conn.execute(text(self.QUERIES["SCHEMAS"]))
                schemas = [
                    SchemaMetadata(
                        name=row.schema_name,
                        owner=row.owner,
                        description=row.description,
                    )
                    for row in result.mappings().all()
                ]
                return schemas
        finally:
            if should_dispose:
                await engine.dispose()

    async def extract_schema_metadata(self, schema_name: str) -> SchemaExtractionResult:
        """
        Executes exactly 4 bulk queries against pg_catalog for the given schema:
        1. Tables & Views
        2. Columns
        3. Foreign Keys
        4. Table Statistics
        Zero N+1 round trips.
        """
        engine = self._engine or self._create_engine()
        should_dispose = self._engine is None
        try:
            async with engine.connect() as conn:
                for stmt in self.get_session_setup_statements():
                    await conn.execute(text(stmt))

                # Query 1: Tables
                tables_res = await conn.execute(
                    text(self.QUERIES["TABLES"]),
                    {"schema_name": schema_name},
                )
                tables = [
                    TableMetadata(
                        schema_name=schema_name,
                        name=row.table_name,
                        table_type=row.table_type,
                        row_count_estimate=int(row.row_count_estimate or 0),
                        size_bytes=int(row.size_bytes or 0),
                        source_description=row.source_description,
                        owner=row.owner,
                    )
                    for row in tables_res.mappings().all()
                ]

                # Query 2: Columns
                cols_res = await conn.execute(
                    text(self.QUERIES["COLUMNS"]),
                    {"schema_name": schema_name},
                )
                columns = [
                    ColumnMetadata(
                        schema_name=schema_name,
                        table_name=row.table_name,
                        name=row.column_name,
                        ordinal_position=int(row.ordinal_position),
                        data_type=row.data_type,
                        raw_data_type=row.raw_data_type,
                        collation=row.collation,
                        is_nullable=bool(row.is_nullable),
                        is_primary_key=bool(row.is_primary_key),
                        is_foreign_key=bool(row.is_foreign_key),
                        default_value=row.default_value,
                        source_description=row.source_description,
                    )
                    for row in cols_res.mappings().all()
                ]

                # Query 3: Foreign Keys
                fks_res = await conn.execute(
                    text(self.QUERIES["FOREIGN_KEYS"]),
                    {"schema_name": schema_name},
                )
                foreign_keys = [
                    ForeignKeyMetadata(
                        schema_name=schema_name,
                        table_name=row.table_name,
                        column_name=row.column_name,
                        foreign_schema_name=row.foreign_schema_name,
                        foreign_table_name=row.foreign_table_name,
                        foreign_column_name=row.foreign_column_name,
                        constraint_name=row.constraint_name,
                    )
                    for row in fks_res.mappings().all()
                ]

                # Query 4: Statistics
                stats_res = await conn.execute(
                    text(self.QUERIES["STATISTICS"]),
                    {"schema_name": schema_name},
                )
                statistics = [
                    TableStatisticsMetadata(
                        schema_name=schema_name,
                        table_name=row.table_name,
                        row_count_estimate=int(row.row_count_estimate or 0),
                        size_bytes=int(row.size_bytes or 0),
                    )
                    for row in stats_res.mappings().all()
                ]

                # Query 5: Indexes
                idx_res = await conn.execute(
                    text(self.QUERIES["INDEXES"]),
                    {"schema_name": schema_name},
                )
                indexes = [
                    IndexMetadata(
                        schema_name=schema_name,
                        table_name=row.table_name,
                        name=row.index_name,
                        is_unique=bool(row.is_unique),
                        is_primary=bool(row.is_primary),
                        index_type=row.index_type or "BTREE",
                        columns_list=[c.strip() for c in (row.column_names or "").split(",") if c.strip()],
                        definition=row.definition,
                    )
                    for row in idx_res.mappings().all()
                ]

                # Query 6: Routines
                routines_res = await conn.execute(
                    text(self.QUERIES["ROUTINES"]),
                    {"schema_name": schema_name},
                )
                routines = [
                    RoutineMetadata(
                        schema_name=schema_name,
                        name=row.routine_name,
                        routine_type=row.routine_type,
                        language=row.language or "sql",
                        arguments_signature=row.arguments_signature,
                        return_type=row.return_type,
                        source_description=row.source_description,
                    )
                    for row in routines_res.mappings().all()
                ]

                schema_meta = SchemaMetadata(name=schema_name)
                return SchemaExtractionResult(
                    schema=schema_meta,
                    tables=tables,
                    columns=columns,
                    foreign_keys=foreign_keys,
                    statistics=statistics,
                    indexes=indexes,
                    routines=routines,
                    success=True,
                )
        finally:
            if should_dispose:
                await engine.dispose()

    @classmethod
    async def discover_databases_from_config(cls, config: Dict[str, Any]) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """
        Connects transiently (NullPool, READ ONLY, 5s timeout) to the 'postgres' maintenance DB
        and queries non-template databases.
        """
        start_time = time.monotonic()
        discovery_config = dict(config)
        # Use postgres maintenance database unless overridden
        discovery_config["database"] = discovery_config.get("database") or "postgres"
        connector = cls(discovery_config)
        try:
            return await asyncio.wait_for(connector._run_database_discovery(start_time), timeout=5.0)
        except asyncio.TimeoutError:
            elapsed_ms = round((time.monotonic() - start_time) * 1000, 2)
            return {
                "success": False,
                "databases": [],
                "latency_ms": elapsed_ms,
                "server_version": None,
                "message": "Database discovery probe timed out after 5.0 seconds.",
            }
        except Exception as exc:
            elapsed_ms = round((time.monotonic() - start_time) * 1000, 2)
            return {
                "success": False,
                "databases": [],
                "latency_ms": elapsed_ms,
                "server_version": None,
                "message": f"Database discovery failed: {str(exc)}",
            }

    async def _run_database_discovery(self, start_time: float) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        engine = self._engine or self._create_engine()
        should_dispose = self._engine is None
        try:
            async with engine.connect() as conn:
                for stmt in self.get_session_setup_statements():
                    await conn.execute(text(stmt))

                ver_res = await conn.execute(text("SELECT version(), current_setting('server_version');"))
                ver_row = ver_res.fetchone()
                server_ver = ver_row[1] if ver_row else None

                db_res = await conn.execute(
                    text("SELECT datname FROM pg_database WHERE datistemplate = false ORDER BY datname;")
                )
                databases = [r[0] for r in db_res.fetchall()]
                elapsed_ms = round((time.monotonic() - start_time) * 1000, 2)
                return {
                    "success": True,
                    "databases": databases,
                    "latency_ms": elapsed_ms,
                    "server_version": server_ver,
                    "message": f"Successfully discovered {len(databases)} databases.",
                }
        finally:
            if should_dispose:
                await engine.dispose()

    async def extract_database_users(self) -> List[Dict[str, Any]]:
        """
        Extracts live database users/roles and their attributes, privileges,
        role memberships, and active sessions from pg_catalog.
        Runs inside NullPool, READ ONLY session, and 5-second timeout ceiling.
        """
        return await asyncio.wait_for(self._run_extract_database_users(), timeout=5.0)

    async def _run_extract_database_users(self) -> List[Dict[str, Any]]:
        engine = self._engine or self._create_engine()
        should_dispose = self._engine is None
        try:
            async with engine.connect() as conn:
                for stmt in self.get_session_setup_statements():
                    await conn.execute(text(stmt))

                result = await conn.execute(text(self.QUERIES["DB_USERS"]))
                rows = result.mappings().all()
                users: List[Dict[str, Any]] = []
                for row in rows:
                    member_roles = list(row["member_of_roles"]) if row["member_of_roles"] is not None else []
                    users.append({
                        "oid": str(row["oid"]),
                        "username": str(row["username"]),
                        "can_login": bool(row["can_login"]),
                        "is_superuser": bool(row["is_superuser"]),
                        "can_create_db": bool(row["can_create_db"]),
                        "can_create_role": bool(row["can_create_role"]),
                        "connection_limit": int(row["connection_limit"]) if row["connection_limit"] is not None else -1,
                        "valid_until": str(row["valid_until"]) if row["valid_until"] is not None else None,
                        "member_of_roles": member_roles,
                        "active_sessions": int(row["active_sessions"] or 0),
                    })
                return users
        finally:
            if should_dispose:
                await engine.dispose()

    async def update_database_user(
        self,
        username: str,
        can_login: Optional[bool] = None,
        connection_limit: Optional[int] = None,
        valid_until: Optional[str] = None,
    ) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """
        Executes ALTER ROLE statement on target database to update role configuration.
        Uses safe identifier quoting to prevent SQL injection.
        Catches InsufficientPrivilegeError / 42501 and returns a clear Persian error message.
        """
        if not username or not username.strip():
            return {"success": False, "message": "ظ†ط§ظ… ع©ط§ط±ط¨ط±غŒ ظ†ط§ظ…ط¹طھط¨ط± ط§ط³طھ."}

        clean_user = username.strip()
        if "\x00" in clean_user:
            return {"success": False, "message": "ظ†ط§ظ… ع©ط§ط±ط¨ط±غŒ ط­ط§ظˆغŒ ظ†ظˆغŒط³ظ‡â€Œظ‡ط§غŒ ط؛غŒط±ظ…ط¬ط§ط² ط§ط³طھ."}
        escaped_user = clean_user.replace('"', '""')
        quoted_username = f'"{escaped_user}"'

        clauses: List[str] = []
        if can_login is not None:
            clauses.append("LOGIN" if can_login else "NOLOGIN")
        if connection_limit is not None:
            clauses.append(f"CONNECTION LIMIT {int(connection_limit)}")
        if valid_until is not None:
            vu = valid_until.strip()
            if not vu or vu.lower() in ("infinity", "none", "null"):
                clauses.append("VALID UNTIL 'infinity'")
            else:
                safe_vu = vu.replace("'", "''")
                clauses.append(f"VALID UNTIL '{safe_vu}'")

        if not clauses:
            return {"success": True, "message": "ظ‡غŒع† طھط؛غŒغŒط±غŒ ط¨ط±ط§غŒ ط§ط¹ظ…ط§ظ„ ط§ط±ط³ط§ظ„ ظ†ط´ط¯ظ‡ ط§ط³طھ."}

        sql_stmt = f"ALTER ROLE {quoted_username} WITH {' '.join(clauses)};"

from __future__ import annotations

import logging
from typing import Any, Dict, Type, Union

from backend.src.models.connections import DatabaseEngine
from backend.src.services.connectors.base import BaseMetadataConnector

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)


class ConnectorRegistry:
    """
    Factory and registry for database metadata connectors.
    Maps database engine types to concrete BaseMetadataConnector implementations.
    """

    def __init__(self) -> None:
        self._registry: Dict[str, Type[BaseMetadataConnector]] = {}

    @staticmethod
    def _normalize_key(engine_type: Union[DatabaseEngine, str]) -> str:
        if isinstance(engine_type, DatabaseEngine):
            return engine_type.value.upper()
        return str(engine_type).strip().upper()

    def register(
        self,
        engine_type: Union[DatabaseEngine, str],
        connector_cls: Type[BaseMetadataConnector],
    ) -> None:
        """
        Registers a connector class for the given engine type.
        Raises TypeError if connector_cls is not a subclass of BaseMetadataConnector.
        """
        if not isinstance(connector_cls, type) or not issubclass(connector_cls, BaseMetadataConnector):
            raise TypeError(
                f"Connector class {connector_cls} must be a subclass of BaseMetadataConnector"
            )
        key = self._normalize_key(engine_type)
        self._registry[key] = connector_cls
        logger.info("Registered connector %s for engine '%s'", connector_cls.__name__, key)

    def get_connector_class(
        self, engine_type: Union[DatabaseEngine, str]
    ) -> Type[BaseMetadataConnector]:
        """
        Resolves the connector class for the given engine.
        Raises NotImplementedError if dialect is unsupported or not registered.
        """
        key = self._normalize_key(engine_type)
        if key not in self._registry:
            raise NotImplementedError(
                f"Unsupported or unregistered connector engine: '{engine_type}'. "
                f"Available engines: {list(self._registry.keys())}"
            )
        return self._registry[key]

    def create_connector(
        self,
        engine_type: Union[DatabaseEngine, str],
        connection_config: Dict[str, Any],
    ) -> BaseMetadataConnector:
        """
        Factory method instantiating a connector for the specified engine and configuration.
        """
        connector_cls = self.get_connector_class(engine_type)
        return connector_cls(connection_config=connection_config)


# Global default registry instance
default_connector_registry = ConnectorRegistry()

from __future__ import annotations

import json
import os
from typing import Any, Dict, Tuple

from cryptography.exceptions import InvalidTag
from cryptography.hazmat.primitives.ciphers.aead import AESGCM

from backend.src.core.config import settings


class EnvelopeEncryptionService:
    """
    AES-256-GCM Envelope Encryption Service for database credentials.

    Architecture:
    - Master KEK (Key Encryption Key): 256-bit static secret loaded securely from configuration/KMS.
    - Ephemeral DEK (Data Encryption Key): 256-bit cryptographically secure random key per connection.
    - Associated Data (AEAD AAD): Enforces cryptographic context bindings:
      - DEK Wrapping: b"DEK_WRAP"
      - Credentials Encryption: b"DB_CREDS"
    - Output Format:
      - encrypted_dek: 12-byte IV + 32-byte encrypted DEK ciphertext + 16-byte auth tag (60 bytes)
      - encrypted_credentials: 12-byte IV + variable ciphertext + 16-byte auth tag
    """

    DEK_WRAP_AAD: bytes = b"DEK_WRAP"
    CREDS_ENCRYPT_AAD: bytes = b"DB_CREDS"
    IV_LENGTH: int = 12
    TAG_LENGTH: int = 16
    KEY_LENGTH_BYTES: int = 32

    def __init__(self, master_kek_hex: str = settings.CATALOG_MASTER_KEK) -> None:
        try:
            self.master_kek = bytes.fromhex(master_kek_hex)
        except ValueError as exc:
            raise ValueError(
                "CATALOG_MASTER_KEK must be a valid hex string of exactly 256 bits (32 bytes / 64 hex characters)"
            ) from exc

        if len(self.master_kek) != self.KEY_LENGTH_BYTES:
            raise ValueError(
                f"CATALOG_MASTER_KEK must be exactly 256 bits (32 bytes / 64 hex characters), got {len(self.master_kek)} bytes"
            )

    def encrypt_credentials(
        self, credentials_payload: Dict[str, Any]
    ) -> Tuple[bytes, bytes]:
        """
        Generates an ephemeral 256-bit DEK, encrypts credentials JSON with DEK,
        and wraps the DEK with the master KEK using AES-256-GCM.

        Returns:
            Tuple[bytes, bytes]: (encrypted_dek, encrypted_credentials)
        """
        # 1. Generate ephemeral 256-bit DEK
        dek = os.urandom(self.KEY_LENGTH_BYTES)

        # 2. Encrypt DEK with KEK (12-byte IV + 32-byte ciphertext + 16-byte tag = 60 bytes)
        kek_aesgcm = AESGCM(self.master_kek)
        dek_iv = os.urandom(self.IV_LENGTH)
        encrypted_dek = dek_iv + kek_aesgcm.encrypt(
            dek_iv, dek, associated_data=self.DEK_WRAP_AAD
        )

        # 3. Encrypt credentials payload with DEK
        payload_bytes = json.dumps(credentials_payload, separators=(",", ":")).encode("utf-8")
        dek_aesgcm = AESGCM(dek)
        data_iv = os.urandom(self.IV_LENGTH)
        encrypted_credentials = data_iv + dek_aesgcm.encrypt(
            data_iv, payload_bytes, associated_data=self.CREDS_ENCRYPT_AAD
        )

        return encrypted_dek, encrypted_credentials

    def decrypt_credentials(
        self, encrypted_dek: bytes, encrypted_credentials: bytes
    ) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """
        Unwraps the DEK using the master KEK, then decrypts the credentials JSON payload.
        Zero plaintext secrets are retained or logged.

        Raises:
            InvalidTag: If any ciphertext, IV, or auth tag is corrupted or tampered with.
        """
        min_length = self.IV_LENGTH + self.TAG_LENGTH
        if len(encrypted_dek) < min_length:
            raise InvalidTag("Encrypted DEK is too short to contain valid IV and tag")
        if len(encrypted_credentials) < min_length:
            raise InvalidTag("Encrypted credentials payload is too short to contain valid IV and tag")

        # 1. Unwrap DEK with KEK
        dek_iv = encrypted_dek[: self.IV_LENGTH]
        dek_ciphertext = encrypted_dek[self.IV_LENGTH :]
        kek_aesgcm = AESGCM(self.master_kek)
        dek = kek_aesgcm.decrypt(
            dek_iv, dek_ciphertext, associated_data=self.DEK_WRAP_AAD
        )

        # 2. Decrypt credentials payload with unwrapped DEK
        data_iv = encrypted_credentials[: self.IV_LENGTH]
        data_ciphertext = encrypted_credentials[self.IV_LENGTH :]
        dek_aesgcm = AESGCM(dek)
        decrypted_bytes = dek_aesgcm.decrypt(
            data_iv, data_ciphertext, associated_data=self.CREDS_ENCRYPT_AAD
        )

        return json.loads(decrypted_bytes.decode("utf-8"))

=== FILE: D:\datacatalog\backend\src\services\ingestion\bulk_ingestion_service.py ===
from __future__ import annotations

import json
import logging
from typing import Dict, List, Optional, Set
import uuid

from sqlalchemy import func, select, text
from sqlalchemy.ext.asyncio import AsyncSession

from backend.src.models.catalog import (
    CatalogColumn,
    CatalogTable,
    DatabaseSchema,
    LifecycleStatus,
)
from backend.src.models.connections import DatabaseConnection
from backend.src.models.rbac import EntityType
from backend.src.schemas.ingestion import (
    BulkIngestionRequest,
    BulkIngestionResponse,
)
from backend.src.services.audit.audit_service import record_audit_event
from backend.src.services.catalog.version_service import version_service

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)


class BulkIngestionService:
    """
    High-throughput batch metadata ingestion service utilizing PostgreSQL vectorized UNNEST array upserts
    to process catalog tables and columns at enterprise scale (< 1.5s for 200 tables / 5,000 columns).

    Guarantees:
    - Vectorized PostgreSQL UNNEST batch upsert for tables and columns in constant round-trips.
    - Never overwrites or clears human-curated approved_description values.
    - Soft-deletes missing tables and columns with schema-level partial failure safety guarantee (skipping failed_schemas).
    - In-place statistical metrics recording in table_statistics_history without bumping structural TableVersion.
    - Automatically triggers TableVersion snapshots and SchemaChangeLog entries exclusively on structural mutations.
    - Persists an immutable AuditLog record in the same atomic transaction.
    """

    async def record_table_statistics(
        self,
        session: AsyncSession,
        table_ids: List[uuid.UUID],
        row_counts: List[int],
        sizes: List[int],
        sync_job_id: Optional[uuid.UUID] = None,
    ) -> int:
        """
        Batch inserts extracted table statistics into table_statistics_history via UNNEST.
        Decoupled from structural TableVersion snapshotting.
        """
        if not table_ids:
            return 0

        stmt = text("""
            INSERT INTO table_statistics_history (
                id, table_id, recorded_at, row_count_estimate, size_bytes, sync_job_id
            )
            SELECT 
                gen_random_uuid(), v.table_id, clock_timestamp(), v.row_count, v.size, CAST(:sync_job_id AS uuid)
            FROM UNNEST(
                CAST(:table_ids AS uuid[]),
                CAST(:row_counts AS bigint[]),
                CAST(:sizes AS bigint[])
            ) AS v(table_id, row_count, size)
            RETURNING id;
        """)

        res = await session.execute(
            stmt,
            {
                "table_ids": table_ids,
                "row_counts": row_counts,
                "sizes": sizes,
                "sync_job_id": sync_job_id,
            },
        )
        return len(res.scalars().all())

    async def soft_delete_missing_entities(
        self,
        session: AsyncSession,
        schema_id: uuid.UUID,
        schema_name: str,
        scanned_table_names: List[str],
        failed_schemas: Optional[List[str]] = None,
    ) -> List[uuid.UUID]:
        """
        Set-based soft deletion with schema-level partial failure isolation guarantee.
        Precondition: skip soft-delete entirely for any schema present in failed_schemas.
        """
        if failed_schemas and schema_name in failed_schemas:
            logger.warning(
                f"Skipping soft deletion for schema '{schema_name}' as it is present in failed_schemas: {failed_schemas}"
            )
            return []

        if scanned_table_names:
            stmt = text("""
                UPDATE catalog_tables
                SET status = 'DELETED', updated_at = clock_timestamp()
                WHERE schema_id = :schema_id
                  AND name != ALL(CAST(:scanned_table_names AS varchar[]))
                  AND status != 'DELETED'
                RETURNING id;
            """)
            res = await session.execute(
                stmt,
                {"schema_id": schema_id, "scanned_table_names": scanned_table_names},
            )
        else:
            stmt = text("""
                UPDATE catalog_tables
                SET status = 'DELETED', updated_at = clock_timestamp()
                WHERE schema_id = :schema_id
                  AND status != 'DELETED'
                RETURNING id;
            """)
            res = await session.execute(stmt, {"schema_id": schema_id})

        return list(res.scalars().all())

    async def ingest_bulk_metadata(
        self,
        session: AsyncSession,
        payload: BulkIngestionRequest,
        actor_id: Optional[uuid.UUID] = None,
        actor_username: str = "system",
        sync_job_id: Optional[uuid.UUID] = None,
        failed_schemas: Optional[List[str]] = None,
    ) -> BulkIngestionResponse:
        """
        Executes vectorized bulk ingestion of tables and columns for a given connection and schema.
        Uses PostgreSQL UNNEST array upserts for constant round-trip execution.
        """
        effective_sync_job_id = sync_job_id or payload.sync_job_id
        effective_failed_schemas = failed_schemas or payload.failed_schemas or []

        # Schema-level partial failure check
        if payload.schema_name in effective_failed_schemas:
            logger.warning(
                f"Skipping ingestion for schema '{payload.schema_name}' as it is marked in failed_schemas."
            )
            return BulkIngestionResponse(
                success=False,
                connection_id=payload.connection_id,
                schema_id=uuid.uuid4(),
                schema_name=payload.schema_name,
                tables_upserted=0,
                tables_deleted=0,
                columns_upserted=0,
                columns_deleted=0,
                versions_created=0,
            )

        # 1. Verify connection existence
        conn_stmt = select(DatabaseConnection).where(
            DatabaseConnection.id == payload.connection_id
        )
        conn_res = await session.execute(conn_stmt)
        connection = conn_res.scalar_one_or_none()
        if not connection:
            raise ValueError(f"Database connection {payload.connection_id} not found.")

        if getattr(payload, "database_collation", None):
            connection.collation = payload.database_collation
            await session.flush()

        # 2. Get or create DatabaseSchema
        schema_stmt = select(DatabaseSchema).where(
            DatabaseSchema.connection_id == payload.connection_id,
            DatabaseSchema.name == payload.schema_name,
        )
        schema_res = await session.execute(schema_stmt)
        schema = schema_res.scalar_one_or_none()

        is_new_schema = False
        if not schema:
            is_new_schema = True
            schema = DatabaseSchema(
                id=uuid.uuid4(),
                connection_id=payload.connection_id,
                name=payload.schema_name,
                description=payload.schema_description,
                status=LifecycleStatus.ACTIVE,
            )
            session.add(schema)
            await session.flush()
        else:
            if schema.status == LifecycleStatus.DELETED:
                schema.status = LifecycleStatus.ACTIVE
                schema.updated_at = func.clock_timestamp()
                await session.flush()

        schema_id = schema.id
        schema_name = schema.name

        tables_upserted_count = 0
        tables_deleted_count = 0
        columns_upserted_count = 0
        columns_deleted_count = 0
        versions_created_count = 0

        ingested_table_names = [t.name for t in payload.tables]
        table_id_map: Dict[str, uuid.UUID] = {}

        # Check description drift on existing tables with approved_description
        if not is_new_schema:
            curated_tbl_stmt = select(CatalogTable).where(
                CatalogTable.schema_id == schema_id,
                CatalogTable.approved_description.isnot(None),
                CatalogTable.approved_description != "",
            )
            curated_tbl_res = await session.execute(curated_tbl_stmt)
            curated_tables = {t.name: t for t in curated_tbl_res.scalars().all()}

            if curated_tables and payload.tables:
                from backend.src.services.ingestion.drift_service import drift_service

                for t_payload in payload.tables:
                    if t_payload.name in curated_tables:
                        existing_t = curated_tables[t_payload.name]
                        await drift_service.detect_and_flag_drift(
                            session=session,
                            entity=existing_t,
                            extracted_comment=t_payload.source_description,
                            actor_id=actor_id,
                        )

        # 3. Vectorized Table Bulk Upsert via UNNEST (1 SQL Statement for all tables)
        if payload.tables:
            tbl_ids = [uuid.uuid4() for _ in payload.tables]
            schema_ids = [schema_id for _ in payload.tables]
            tbl_names = [t.name for t in payload.tables]
            tbl_types = [
                t.table_type.value if hasattr(t.table_type, "value") else str(t.table_type)
                for t in payload.tables
            ]
            row_counts = [t.row_count_estimate for t in payload.tables]
            sizes = [t.size_bytes for t in payload.tables]
            source_descriptions = [t.source_description for t in payload.tables]
            owners = [t.owner for t in payload.tables]
            custom_props = [json.dumps(t.custom_properties or {}) for t in payload.tables]

            table_upsert_stmt = text("""
                INSERT INTO catalog_tables (
                    id, schema_id, name, table_type, row_count_estimate, size_bytes,
                    source_description, owner, status, custom_properties, updated_at
                )
                SELECT 
                    v.id, v.schema_id, v.name, v.table_type::table_type_enum, v.row_count_estimate, v.size_bytes,
                    v.source_description, v.owner, 'ACTIVE'::lifecycle_status_enum, v.custom_properties::jsonb,
                    clock_timestamp()
                FROM UNNEST(
                    CAST(:ids AS uuid[]),
                    CAST(:schema_ids AS uuid[]),
                    CAST(:names AS varchar[]),
                    CAST(:table_types AS varchar[]),
                    CAST(:row_counts AS bigint[]),
                    CAST(:sizes AS bigint[]),
                    CAST(:source_descriptions AS text[]),
                    CAST(:owners AS varchar[]),
                    CAST(:custom_props AS text[])
                ) AS v(id, schema_id, name, table_type, row_count_estimate, size_bytes, source_description, owner, custom_properties)
                ON CONFLICT (schema_id, name) DO UPDATE SET
                    table_type = EXCLUDED.table_type,
                    row_count_estimate = EXCLUDED.row_count_estimate,
                    size_bytes = EXCLUDED.size_bytes,
                    source_description = EXCLUDED.source_description,
                    owner = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.owner, catalog_tables.owner),
                    status = 'ACTIVE',
                    custom_properties = EXCLUDED.custom_properties,
                    updated_at = clock_timestamp()
                RETURNING id, name;
            """)

            tbl_upsert_res = await session.execute(
                table_upsert_stmt,
                {
                    "ids": tbl_ids,
                    "schema_ids": schema_ids,
                    "names": tbl_names,
                    "table_types": tbl_types,
                    "row_counts": row_counts,
                    "sizes": sizes,
                    "source_descriptions": source_descriptions,
                    "owners": owners,
                    "custom_props": custom_props,
                },
            )

            for row in tbl_upsert_res.fetchall():
                t_id, t_name = row[0], row[1]
                table_id_map[t_name] = t_id
            tables_upserted_count = len(table_id_map)

        # Check description drift on existing columns with approved_description
        if not is_new_schema:
            curated_col_stmt = (
                select(CatalogColumn)
                .join(CatalogTable, CatalogColumn.table_id == CatalogTable.id)
                .where(
                    CatalogTable.schema_id == schema_id,
                    CatalogColumn.approved_description.isnot(None),
                    CatalogColumn.approved_description != "",
                )
            )
            curated_col_res = await session.execute(curated_col_stmt)
            curated_cols = {(c.table_id, c.name): c for c in curated_col_res.scalars().all()}

            if curated_cols and payload.tables:
                from backend.src.services.ingestion.drift_service import drift_service

                for t_payload in payload.tables:
                    cur_t_id = table_id_map.get(t_payload.name)
                    if not cur_t_id:
                        continue
                    for c_payload in t_payload.columns:
                        col_key = (cur_t_id, c_payload.name)
                        if col_key in curated_cols:
                            existing_c = curated_cols[col_key]
                            await drift_service.detect_and_flag_drift(
                                session=session,
                                entity=existing_c,
                                extracted_comment=c_payload.source_description,
                                actor_id=actor_id,
                            )

        # 4. Vectorized Column Bulk Upsert via UNNEST (1 SQL Statement for all columns across all tables)
        col_ids: List[uuid.UUID] = []
        col_table_ids: List[uuid.UUID] = []
        col_names: List[str] = []
        col_ordinal_positions: List[int] = []
        col_data_types: List[str] = []
        col_raw_data_types: List[str] = []
        col_collations: List[Optional[str]] = []
        col_is_nullables: List[bool] = []
        col_is_primary_keys: List[bool] = []
        col_is_foreign_keys: List[bool] = []
        col_default_values: List[Optional[str]] = []
        col_source_descriptions: List[Optional[str]] = []
        col_classification_levels: List[str] = []

        for table_payload in payload.tables:
            current_table_id = table_id_map.get(table_payload.name)
            if not current_table_id:
                continue

            for col_payload in table_payload.columns:
                cls_level_str = (
                    col_payload.classification_level.value
                    if hasattr(col_payload.classification_level, "value")
                    else str(col_payload.classification_level)
                )
                col_ids.append(uuid.uuid4())
                col_table_ids.append(current_table_id)
                col_names.append(col_payload.name)
                col_ordinal_positions.append(col_payload.ordinal_position)
                col_data_types.append(col_payload.data_type)
                col_raw_data_types.append(col_payload.raw_data_type)
                col_collations.append(col_payload.collation)
                col_is_nullables.append(col_payload.is_nullable)
                col_is_primary_keys.append(col_payload.is_primary_key)
                col_is_foreign_keys.append(col_payload.is_foreign_key)
                col_default_values.append(col_payload.default_value)
                col_source_descriptions.append(col_payload.source_description)
                col_classification_levels.append(cls_level_str)

        if col_ids:
            col_upsert_stmt = text("""
                INSERT INTO catalog_columns (
                    id, table_id, name, ordinal_position, data_type, raw_data_type,
                    "collation", is_nullable, is_primary_key, is_foreign_key, default_value,
                    source_description, classification_level, status, updated_at
                )
                SELECT 
                    v.id, v.table_id, v.name, v.ordinal_position, v.data_type, v.raw_data_type,
                    v."collation", v.is_nullable, v.is_primary_key, v.is_foreign_key, v.default_value,
                    v.source_description, v.classification_level::classification_level_enum, 'ACTIVE'::lifecycle_status_enum,
                    clock_timestamp()
                FROM UNNEST(
                    CAST(:ids AS uuid[]),
                    CAST(:table_ids AS uuid[]),
                    CAST(:names AS varchar[]),
                    CAST(:ordinal_positions AS int[]),
                    CAST(:data_types AS varchar[]),
                    CAST(:raw_data_types AS varchar[]),
                    CAST(:collations AS varchar[]),
                    CAST(:is_nullables AS boolean[]),
                    CAST(:is_primary_keys AS boolean[]),
                    CAST(:is_foreign_keys AS boolean[]),
                    CAST(:default_values AS text[]),
                    CAST(:source_descriptions AS text[]),
                    CAST(:classification_levels AS varchar[])
                ) AS v(id, table_id, name, ordinal_position, data_type, raw_data_type, "collation", is_nullable, is_primary_key, is_foreign_key, default_value, source_description, classification_level)
                ON CONFLICT (table_id, name) DO UPDATE SET
                    ordinal_position = EXCLUDED.ordinal_position,
                    data_type = EXCLUDED.data_type,
                    raw_data_type = EXCLUDED.raw_data_type,
                    "collation" = EXCLUDED."collation",
                    is_nullable = EXCLUDED.is_nullable,
                    is_primary_key = EXCLUDED.is_primary_key,
                    is_foreign_key = EXCLUDED.is_foreign_key,
                    default_value = EXCLUDED.default_value,
                    source_description = EXCLUDED.source_description,
                    classification_level = EXCLUDED.classification_level,
                    status = 'ACTIVE',
                    updated_at = clock_timestamp()
                RETURNING id;
            """)

            col_upsert_res = await session.execute(
                col_upsert_stmt,
                {
                    "ids": col_ids,
                    "table_ids": col_table_ids,
                    "names": col_names,
                    "ordinal_positions": col_ordinal_positions,
                    "data_types": col_data_types,
                    "raw_data_types": col_raw_data_types,
                    "collations": col_collations,
                    "is_nullables": col_is_nullables,
                    "is_primary_keys": col_is_primary_keys,
                    "is_foreign_keys": col_is_foreign_keys,
                    "default_values": col_default_values,
                    "source_descriptions": col_source_descriptions,
                    "classification_levels": col_classification_levels,
                },
            )
            columns_upserted_count = len(col_upsert_res.scalars().all())

        # 4b. Upsert & Refresh Indexes (clean up dropped indexes on scanned tables)
        scanned_table_ids = list(table_id_map.values())
        idx_table_ids: List[uuid.UUID] = []
        idx_names: List[str] = []
        if payload.indexes:
            idx_uniques: List[bool] = []
            idx_primaries: List[bool] = []
            idx_types: List[str] = []
            idx_columns_json: List[str] = []
            idx_definitions: List[Optional[str]] = []

            for idx_p in payload.indexes:
                target_tid = table_id_map.get(idx_p.table_name)
                if not target_tid:
                    continue
                idx_table_ids.append(target_tid)
                idx_names.append(idx_p.name)
                idx_uniques.append(idx_p.is_unique)
                idx_primaries.append(idx_p.is_primary)
                idx_types.append(idx_p.index_type or "BTREE")
                idx_columns_json.append(json.dumps(idx_p.columns_list or []))
                idx_definitions.append(idx_p.definition)

            if idx_table_ids:
                idx_upsert_stmt = text("""
                    INSERT INTO catalog_indexes (
                        id, table_id, schema_id, name, is_unique, is_primary, index_type,
                        columns_list, definition, updated_at
                    )
                    SELECT
                        gen_random_uuid(), v.table_id, :schema_id, v.name, v.is_unique, v.is_primary,
                        v.index_type, v.columns_list::jsonb, v.definition, clock_timestamp()
                    FROM UNNEST(
                        CAST(:table_ids AS uuid[]),
                        CAST(:names AS varchar[]),
                        CAST(:is_uniques AS boolean[]),
                        CAST(:is_primaries AS boolean[]),
                        CAST(:index_types AS varchar[]),
                        CAST(:columns_lists AS text[]),
                        CAST(:definitions AS text[])
                    ) AS v(table_id, name, is_unique, is_primary, index_type, columns_list, definition)
                    ON CONFLICT (table_id, name) DO UPDATE SET
                        is_unique = EXCLUDED.is_unique,
                        is_primary = EXCLUDED.is_primary,
                        index_type = EXCLUDED.index_type,
                        columns_list = EXCLUDED.columns_list,
                        definition = EXCLUDED.definition,
                        updated_at = clock_timestamp();
                """)
                await session.execute(
                    idx_upsert_stmt,
                    {
                        "schema_id": schema_id,
                        "table_ids": idx_table_ids,
                        "names": idx_names,
                        "is_uniques": idx_uniques,
                        "is_primaries": idx_primaries,
                        "index_types": idx_types,
                        "columns_lists": idx_columns_json,
                        "definitions": idx_definitions,
                    },
                )

        # Stale/dropped index cleanup for scanned tables
        if scanned_table_ids and payload.indexes is not None:
            if idx_table_ids:
                clean_idx_stmt = text("""
                    WITH scanned_idx AS (
                        SELECT UNNEST(CAST(:tbl_ids AS uuid[])) AS table_id,
                               UNNEST(CAST(:names AS varchar[])) AS idx_name
                    )
                    DELETE FROM catalog_indexes ci
                    WHERE ci.table_id = ANY(CAST(:distinct_tbl_ids AS uuid[]))
                      AND NOT EXISTS (
                          SELECT 1 FROM scanned_idx si
                          WHERE si.table_id = ci.table_id AND si.idx_name = ci.name
                      );
                """)
                await session.execute(
                    clean_idx_stmt,
                    {
                        "tbl_ids": idx_table_ids,
                        "names": idx_names,
                        "distinct_tbl_ids": scanned_table_ids,
                    },
                )
            elif len(payload.indexes) == 0 and len(payload.tables) > 0:
                clean_idx_stmt = text("""
                    DELETE FROM catalog_indexes
                    WHERE table_id = ANY(CAST(:distinct_tbl_ids AS uuid[]));
                """)
                await session.execute(
                    clean_idx_stmt,
                    {"distinct_tbl_ids": scanned_table_ids},
                )

        # 4c. Upsert & Refresh Routines
        rt_names: List[str] = []
        rt_types: List[str] = []
        if payload.routines:
            rt_languages: List[str] = []
            rt_signatures: List[Optional[str]] = []
            rt_returns: List[Optional[str]] = []
            rt_descriptions: List[Optional[str]] = []

            for r_p in payload.routines:
                rt_names.append(r_p.name)
                rt_types.append(r_p.routine_type or "FUNCTION")
                rt_languages.append(r_p.language or "sql")
                rt_signatures.append(r_p.arguments_signature)
                rt_returns.append(r_p.return_type)
                rt_descriptions.append(r_p.source_description)

            if rt_names:
                rt_upsert_stmt = text("""
                    INSERT INTO catalog_routines (
                        id, schema_id, name, routine_type, language, arguments_signature,
                        return_type, source_description, updated_at
                    )
                    SELECT
                        gen_random_uuid(), :schema_id, v.name, v.routine_type, v.language,
                        v.arguments_signature, v.return_type, v.source_description, clock_timestamp()
                    FROM UNNEST(
                        CAST(:names AS varchar[]),
                        CAST(:routine_types AS varchar[]),
                        CAST(:languages AS varchar[]),
                        CAST(:arguments_signatures AS text[]),
                        CAST(:return_types AS varchar[]),
                        CAST(:source_descriptions AS text[])
                    ) AS v(name, routine_type, language, arguments_signature, return_type, source_description)
                    ON CONFLICT (schema_id, name, routine_type) DO UPDATE SET
                        language = EXCLUDED.language,
                        arguments_signature = EXCLUDED.arguments_signature,
                        return_type = EXCLUDED.return_type,
                        source_description = EXCLUDED.source_description,
                        updated_at = clock_timestamp();
                """)
                await session.execute(
                    rt_upsert_stmt,
                    {
                        "schema_id": schema_id,
                        "names": rt_names,
                        "routine_types": rt_types,
                        "languages": rt_languages,
                        "arguments_signatures": rt_signatures,
                        "return_types": rt_returns,
                        "source_descriptions": rt_descriptions,
                    },
                )

        # Stale/dropped routine cleanup for schema (skipping failed schemas)
        if payload.routines is not None and not (effective_failed_schemas and schema_name in effective_failed_schemas):
            if rt_names:
                clean_rt_stmt = text("""
                    WITH scanned_rt AS (
                        SELECT UNNEST(CAST(:names AS varchar[])) AS rt_name,
                               UNNEST(CAST(:routine_types AS varchar[])) AS rt_type
                    )
                    DELETE FROM catalog_routines cr
                    WHERE cr.schema_id = :schema_id
                      AND NOT EXISTS (
                          SELECT 1 FROM scanned_rt sr
                          WHERE sr.rt_name = cr.name AND sr.rt_type = cr.routine_type
                      );
                """)
                await session.execute(
                    clean_rt_stmt,
                    {
                        "schema_id": schema_id,
                        "names": rt_names,
                        "routine_types": rt_types,
                    },
                )
            elif len(payload.routines) == 0 and len(payload.tables) > 0:
                clean_rt_stmt = text("""
                    DELETE FROM catalog_routines
                    WHERE schema_id = :schema_id;
                """)
                await session.execute(
                    clean_rt_stmt,
                    {"schema_id": schema_id},
                )

        # 5. Soft-delete missing columns for scanned tables (Set-based vectorized sweep)
        if scanned_table_ids:
            if col_ids:
                soft_del_col_stmt = text("""
                    WITH scanned AS (
                        SELECT UNNEST(CAST(:tbl_ids AS uuid[])) AS table_id,
                               UNNEST(CAST(:c_names AS varchar[])) AS col_name
                    )
                    UPDATE catalog_columns c
                    SET status = 'DELETED', updated_at = clock_timestamp()
                    WHERE c.table_id = ANY(CAST(:distinct_tbl_ids AS uuid[]))
                      AND c.status != 'DELETED'
                      AND NOT EXISTS (
                          SELECT 1 FROM scanned s WHERE s.table_id = c.table_id AND s.col_name = c.name
                      )
                    RETURNING c.id;
                """)
                soft_del_col_res = await session.execute(
                    soft_del_col_stmt,
                    {
                        "tbl_ids": col_table_ids,
                        "c_names": col_names,
                        "distinct_tbl_ids": scanned_table_ids,
                    },
                )
            else:
                soft_del_col_stmt = text("""
                    UPDATE catalog_columns
                    SET status = 'DELETED', updated_at = clock_timestamp()
                    WHERE table_id = ANY(CAST(:distinct_tbl_ids AS uuid[]))
                      AND status != 'DELETED'
                    RETURNING id;
                """)
                soft_del_col_res = await session.execute(
                    soft_del_col_stmt,
                    {"distinct_tbl_ids": scanned_table_ids},
                )
            columns_deleted_count = len(soft_del_col_res.scalars().all())

        # 6. Soft-delete missing tables for this schema with failed_schemas guard
        deleted_tbl_rows = await self.soft_delete_missing_entities(
            session=session,
            schema_id=schema_id,
            schema_name=schema_name,
            scanned_table_names=ingested_table_names,
            failed_schemas=effective_failed_schemas,
        )
        tables_deleted_count = len(deleted_tbl_rows)

        # 7. In-place stats recording into table_statistics_history (T060)
        if payload.tables:
            stat_table_ids = [table_id_map[t.name] for t in payload.tables if t.name in table_id_map]
            stat_row_counts = [t.row_count_estimate for t in payload.tables if t.name in table_id_map]
            stat_sizes = [t.size_bytes for t in payload.tables if t.name in table_id_map]
            await self.record_table_statistics(
                session=session,
                table_ids=stat_table_ids,
                row_counts=stat_row_counts,
                sizes=stat_sizes,
                sync_job_id=effective_sync_job_id,
            )

        await session.flush()

        # 8. Automatically trigger TableVersion snapshots and SchemaChangeLog entries
        # Only captures versions when structural schema changes occurred (T060 & T063)
        all_affected_table_ids = list(set(table_id_map.values()) | set(deleted_tbl_rows))
        created_versions = await version_service.capture_versions_batch(
            session=session,
            table_ids=all_affected_table_ids,
            actor_id=actor_id,
            actor_username=actor_username,
        )
        versions_created_count = len(created_versions)

        # 9. Record immutable audit log entry in the same transaction
        await record_audit_event(
            session=session,
            actor_username=actor_username,
            action="BULK_METADATA_INGESTION",
            entity_type=EntityType.SCHEMA,
            entity_id=schema_id,
            actor_id=actor_id,
            diff_jsonb={
                "connection_id": str(payload.connection_id),
                "schema_name": payload.schema_name,
                "tables_upserted": tables_upserted_count,
                "tables_deleted": tables_deleted_count,
                "columns_upserted": columns_upserted_count,
                "columns_deleted": columns_deleted_count,
                "versions_created": versions_created_count,
            },
            flush=True,
        )

        return BulkIngestionResponse(
            success=True,
            connection_id=payload.connection_id,
            schema_id=schema_id,
            schema_name=schema_name,
            tables_upserted=tables_upserted_count,
            tables_deleted=tables_deleted_count,
            columns_upserted=columns_upserted_count,
            columns_deleted=columns_deleted_count,
            versions_created=versions_created_count,
        )

from __future__ import annotations

import enum
import logging
from typing import Optional, Union
import uuid

from sqlalchemy import func, select
from sqlalchemy.ext.asyncio import AsyncSession

from backend.src.models.catalog import CatalogColumn, CatalogTable
from backend.src.models.rbac import EntityType
from backend.src.models.versioning import SchemaChangeLog, SchemaChangeType
from backend.src.services.audit.audit_service import record_audit_event

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)


class DriftResolutionAction(str, enum.Enum):
    """Actions available for resolving description drift conflicts."""

    RETAIN_APPROVED = "RETAIN_APPROVED"
    OVERWRITE_WITH_SOURCE = "OVERWRITE_WITH_SOURCE"
    CUSTOM_MERGE = "CUSTOM_MERGE"


class DriftService:
    """
    Service responsible for detecting divergence between database native comments and
    human-curated catalog descriptions, and resolving conflicts via three supported workflows:
    - RETAIN_APPROVED: Keeps the curated approved description intact and clears the drift flag.
    - OVERWRITE_WITH_SOURCE: Overwrites approved description with the native DB comment.
    - CUSTOM_MERGE: Blends or replaces descriptions with user-provided merged text.
    """

    async def detect_and_flag_drift(
        self,
        session: AsyncSession,
        entity: Union[CatalogTable, CatalogColumn],
        extracted_comment: Optional[str],
        actor_id: Optional[uuid.UUID] = None,
    ) -> bool:
        """
        Detects if extracted database comment diverges from both current source_description
        and existing approved_description. If drift detected, flags entity and creates
        SchemaChangeLog(DESCRIPTION_DRIFT) without incrementing TableVersion.
        """
        has_curated_desc = bool(
            entity.approved_description and entity.approved_description.strip()
        )
        source_changed = extracted_comment != entity.source_description
        differs_from_curated = (
            extracted_comment != entity.approved_description
            if has_curated_desc
            else False
        )

        if has_curated_desc and source_changed and differs_from_curated:
            entity.description_drift_detected = True
            entity.updated_at = func.clock_timestamp()

            table_id = (
                entity.id if isinstance(entity, CatalogTable) else entity.table_id
            )
            col_name = entity.name if isinstance(entity, CatalogColumn) else None

            change_log = SchemaChangeLog(
                id=uuid.uuid4(),
                table_id=table_id,
                version_id=None,  # Drift does not increment structural TableVersion
                change_type=SchemaChangeType.DESCRIPTION_DRIFT,
                column_name=col_name,
                old_value={
                    "source_description": entity.source_description,
                    "approved_description": entity.approved_description,
                },
                new_value={
                    "source_description": extracted_comment,
                },
                actor_id=actor_id,
            )
            session.add(change_log)
            entity.source_description = extracted_comment
            await session.flush()
            return True

        # If no drift, simply update source_description to stay in sync with DB
        if source_changed:
            entity.source_description = extracted_comment
            entity.updated_at = func.clock_timestamp()
            await session.flush()

        return False

    async def resolve_table_drift(
        self,
        session: AsyncSession,
        table_id: uuid.UUID,
        resolution_action: Union[str, DriftResolutionAction],
        custom_text: Optional[str] = None,
        actor_id: Optional[uuid.UUID] = None,
        actor_username: str = "system",
    ) -> CatalogTable:
        """Resolves description drift on a catalog table."""
        stmt = select(CatalogTable).where(CatalogTable.id == table_id)
        res = await session.execute(stmt)
        table = res.scalar_one_or_none()
        if not table:
            raise ValueError(f"Table with ID '{table_id}' not found.")

        action = (
            resolution_action.value
            if hasattr(resolution_action, "value")
            else str(resolution_action)
        )

        if action == DriftResolutionAction.RETAIN_APPROVED.value:
            # Retain approved description as is, clear drift flag
            table.description_drift_detected = False
        elif action == DriftResolutionAction.OVERWRITE_WITH_SOURCE.value:
            # Overwrite approved description with source comment
            table.approved_description = table.source_description
            table.description_source = "SOURCE_DB"
            table.curated_by_id = actor_id
            table.curated_by_username = actor_username
            table.curated_at = func.clock_timestamp()
            table.description_drift_detected = False
        elif action == DriftResolutionAction.CUSTOM_MERGE.value:
            if custom_text is None:
                raise ValueError("custom_text must be provided for CUSTOM_MERGE action.")
            table.approved_description = custom_text
            table.description_source = "HUMAN"
            table.curated_by_id = actor_id
            table.curated_by_username = actor_username
            table.curated_at = func.clock_timestamp()
            table.description_drift_detected = False
        else:
            raise ValueError(f"Unknown drift resolution action: {action}")

        table.updated_at = func.clock_timestamp()

        # Audit Log Entry
        await record_audit_event(
            session=session,
            actor_username=actor_username,
            action="RESOLVE_TABLE_DESCRIPTION_DRIFT",
            entity_type=EntityType.TABLE,
            entity_id=table.id,
            actor_id=actor_id,
            diff_jsonb={
                "action": action,
                "approved_description": table.approved_description,
                "source_description": table.source_description,
            },
            flush=True,
        )

        return table

    async def resolve_column_drift(
        self,
        session: AsyncSession,
        column_id: uuid.UUID,
        resolution_action: Union[str, DriftResolutionAction],
        custom_text: Optional[str] = None,
        actor_id: Optional[uuid.UUID] = None,
        actor_username: str = "system",
    ) -> CatalogColumn:
        """Resolves description drift on a catalog column."""
        stmt = select(CatalogColumn).where(CatalogColumn.id == column_id)
        res = await session.execute(stmt)
        column = res.scalar_one_or_none()
        if not column:
            raise ValueError(f"Column with ID '{column_id}' not found.")

        action = (
            resolution_action.value
            if hasattr(resolution_action, "value")
            else str(resolution_action)
        )

        if action == DriftResolutionAction.RETAIN_APPROVED.value:
            column.description_drift_detected = False
        elif action == DriftResolutionAction.OVERWRITE_WITH_SOURCE.value:
            column.approved_description = column.source_description
            column.description_source = "SOURCE_DB"
            column.curated_by_id = actor_id
            column.curated_by_username = actor_username
            column.curated_at = func.clock_timestamp()
            column.description_drift_detected = False
        elif action == DriftResolutionAction.CUSTOM_MERGE.value:
            if custom_text is None:
                raise ValueError("custom_text must be provided for CUSTOM_MERGE action.")
            column.approved_description = custom_text
            column.description_source = "HUMAN"
            column.curated_by_id = actor_id
            column.curated_by_username = actor_username
            column.curated_at = func.clock_timestamp()
            column.description_drift_detected = False
        else:
            raise ValueError(f"Unknown drift resolution action: {action}")

        column.updated_at = func.clock_timestamp()

        # Audit Log Entry
        await record_audit_event(
            session=session,
            actor_username=actor_username,
            action="RESOLVE_COLUMN_DESCRIPTION_DRIFT",
            entity_type=EntityType.COLUMN,
            entity_id=column.id,
            actor_id=actor_id,
            diff_jsonb={
                "action": action,
                "approved_description": column.approved_description,
                "source_description": column.source_description,
            },
            flush=True,
        )

        return column


drift_service = DriftService()
