=== FILE: D:\datacatalog\frontend\src\app\features\catalog\stores\catalog.store.ts ===
import { Injectable, computed, inject, signal } from '@angular/core';
import { HttpClient, HttpParams } from '@angular/common/http';
import { firstValueFrom } from 'rxjs';
import {
  BulkTagRequest,
  CatalogObjectsResponse,
  CategoryTreeNode,
  ChangeLogItem,
  ColumnItem,
  KeysetPageInfo,
  PhysicalDatabaseNode,
  SearchHit,
  SearchResponse,
  TableDetail,
  TableItem,
} from '../models/catalog.models';

export interface CatalogFilterOptions {
  database?: string;
  schema?: string;
  classification?: string;
  status?: string;
  tag?: string;
  category?: string;
  missing_descriptions_only?: boolean;
  sort_by?: string;
  min_rows?: number;
}

@Injectable({
  providedIn: 'root',
})
export class CatalogStore {
  private readonly http = inject(HttpClient);

  // Private state signals
  private readonly _tables = signal<TableItem[]>([]);
  private readonly _searchHits = signal<SearchHit[]>([]);
  private readonly _pageInfo = signal<KeysetPageInfo | null>(null);
  private readonly _isLoading = signal<boolean>(false);
  private readonly _activeFilter = signal<string>('');
  private readonly _activeFilterOptions = signal<CatalogFilterOptions>({});
  private readonly _error = signal<string | null>(null);

  // Public readonly selectors
  readonly tables = this._tables.asReadonly();
  readonly searchHits = this._searchHits.asReadonly();
  readonly isLoading = this._isLoading.asReadonly();
  readonly pageInfo = this._pageInfo.asReadonly();
  readonly activeFilter = this._activeFilter.asReadonly();
  readonly activeFilterOptions = this._activeFilterOptions.asReadonly();
  readonly error = this._error.asReadonly();

  // Computed signals
  readonly hasMore = computed<boolean>(() => this._pageInfo()?.has_next_page ?? false);
  readonly totalHitCount = computed<number>(() => this._searchHits().length);

  /**
   * Executes keyset-paginated search against the catalog API.
   * If reset is true, clears accumulated results and starts from beginning.
   */
  async search(
    query: string = '',
    reset: boolean = true,
    filters?: CatalogFilterOptions
  ): Promise<void> {
    if (reset) {
      this._searchHits.set([]);
      this._pageInfo.set(null);
      this._activeFilter.set(query);
      if (filters !== undefined) {
        this._activeFilterOptions.set(filters);
      }
    }

    this._isLoading.set(true);
    this._error.set(null);

    const activeOpts = filters !== undefined ? filters : this._activeFilterOptions();
    const cursor = reset ? '' : (this._pageInfo()?.next_cursor || '');
    let url = `/api/v1/search?q=${encodeURIComponent(query)}&limit=50&cursor=${cursor}`;

    if (activeOpts.database) {
      url += `&database=${encodeURIComponent(activeOpts.database)}`;
    }
    if (activeOpts.schema) {
      url += `&schema=${encodeURIComponent(activeOpts.schema)}`;
    }
    if (activeOpts.classification) {
      url += `&classification=${encodeURIComponent(activeOpts.classification)}`;
    }
    if (activeOpts.status) {
      url += `&status=${encodeURIComponent(activeOpts.status)}`;
    }
    if (activeOpts.tag) {
      url += `&tag=${encodeURIComponent(activeOpts.tag)}`;
    }
    if (activeOpts.category) {
      url += `&category=${encodeURIComponent(activeOpts.category)}`;
    }
    if (activeOpts.missing_descriptions_only) {
      url += `&missing_descriptions_only=true`;
    }
    if (activeOpts.sort_by) {
      url += `&sort_by=${encodeURIComponent(activeOpts.sort_by)}`;
    }
    if (activeOpts.min_rows !== undefined && activeOpts.min_rows !== null) {
      url += `&min_rows=${activeOpts.min_rows}`;
    }

    try {
      const resp = await firstValueFrom(this.http.get<SearchResponse>(url));
      this._searchHits.update(current => (reset ? resp.items : [...current, ...resp.items]));
      this._pageInfo.set(resp.page_info);
    } catch (err: unknown) {
      const msg = err instanceof Error ? err.message : 'Catalog search request failed';
      this._error.set(msg);
      throw err;
    } finally {
      this._isLoading.set(false);
    }
  }

  /**
   * Appends the next keyset page to the existing search results.
   */
  async loadNextPage(): Promise<void> {
    if (this._isLoading() || !this.hasMore()) {
      return;
    }
    const currentQuery = this._activeFilter();
    await this.search(currentQuery, false);
  }

  /**
   * Updates approved description for a table and synchronizes reactive state.
   */
  async updateDescription(tableId: string, approvedDescription: string): Promise<void> {
    const updated = await firstValueFrom(
      this.http.patch<{ id: string; effective_description: string }>(
        `/api/v1/tables/${tableId}/description`,
        { approved_description: approvedDescription }
      )
    );

    const newDesc = updated.effective_description;

    this._tables.update(list =>
      list.map(t => (t.id === tableId ? { ...t, effective_description: newDesc } : t))
    );

    this._searchHits.update(list =>
      list.map(hit => (hit.id === tableId ? { ...hit, effective_description: newDesc } : hit))
    );
  }

  /**
   * Updates owner for a table and synchronizes reactive state.
   */
  async updateTableOwner(tableId: string, owner: string): Promise<TableDetail> {
    const updated = await firstValueFrom(
      this.http.patch<TableDetail>(
        `/api/v1/tables/${tableId}/owner`,
        { owner }
      )
    );

    this._tables.update(list =>
      list.map(t => (t.id === tableId ? { ...t, owner: updated.owner } : t))
    );

    return updated;
  }

  /**
   * Retrieves full table details including columns and tags.
   */
  async getTableDetails(tableId: string): Promise<TableDetail> {
    return firstValueFrom(this.http.get<TableDetail>(`/api/v1/tables/${tableId}`));
  }

  /**
   * Approves AI-suggested description for a table.
   */
  async approveAiTableDescription(tableId: string): Promise<TableDetail> {
    const updated = await firstValueFrom(
      this.http.post<TableDetail>(`/api/v1/tables/${tableId}/approve-ai-description`, {})
    );
    this._tables.update((list) =>
      list.map((t) => (t.id === tableId ? { ...t, effective_description: updated.effective_description } : t))
    );
    this._searchHits.update((list) =>
      list.map((hit) => (hit.id === tableId ? { ...hit, effective_description: updated.effective_description } : hit))
    );
    return updated;
  }

  /**
   * Approves AI-suggested description for a column.
   */
  async approveAiColumnDescription(columnId: string): Promise<ColumnItem> {
    return firstValueFrom(
      this.http.post<ColumnItem>(`/api/v1/columns/${columnId}/approve-ai-description`, {})
    );
  }

  /**
   * Updates approved description for a column.
   */
  async updateColumnDescription(columnId: string, approvedDescription: string): Promise<ColumnItem> {
    return firstValueFrom(
      this.http.patch<ColumnItem>(`/api/v1/columns/${columnId}/description`, {
        approved_description: approvedDescription,
      })
    );
  }

  /**
   * Updates security classification for a column.
   */
  async updateColumnClassification(columnId: string, classificationLevel: string): Promise<ColumnItem> {
    return firstValueFrom(
      this.http.patch<ColumnItem>(`/api/v1/columns/${columnId}/classification`, {
        classification_level: classificationLevel,
      })
    );
  }

  /**
   * Fetches change log history for a table.
   */
  async getTableHistory(tableId: string): Promise<ChangeLogItem[]> {
    return firstValueFrom(this.http.get<ChangeLogItem[]>(`/api/v1/tables/${tableId}/change-logs`));
  }

  /**
   * Fetches physical database tree with optional advanced search and filtering.
   */
  async getPhysicalTree(filters?: {
    search?: string;
    engine_type?: string;
    host?: string;
    owner?: string;
    is_active?: boolean;
  }): Promise<PhysicalDatabaseNode[]> {
    let params = new HttpParams();
    if (filters?.search) params = params.set('search', filters.search);
    if (filters?.engine_type) params = params.set('engine_type', filters.engine_type);
    if (filters?.host) params = params.set('host', filters.host);
    if (filters?.owner) params = params.set('owner', filters.owner);
    if (filters?.is_active !== undefined) params = params.set('is_active', String(filters.is_active));
    return firstValueFrom(this.http.get<PhysicalDatabaseNode[]>('/api/v1/tables/tree/physical', { params }));
  }

  /**
   * Fetches dedicated catalog objects (Tables, Views, Indexes, Procedures, Functions) for a given scope.
   */
  async getCatalogObjects(scope?: {
    database?: string;
    schema?: string;
    table_id?: string;
    object_type?: string;
  }): Promise<CatalogObjectsResponse> {
    let params = new HttpParams();
    if (scope?.database) params = params.set('database', scope.database);
    if (scope?.schema) params = params.set('schema', scope.schema);
    if (scope?.table_id) params = params.set('table_id', scope.table_id);
    if (scope?.object_type) params = params.set('object_type', scope.object_type);
    return firstValueFrom(this.http.get<CatalogObjectsResponse>('/api/v1/catalog/objects', { params }));
  }

  /**
   * Fetches category business hierarchy tree.
   */
  async getCategoryTree(): Promise<CategoryTreeNode[]> {
    return firstValueFrom(this.http.get<CategoryTreeNode[]>('/api/v1/categories/tree'));
  }

  async loadCategoryTree(): Promise<CategoryTreeNode[]> {
    return this.getCategoryTree();
  }

  /**
   * Executes bulk tag assignment across entities.
   */
  async bulkTag(request: BulkTagRequest): Promise<{ success: boolean; affected_count: number }> {
    return firstValueFrom(
      this.http.post<{ success: boolean; affected_count: number }>('/api/v1/tags/bulk-assign', request)
    );
  }

  /**
   * Sets searchHits directly (useful for testing and component state priming).
   */
  setSearchHits(hits: SearchHit[]): void {
    this._searchHits.set(hits);
  }

  /**
   * Sets tables directly.
   */
  setTables(tables: TableItem[]): void {
    this._tables.set(tables);
  }

  /**
   * Resets all store state to initial defaults.
   */
  reset(): void {
    this._tables.set([]);
    this._searchHits.set([]);
    this._pageInfo.set(null);
    this._isLoading.set(false);
    this._activeFilter.set('');
    this._activeFilterOptions.set({});
    this._error.set(null);
  }
}

  // Description Display Policy: 'APPROVED_FIRST' | 'SOURCE_FIRST' | 'BOTH'
  readonly descPolicy = signal<DescriptionPolicy>('BOTH');

  // Search & Filter State
  searchQuery = '';
  selectedDatabase = '';
  selectedSchema = '';
  selectedClassification = '';
  selectedStatus = '';
  selectedCategory = '';
  missingDescriptionsOnly = signal<boolean>(false);
  selectedSortBy = signal<string>('row_count_desc');
  hideLowRowTables = signal<boolean>(false);

  // Advanced Tree Filtering State
  readonly dbSearchFilter = signal<string>('');
  readonly dbHostFilter = signal<string>('');
  readonly dbEngineFilter = signal<string>('');
  readonly dbOwnerFilter = signal<string>('');

  // Trees State
  activeTreeTab = signal<'physical' | 'category'>('physical');
  physicalTree = signal<PhysicalDatabaseNode[]>([]);
  categoryTree = signal<CategoryTreeNode[]>([]);
  isTreeLoading = signal<boolean>(false);
  isSidebarExpanded = signal<boolean>(true);

  // Filtered physical database tree based on search & filter criteria
  readonly filteredPhysicalTree = computed<PhysicalDatabaseNode[]>(() => {
    const term = this.dbSearchFilter().trim().toLowerCase();
    const hostTerm = this.dbHostFilter().trim().toLowerCase();
    const engineTerm = this.dbEngineFilter().trim().toUpperCase();
    const ownerTerm = this.dbOwnerFilter().trim().toLowerCase();

    return this.physicalTree().filter((conn) => {
      if (term) {
        const matchesName = (conn.name || '').toLowerCase().includes(term);
        const matchesDb = (conn.database_name || '').toLowerCase().includes(term);
        if (!matchesName && !matchesDb) return false;
      }
      if (hostTerm) {
        if (!conn.host || !conn.host.toLowerCase().includes(hostTerm)) return false;
      }
      if (engineTerm) {
        if (!conn.engine_type || conn.engine_type.toUpperCase() !== engineTerm) return false;
      }
      if (ownerTerm) {
        if (!conn.owner || !conn.owner.toLowerCase().includes(ownerTerm)) return false;
      }
      return true;
    });
  });

  clearDbFilters(): void {
    this.dbSearchFilter.set('');
    this.dbHostFilter.set('');
    this.dbEngineFilter.set('');
    this.dbOwnerFilter.set('');
  }

  // 5 Dedicated Object Tabs State
  readonly activeObjectTab = signal<'tables' | 'views' | 'indexes' | 'procedures' | 'functions'>('tables');
  readonly catalogObjects = signal<CatalogObjectsResponse | null>(null);
  readonly isLoadingObjects = signal<boolean>(false);

  readonly objectCounts = computed(() => {
    const objs = this.catalogObjects();
    return {
      tables: objs?.counts?.tables ?? this.store.searchHits().length,
      views: objs?.counts?.views ?? 0,
      indexes: objs?.counts?.indexes ?? 0,
      procedures: objs?.counts?.procedures ?? 0,
      functions: objs?.counts?.functions ?? 0,
    };
  });

  selectedTableIds = signal<Set<string>>(new Set());

  // Table Detail Inspector Drawer
  selectedTable = signal<TableDetail | null>(null);
  selectedTableId = signal<string | null>(null);
  activeInspectorTab = signal<'columns' | 'metadata' | 'indexes' | 'history' | 'statistics'>('columns');
  isInspectorLoading = signal<boolean>(false);
  tableHistory = signal<ChangeLogItem[]>([]);
  showDriftResolution = signal<boolean>(false);

  // Table Inspector Indexes (filtered specifically for selectedTable().id)
  readonly tableSpecificIndexes = signal<CatalogObjectItem[] | null>(null);

  readonly tableIndexes = computed<CatalogObjectItem[]>(() => {
    const tbl = this.selectedTable();
    if (!tbl) return [];

    const specific = this.tableSpecificIndexes();
    if (specific !== null) {
      return specific;
    }

    const allIndexes = this.catalogObjects()?.indexes || [];
    return allIndexes.filter((idx) => {
      const idxTableId = idx.details?.['table_id'];
      if (idxTableId) {
        return idxTableId === tbl.id;
      }
      return idx.table_name === tbl.name;
    });
  });

  readonly kpiDocumentedPct = computed(() => {
    const hits = this.store.searchHits();
    if (hits.length === 0) return 0;
    const docCount = hits.filter(
      (h) => Boolean(h.approved_description?.trim() || h.source_description?.trim() || h.effective_description?.trim())
    ).length;

  readonly kpiSensitiveColumnsCount = computed(() => {

  ngOnInit(): void {
    // 0. Load persisted description display policy
    try {
      if (typeof localStorage !== 'undefined') {
        const savedPolicy = localStorage.getItem('datacatalog_desc_policy') as DescriptionPolicy;
        if (savedPolicy === 'APPROVED_FIRST' || savedPolicy === 'SOURCE_FIRST' || savedPolicy === 'BOTH') {
          this.descPolicy.set(savedPolicy);

        if (q !== undefined && q !== this.searchQuery) {
          this.searchQuery = q;

  getDisplayDescription(hit: SearchHit): {
    policy: DescriptionPolicy;
    primaryText: string;
    origin: 'approved' | 'source' | 'none';
    secondaryText?: string;
    secondaryOrigin?: 'approved' | 'source';
  } {
    const policy = this.descPolicy();
    const app = hit.approved_description?.trim();
    const src = hit.source_description?.trim();
    const eff = hit.effective_description?.trim();

    if (policy === 'APPROVED_FIRST') {
      if (app) {
        return { policy, primaryText: app, origin: 'approved' };
      }
      if (src) {
        return { policy, primaryText: src, origin: 'source' };
      }
      if (eff) {
        return { policy, primaryText: eff, origin: 'source' };
      }
      return { policy, primaryText: 'ط¨ط¯ظˆظ† طھظˆط¶غŒط­ط§طھ ط«ط¨طھ ط´ط¯ظ‡', origin: 'none' };
    }

    if (policy === 'SOURCE_FIRST') {
      if (src) {
        return { policy, primaryText: src, origin: 'source' };
      }
      if (app) {
        return { policy, primaryText: app, origin: 'approved' };
      }
      if (eff) {
        return { policy, primaryText: eff, origin: 'source' };
      }
      return { policy, primaryText: 'ط¨ط¯ظˆظ† طھظˆط¶غŒط­ط§طھ ط«ط¨طھ ط´ط¯ظ‡', origin: 'none' };
    }

    // BOTH
    if (app && src) {
      return {
        policy,
        primaryText: app,
        origin: 'approved',
        secondaryText: src,
        secondaryOrigin: 'source',
      };
    }
    if (app) {
      return { policy, primaryText: app, origin: 'approved' };
    }
    if (src) {
      return { policy, primaryText: src, origin: 'source' };
    }
    if (eff) {
      return { policy, primaryText: eff, origin: 'source' };
    }
    return { policy, primaryText: 'ط¨ط¯ظˆظ† طھظˆط¶غŒط­ط§طھ ط«ط¨طھ ط´ط¯ظ‡', origin: 'none' };
  }

  executeSearch(): void {
    const filters = {
      database: this.selectedDatabase || undefined,
      schema: this.selectedSchema || undefined,
      classification: this.selectedClassification || undefined,
      status: this.selectedStatus || undefined,
      category: this.selectedCategory || undefined,
      missing_descriptions_only: this.missingDescriptionsOnly() || undefined,
      sort_by: this.selectedSortBy(),
      min_rows: this.hideLowRowTables() ? 10 : undefined,
    };
    this.store.search(this.searchQuery, true, filters).catch(() => {
      this.showToast('ط®ط·ط§ ط¯ط± ط¨ط±ظ‚ط±ط§ط±غŒ ط§ط±طھط¨ط§ط· ط¨ط§ ط³ط±ظˆط± ظ…طھط§ط¯غŒطھط§', 'error');
    });
    this.loadCatalogObjects();

  isTableEmpty(hit: SearchHit): boolean {
    return (hit.row_count_estimate || 0) === 0;
  }

  isTableLowRow(hit: SearchHit): boolean {
    const c = hit.row_count_estimate || 0;
    return c >= 1 && c < 10;
  }

  resetFilters(): void {
    this.searchQuery = '';
    this.selectedDatabase = '';

    this.selectedClassification = '';
    this.selectedStatus = '';
    this.selectedCategory = '';

  clearSelection(): void {

  async loadTrees(): Promise<void> {
    this.isTreeLoading.set(true);
    try {
      const [phys, cat] = await Promise.all([
        this.store.getPhysicalTree(),
        this.store.getCategoryTree(),
      ]);
      this.physicalTree.set(phys);
      this.categoryTree.set(cat);
    } catch {
      // Ignored or handled gracefully
    } finally {
      this.isTreeLoading.set(false);
    }
  }

  // Tree Node Selection Handlers

  // Selection Checkbox Handlers
  toggleTableSelection(id: string): void {
    this.selectedTableIds.update((current) => {
      const next = new Set(current);
      if (next.has(id)) {
        next.delete(id);
      } else {
        next.add(id);
      }
      return next;
    });
  }

  toggleSelectAll(): void {
    const hits = this.store.searchHits();
    const current = this.selectedTableIds();
    if (current.size === hits.length && hits.length > 0) {
      this.selectedTableIds.set(new Set());
    } else {
      this.selectedTableIds.set(new Set(hits.map((h) => h.id)));
    }
  }

  isTableSelected(id: string): boolean {
    return this.selectedTableIds().has(id);
  }

  // Table Detail Inspector Drawer
  async inspectTable(tableId: string): Promise<void> {
    this.isEditingOwner.set(false);
    this.selectedTableId.set(tableId);
    this.isInspectorLoading.set(true);
    this.tableSpecificIndexes.set(null);
    try {
      const [detail, history, objRes] = await Promise.all([
        this.store.getTableDetails(tableId),
        this.store.getTableHistory(tableId),
        this.store.getCatalogObjects({ table_id: tableId }).catch(() => null),
      ]);
      this.selectedTable.set(detail);
      this.tableHistory.set(history);
      if (objRes && Array.isArray(objRes.indexes)) {
        this.tableSpecificIndexes.set(objRes.indexes);
      }
    } catch {
      this.showToast('ط¹ط¯ظ… ط¯ط³طھط±ط³غŒ غŒط§ ط®ط·ط§ ط¯ط± ط¨ط§ط±ع¯ط°ط§ط±غŒ ط´ظ†ط§ط³ظ†ط§ظ…ظ‡ ط¬ط¯ظˆظ„', 'error');
      this.selectedTable.set(null);
    } finally {
      this.isInspectorLoading.set(false);
    }
  }

  closeInspector(): void {
    this.isEditingOwner.set(false);
    this.selectedTable.set(null);
    this.selectedTableId.set(null);
    this.tableSpecificIndexes.set(null);
  }

  // AI Suggestion Approvals
  async approveAiTableDescription(tableId: string): Promise<void> {
    try {
      const updated = await this.store.approveAiTableDescription(tableId);
      this.selectedTable.set(updated);

      next: (res) => {
        // Backend returns in DESC order, reverse for chronological chart view

import { Injectable, inject } from '@angular/core';
import { HttpClient, HttpParams } from '@angular/common/http';
import { Observable } from 'rxjs';
import {
  ConnectionCreateRequest,
  ConnectionTestResult,
  DatabaseConnection,
} from '../models/connection.models';
import { CategoryTreeNode } from '../../catalog/models/catalog.models';

@Injectable({
  providedIn: 'root',
})
export class ConnectionService {
  private readonly http = inject(HttpClient);
  private readonly baseUrl = '/api/v1/connections';

  /**
   * Retrieves business category hierarchy tree.
   */
  getCategoryTree(): Observable<CategoryTreeNode[]> {
    return this.http.get<CategoryTreeNode[]>('/api/v1/categories/tree');
  }

  /**
   * Retrieves all registered database connections with optional active filter.
   */
  getConnections(isActive?: boolean): Observable<DatabaseConnection[]> {
    let params = new HttpParams();
    if (isActive !== undefined) {
      params = params.set('is_active', isActive.toString());
    }
    return this.http.get<DatabaseConnection[]>(this.baseUrl, { params });
  }

  /**
   * Retrieves single database connection by ID.
   */
  getConnection(id: string): Observable<DatabaseConnection> {
    return this.http.get<DatabaseConnection>(`${this.baseUrl}/${id}`);
  }

  /**
   * Registers a new database connection with envelope encrypted credentials.
   */
  createConnection(request: ConnectionCreateRequest): Observable<DatabaseConnection> {
    return this.http.post<DatabaseConnection>(this.baseUrl, request);
  }

  /**
   * Updates an existing database connection.
   */
  updateConnection(id: string, request: Partial<ConnectionCreateRequest>): Observable<DatabaseConnection> {
    return this.http.put<DatabaseConnection>(`${this.baseUrl}/${id}`, request);
  }

  /**
   * Deletes a database connection.
   */
  deleteConnection(id: string): Observable<void> {
    return this.http.delete<void>(`${this.baseUrl}/${id}`);
  }

  /**
   * Executes live dialect connection ping test with 5s timeout.
   */
  testConnection(id: string): Observable<ConnectionTestResult> {
    return this.http.post<ConnectionTestResult>(`${this.baseUrl}/${id}/test`, {});
  }

  /**
   * Auto-discovers non-template databases from host.
   */
  discoverDatabases(payload: {
    engine_type: string;
    host: string;
    port: number;
    credentials: { username: string; password?: string };
    custom_params?: any;
  }): Observable<{ success: boolean; databases: string[]; latency_ms: number; server_version?: string; message: string }> {
    return this.http.post<{ success: boolean; databases: string[]; latency_ms: number; server_version?: string; message: string }>(
      `${this.baseUrl}/discover-databases`,
      payload
    );
  }

  /**
   * Executes live diagnostic connectivity test on unsaved connection payload before saving.
   */
  testUnsavedConnection(payload: {
    engine_type: string;
    host: string;
    port: number;
    database_name: string;
    credentials: { username: string; password?: string };
    custom_params?: any;
  }): Observable<ConnectionTestResult> {
    return this.http.post<ConnectionTestResult>(`${this.baseUrl}/test-unsaved`, payload);
  }
}


=== FILE: D:\datacatalog\frontend\src\app\features\connections\validators\cron.validator.ts ===
import { AbstractControl, ValidationErrors, ValidatorFn } from '@angular/forms';

const MONTH_NAMES: Record<string, number> = {
  JAN: 1,
  FEB: 2,
  MAR: 3,
  APR: 4,
  MAY: 5,
  JUN: 6,
  JUL: 7,
  AUG: 8,
  SEP: 9,
  OCT: 10,
  NOV: 11,
  DEC: 12,
};

const DOW_NAMES: Record<string, number> = {
  SUN: 0,
  MON: 1,
  TUE: 2,
  WED: 3,
  THU: 4,
  FRI: 5,
  SAT: 6,
};

interface FieldBound {
  name: string;
  min: number;
  max: number;
  nameMap?: Record<string, number>;
}

const FIELD_BOUNDS: FieldBound[] = [
  { name: 'minute', min: 0, max: 59 },
  { name: 'hour', min: 0, max: 23 },
  { name: 'day of month', min: 1, max: 31 },
  { name: 'month', min: 1, max: 12, nameMap: MONTH_NAMES },
  { name: 'day of week', min: 0, max: 7, nameMap: DOW_NAMES },
];

function parseToken(token: string, nameMap?: Record<string, number>): number {
  const upper = token.toUpperCase();
  if (nameMap && upper in nameMap) {
    return nameMap[upper];
  }
  if (!/^\d+$/.test(token)) {
    throw new Error(`Invalid token: '${token}'`);
  }
  return parseInt(token, 10);
}

function validateField(
  fieldStr: string,
  bound: FieldBound
): void {
  if (!fieldStr || fieldStr.trim() === '') {
    throw new Error(`Field '${bound.name}' cannot be empty`);
  }

  const items = fieldStr.split(',');
  for (const item of items) {
    if (!item) {
      throw new Error(`Empty element in field '${bound.name}'`);
    }

    let base = item;
    if (item.includes('/')) {
      const parts = item.split('/');
      if (parts.length !== 2) {
        throw new Error(`Invalid step expression '${item}' in field '${bound.name}'`);
      }
      base = parts[0];
      const stepStr = parts[1];
      if (!/^\d+$/.test(stepStr)) {
        throw new Error(`Step '${stepStr}' must be a positive integer in field '${bound.name}'`);
      }
      const step = parseInt(stepStr, 10);
      if (step < 1) {
        throw new Error(`Step must be >= 1 in field '${bound.name}'`);
      }
      if (base === '*') {
        continue;
      }
    }

    if (base === '*') {
      continue;
    }

    if (base.includes('-')) {
      const rangeParts = base.split('-');
      if (rangeParts.length !== 2) {
        throw new Error(`Invalid range expression '${base}' in field '${bound.name}'`);
      }
      const start = parseToken(rangeParts[0], bound.nameMap);
      const end = parseToken(rangeParts[1], bound.nameMap);
      if (start < bound.min || start > bound.max || end < bound.min || end > bound.max) {
        throw new Error(`Range values '${base}' must be between ${bound.min} and ${bound.max} in field '${bound.name}'`);
      }
      if (start > end) {
        throw new Error(`Range start '${start}' must be <= end '${end}' in field '${bound.name}'`);
      }
    } else {
      const val = parseToken(base, bound.nameMap);
      if (val < bound.min || val > bound.max) {
        throw new Error(`Value '${val}' out of range [${bound.min}, ${bound.max}] in field '${bound.name}'`);
      }
    }
  }
}

export function cronValidator(): ValidatorFn {
  return (control: AbstractControl): ValidationErrors | null => {
    const value = control.value;
    if (value === null || value === undefined || value === '') {
      return null;
    }

    if (typeof value !== 'string') {
      return { invalidCron: { message: 'Cron expression must be a string' } };
    }

    const trimmed = value.trim();
    if (trimmed === '') {
      return null;
    }

    const fields = trimmed.split(/\s+/);
    if (fields.length !== 5) {
      return {
        invalidCron: {
          message: `Expected exactly 5 fields (<minute> <hour> <day of month> <month> <day of week>), got ${fields.length}`,
        },
      };
    }

    try {
      for (let i = 0; i < FIELD_BOUNDS.length; i++) {
        validateField(fields[i], FIELD_BOUNDS[i]);
      }
      return null;
    } catch (err: unknown) {
      const errorMsg = err instanceof Error ? err.message : 'Invalid cron syntax';
      return {
        invalidCron: {
          message: errorMsg,
        },
      };
    }
  };
}

=== FILE: D:\datacatalog\frontend\src\app\features\connections\connection-diagnostic-dialog.component.ts ===
import {
  ChangeDetectionStrategy,
  Component,
  OnChanges,
  SimpleChanges,
  inject,
  input,
  model,
  output,
  signal,
} from "@angular/core";

import { DatabaseConnection } from "./models/connection.models";
import {
  CircuitState,
  ConnectionDiagnosticTestResponse,
  SyncJobService,
} from "../../core/services/sync-job.service";

@Component({
  selector: "app-connection-diagnostic-dialog",
  standalone: true,
  imports: [],
  templateUrl: "./connection-diagnostic-dialog.component.html",
  styleUrls: ["./connection-diagnostic-dialog.component.css"],
  changeDetection: ChangeDetectionStrategy.OnPush,
})
export class ConnectionDiagnosticDialogComponent implements OnChanges {
  private readonly syncJobService = inject(SyncJobService);

  readonly connection = input<DatabaseConnection | null>(null);
  readonly visible = model<boolean>(false);
  readonly circuitBreakerReset = output<void>();

  readonly isLoading = signal<boolean>(false);
  readonly isResetting = signal<boolean>(false);
  readonly testResult = signal<ConnectionDiagnosticTestResponse | null>(null);
  readonly errorMessage = signal<string | null>(null);
  readonly circuitState = signal<CircuitState>("CLOSED");
  readonly consecutiveFailures = signal<number>(0);
  readonly cooldownUntil = signal<string | null>(null);

  ngOnChanges(changes: SimpleChanges): void {
    const connection = this.connection();
    if (connection) {
      if (connection.sync_schedule) {
        this.circuitState.set(
          (connection.sync_schedule.circuit_state as CircuitState) ?? "CLOSED",
        );
        this.consecutiveFailures.set(
          connection.sync_schedule.consecutive_failures ?? 0,
        );
        this.cooldownUntil.set(connection.sync_schedule.cooldown_until ?? null);
      } else {
        this.circuitState.set("CLOSED");
        this.consecutiveFailures.set(0);
        this.cooldownUntil.set(null);
      }
    }
    if (
      (changes["visible"] || changes["connection"]) &&
      this.visible() &&
      connection
    ) {
      this.runDiagnostic();
    }
  }

  runDiagnostic(): void {
    const connection = this.connection();
    if (!connection) return;

    this.isLoading.set(true);
    this.errorMessage.set(null);

    this.syncJobService.testConnection(connection.id).subscribe({
      next: (res) => {
        this.testResult.set(res);
        this.isLoading.set(false);
      },
      error: (err: unknown) => {
        const msg =
          err instanceof Error
            ? err.message
            : "ط®ط·ط§ ط¯ط± ط¨ط±ظ‚ط±ط§ط±غŒ ط§ط±طھط¨ط§ط· ط¨ط§ ظ¾ط§غŒع¯ط§ظ‡ ط¯ط§ط¯ظ‡";
        this.errorMessage.set(msg);
        this.isLoading.set(false);
      },
    });
  }

  resetCircuitBreakerAction(): void {
    const connection = this.connection();
    if (!connection) return;

    this.isResetting.set(true);
    this.syncJobService.resetCircuitBreaker(connection.id).subscribe({
      next: (res) => {
        this.circuitState.set(res.circuit_state);
        this.consecutiveFailures.set(res.consecutive_failures);
        this.cooldownUntil.set(res.cooldown_until || null);
        this.isResetting.set(false);
        this.circuitBreakerReset.emit();
      },
      error: (err: unknown) => {
        const msg =
          err instanceof Error ? err.message : "ط®ط·ط§ ط¯ط± ط¨ط§ط²ظ†ط´ط§ظ†غŒ ظ…ط¯ط§ط±ط´ع©ظ†";
        this.errorMessage.set(msg);
        this.isResetting.set(false);
      },
    });
  }

  close(): void {
    this.visible.set(false);
  }
}

export function jsonObjectValidator(): ValidatorFn {
  return (control: AbstractControl): ValidationErrors | null => {
    const val = control.value;
    if (!val || (typeof val === "string" && !val.trim())) {
      return null;
    }
    try {
      const parsed = JSON.parse(val);
      if (
        typeof parsed !== "object" ||
        parsed === null ||
        Array.isArray(parsed)
      ) {
        return {
          invalidJson:
            'ظˆط±ظˆط¯غŒ ط¨ط§غŒط¯ غŒع© ط´غŒط، ظ…ط¹طھط¨ط± JSON ط¨ط§ط´ط¯ (ظ…ط§ظ†ظ†ط¯: {"key": "value"})',
        };
      }
      return null;
    } catch {
      return { invalidJson: "ط®ط·ط§ ط¯ط± ط³ط§ط®طھط§ط± JSON: ظپط±ظ…طھ ظˆط§ط±ط¯ ط´ط¯ظ‡ ظ†ط§ظ…ط¹طھط¨ط± ط§ط³طھ" };
    }
  };
}

export class ConnectionDialogComponent implements OnInit {
  private readonly fb = inject(FormBuilder);
  private readonly connectionService = inject(ConnectionService);

  readonly connectionToEdit = input<DatabaseConnection | null>(null);

  readonly save = output<ConnectionCreateRequest>();

  // Database Combobox & Discovery Signals

  );

  // Test Connection Signals

  readonly supportedEngines: DatabaseEngine[] = [

  readonly isSubmitting = signal<boolean>(false);
  readonly errorMessage = signal<string | null>(null);
  readonly isCustomParamsOpen = signal<boolean>(false);
  readonly selectedEngine = signal<DatabaseEngine>("POSTGRESQL");

  // Category Tree Signals
  readonly rawCategories = signal<CategoryTreeNode[]>([]);
  readonly isLoadingCategories = signal<boolean>(false);
  readonly categorySearchTerm = signal<string>("");
  readonly expandedNodeIds = signal<Set<string>>(new Set<string>());
  readonly selectedCategoryName = signal<string | null>(null);

  readonly form = this.fb.group({
    name: this.fb.control<string>("", {
      nonNullable: true,
      validators: [
        Validators.required,
        Validators.minLength(1),
        Validators.maxLength(200),
      ],
    }),
    category_id: this.fb.control<string | null>(null),
    engine_type: this.fb.control<DatabaseEngine>("POSTGRESQL", {
      nonNullable: true,
      validators: [Validators.required],
    }),
    host: this.fb.control<string>("localhost", {
      nonNullable: true,
      validators: [
        Validators.required,
        Validators.minLength(1),
        Validators.maxLength(255),
      ],
    }),
    port: this.fb.control<number>(5432, {
      nonNullable: true,
      validators: [
        Validators.required,
        Validators.min(1),
        Validators.max(65535),
      ],
    }),
    database_name: this.fb.control<string>("", {
      nonNullable: true,
      validators: [
        Validators.required,
        Validators.minLength(1),
        Validators.maxLength(255),
      ],
    }),
    default_schema: this.fb.control<string | null>("public"),
    owner: this.fb.control<string>("admin", {
      nonNullable: true,
      validators: [Validators.required, Validators.maxLength(255)],
    }),
    username: this.fb.control<string>("", {
      nonNullable: true,
      validators: [Validators.required],
    }),
    password: this.fb.control<string>("", {
      nonNullable: true,
      validators: [Validators.required],
    }),
    cron_expression: this.fb.control<string | null>("", {
      validators: [cronValidator()],
    }),
    custom_params_json: this.fb.control<string>("{}", {
      nonNullable: true,
      validators: [jsonObjectValidator()],
    }),
  });

  // Flattened and filtered category list for display in the tree picker
  readonly flattenedCategoryList = computed<FlattenedCategoryNode[]>(() => {
    const raw = this.rawCategories();
    const expanded = this.expandedNodeIds();
    const term = this.categorySearchTerm().trim().toLowerCase();

    const result: FlattenedCategoryNode[] = [];

    const traverse = (
      nodes: CategoryTreeNode[],
      level: number,
      parentPath: string,
    ) => {
      for (const node of nodes) {
        const isLeaf = !node.children || node.children.length === 0;
        const currentPath = parentPath
          ? `${parentPath} > ${node.name}`
          : node.name;

        if (term) {
          const matchesSelf = node.name.toLowerCase().includes(term);
          const hasMatchingChild = this.hasMatchingDescendant(node, term);
          if (matchesSelf || hasMatchingChild) {
            result.push({ node, level, isLeaf, parentPath: currentPath });
            if (node.children && node.children.length > 0) {
              traverse(node.children, level + 1, currentPath);
            }
          }
        } else {
          result.push({ node, level, isLeaf, parentPath: currentPath });
          if (!isLeaf && expanded.has(node.id) && node.children) {
            traverse(node.children, level + 1, currentPath);
          }
        }
      }
    };

    traverse(raw, 0, "");
    return result;
  });

  ngOnInit(): void {
    this.loadCategoryTree();

    // Auto-update port when engine_type changes
    this.form.controls.engine_type.valueChanges
      .pipe(takeUntilDestroyed(this.destroyRef))
      .subscribe((engine) => {
        if (engine) {
          this.selectedEngine.set(engine);
          if (this.defaultPorts[engine]) {
            this.form.controls.port.setValue(this.defaultPorts[engine]);
          }
        }
      });

    // Auto-discover databases when host, port, username, password are all filled (debounced 600ms)
    merge(
      this.form.controls.engine_type.valueChanges,
      this.form.controls.host.valueChanges,
      this.form.controls.port.valueChanges,
      this.form.controls.username.valueChanges,
      this.form.controls.password.valueChanges,
    )
      .pipe(
        debounceTime(600),
        map(() => {
          const val = this.form.getRawValue();
          return `${val.engine_type}|${val.host}|${val.port}|${val.username}|${val.password}`;
        }),
        distinctUntilChanged(),
        takeUntilDestroyed(this.destroyRef),
      )
      .subscribe(() => {
        if (this.canDiscoverDatabases() && !this.isDiscoveringDatabases()) {
          this.discoverDatabases();
        }
      });

    const connectionToEdit = this.connectionToEdit();
    const preselectedCategoryId = this.preselectedCategoryId();
    if (connectionToEdit) {
      const conn = connectionToEdit;
      const customParamsVal =
        conn.custom_params && Object.keys(conn.custom_params).length > 0
          ? JSON.stringify(conn.custom_params, null, 2)
          : "{}";
      this.form.patchValue({
        name: conn.name,
        category_id: conn.category_id || null,
        engine_type: conn.engine_type,
        host: conn.host,
        port: conn.port,
        database_name: conn.database_name,
        default_schema: conn.default_schema || "",
        owner: conn.owner,
        username: conn.masked_credentials?.["username"] || "admin",
        password: "",
        cron_expression: conn.sync_schedule?.cron_expression || "",
        custom_params_json: customParamsVal,
      });
      if (conn.category_name) {
        this.selectedCategoryName.set(conn.category_name);
      }
      if (conn.custom_params && Object.keys(conn.custom_params).length > 0) {
        this.isCustomParamsOpen.set(true);
      }
      // In edit mode, password is optional
      this.form.controls.password.clearValidators();
      this.form.controls.password.updateValueAndValidity();
    } else if (preselectedCategoryId) {
      this.form.controls.category_id.setValue(preselectedCategoryId);
    }
  }

  loadCategoryTree(): void {
    this.isLoadingCategories.set(true);
    this.connectionService.getCategoryTree().subscribe({
      next: (tree) => {
        this.rawCategories.set(tree);
        this.isLoadingCategories.set(false);

        // Auto-expand parents if category is already selected
        const currentCatId = this.form.controls.category_id.value;
        if (currentCatId) {
          const found = this.findNodeAndAncestors(tree, currentCatId);
          if (found) {
            this.selectedCategoryName.set(found.target.name);
            this.expandedNodeIds.update((prev) => {
              const next = new Set(prev);
              found.ancestors.forEach((aId) => next.add(aId));
              return next;
            });
          }
        } else {
          // Expand first level by default for convenience
          const initialSet = new Set<string>();
          tree.forEach((root) => initialSet.add(root.id));
          this.expandedNodeIds.set(initialSet);
        }
      },
      error: () => {
        this.isLoadingCategories.set(false);
      },
    });
  }

  private hasMatchingDescendant(node: CategoryTreeNode, term: string): boolean {
    if (!node.children || node.children.length === 0) return false;
    for (const child of node.children) {
      if (
        child.name.toLowerCase().includes(term) ||
        this.hasMatchingDescendant(child, term)
      ) {
        return true;
      }
    }
    return false;
  }

  private findNodeAndAncestors(
    nodes: CategoryTreeNode[],
    targetId: string,
    currentPath: string[] = [],
  ): { target: CategoryTreeNode; ancestors: string[] } | null {
    for (const node of nodes) {
      if (node.id === targetId) {
        return { target: node, ancestors: currentPath };
      }
      if (node.children && node.children.length > 0) {
        const found = this.findNodeAndAncestors(node.children, targetId, [
          ...currentPath,
          node.id,
        ]);
        if (found) return found;
      }
    }
    return null;
  }

  onSearchInput(event: Event): void {
    const input = event.target as HTMLInputElement;
    this.categorySearchTerm.set(input.value);
  }

  toggleExpanded(nodeId: string): void {
    this.expandedNodeIds.update((prev) => {
      const next = new Set(prev);
      if (next.has(nodeId)) {
        next.delete(nodeId);
      } else {
        next.add(nodeId);
      }
      return next;
    });
  }

  onNodeClick(item: FlattenedCategoryNode): void {
    if (!item.isLeaf) {
      // Parent node: toggle expand/collapse, cannot select
      this.toggleExpanded(item.node.id);
      return;
    }
    // Leaf node: select this leaf!
    this.form.controls.category_id.setValue(item.node.id);
    this.selectedCategoryName.set(item.node.name);
  }

  clearCategorySelection(): void {
    this.form.controls.category_id.setValue(null);
    this.selectedCategoryName.set(null);
  }

  onEngineChange(): void {
    const engine = this.form.controls.engine_type.value;
    if (engine) {
      this.selectedEngine.set(engine);
      if (this.defaultPorts[engine]) {
        this.form.controls.port.setValue(this.defaultPorts[engine]);
      }
    }
  }

  applyQuickParam(paramJson: string): void {
    this.form.controls.custom_params_json.setValue(paramJson);
    this.form.controls.custom_params_json.markAsDirty();
  }

  onBackdropClick(event: MouseEvent): void {
    if ((event.target as HTMLElement).classList.contains("modal-backdrop")) {
      this.cancel.emit();
    }
  }

  toPersianNumber(num: number): string {
    const farsiDigits = ["غ°", "غ±", "غ²", "غ³", "غ´", "غµ", "غ¶", "غ·", "غ¸", "غ¹"];
    return num.toString().replace(/\d/g, (d) => farsiDigits[parseInt(d, 10)]);
  }

  canDiscoverDatabases(): boolean {
    const val = this.form.getRawValue();
    const hasHost = Boolean(val.host && val.host.trim().length > 0);
    const validPort =
      typeof val.port === "number" && val.port > 0 && val.port <= 65535;
    const hasUsername = Boolean(val.username && val.username.trim().length > 0);
    const hasPassword = Boolean(
      this.connectionToEdit() ||
      (val.password && val.password.trim().length > 0),
    );
    return hasHost && validPort && hasUsername && hasPassword;
  }

  discoverDatabases(): void {
    if (this.isDiscoveringDatabases()) return;
    const val = this.form.getRawValue();
    if (!val.host || !val.port || !val.username) return;

    let customParams: Record<string, unknown> = {};
    if (val.custom_params_json?.trim()) {
      try {
        const parsed = JSON.parse(val.custom_params_json.trim());
        if (
          typeof parsed === "object" &&
          parsed !== null &&
          !Array.isArray(parsed)
        ) {
          customParams = parsed;
        }
      } catch {}
    }

    this.isDiscoveringDatabases.set(true);
    this.discoveryStatus.set("loading");
    this.discoveryMessage.set(null);

    this.connectionService
      .discoverDatabases({
        engine_type: val.engine_type,
        host: val.host,
        port: val.port,
        credentials: {
          username: val.username,
          password: val.password || undefined,
        },
        custom_params: customParams,
      })
      .subscribe({
        next: (res) => {
          this.isDiscoveringDatabases.set(false);
          if (res.success && res.databases) {
            this.discoveredDatabases.set(res.databases);
            this.discoveryStatus.set("success");
            const countStr = this.toPersianNumber(res.databases.length);
            this.discoveryMessage.set(`âœ“ ${countStr} ظ¾ط§غŒع¯ط§ظ‡â€Œط¯ط§ط¯ظ‡ ط´ظ†ط§ط³ط§غŒغŒ ط´ط¯`);
            if (res.databases.length > 0) {
              this.isDropdownOpen.set(true);
              if (!this.form.controls.database_name.value) {
                this.form.controls.database_name.setValue(res.databases[0]);
              }
            }
          } else {
            this.discoveryStatus.set("error");
            this.discoveryMessage.set(
              this.translateErrorMessage(res.message, "discovery"),
            );
          }
        },
        error: (err) => {
          this.isDiscoveringDatabases.set(false);
          this.discoveryStatus.set("error");
          const rawMsg =
            err.error?.detail || err.error?.message || err.message || "";
          this.discoveryMessage.set(
            this.translateErrorMessage(rawMsg, "discovery"),
          );
        },
      });
  }

  selectDiscoveredDatabase(db: string): void {
    this.form.controls.database_name.setValue(db);
    this.form.controls.database_name.markAsDirty();
    this.isDropdownOpen.set(false);
  }

  onComboboxFocus(): void {
    if (this.discoveredDatabases().length > 0) {
      this.isDropdownOpen.set(true);
    }
  }

  toggleDropdown(): void {
    if (this.discoveredDatabases().length > 0) {
      this.isDropdownOpen.update((v) => !v);
    }
  }

  @HostListener("document:click", ["$event"])

    if (!target.closest(".combobox-container")) {
      this.isDropdownOpen.set(false);
    }
  }

  canTestConnection(): boolean {
    const val = this.form.getRawValue();
    const hasCreds = Boolean(
      val.username && (val.password || this.connectionToEdit()),
    );
    return Boolean(val.host && val.port && val.database_name && hasCreds);
  }

  testUnsavedConnection(): void {
    if (this.isTestingConnection()) return;
    const val = this.form.getRawValue();
    if (!val.host || !val.port || !val.database_name || !val.username) {
      this.form.controls.database_name.markAsTouched();
      return;
    }

    let customParams: Record<string, unknown> = {};
    if (val.custom_params_json?.trim()) {
      try {
        const parsed = JSON.parse(val.custom_params_json.trim());
        if (
          typeof parsed === "object" &&
          parsed !== null &&
          !Array.isArray(parsed)
        ) {
          customParams = parsed;
        }
      } catch {}
    }

    this.isTestingConnection.set(true);
    this.testResult.set(null);

    this.connectionService
      .testUnsavedConnection({
        engine_type: val.engine_type,
        host: val.host,
        port: val.port,
        database_name: val.database_name,
        credentials: {
          username: val.username,
          password: val.password || undefined,
        },
        custom_params: customParams,
      })
      .subscribe({
        next: (res) => {
          this.isTestingConnection.set(false);
          const translatedMsg = this.translateTestMessage(
            res.message,
            res.success,
          );
          this.testResult.set({
            ...res,
            message: translatedMsg,
          });
        },
        error: (err) => {
          this.isTestingConnection.set(false);
          const rawMsg =
            err.error?.detail || err.error?.message || err.message || "";
          const msg = this.translateErrorMessage(rawMsg, "test");
          this.testResult.set({
            success: false,
            latency_ms: 0,
            dialect: val.engine_type,
            message: msg,
            tested_at: new Date().toISOString(),
          });
        },
      });
  }

  onSubmit(): void {
    if (this.form.invalid) {
      this.form.markAllAsTouched();
      if (this.form.controls.custom_params_json.invalid) {
        this.isCustomParamsOpen.set(true);
      }
      return;
    }

    const val = this.form.getRawValue();
    let customParams: Record<string, unknown> = {};
    const rawCustom = val.custom_params_json?.trim();
    if (rawCustom) {
      try {
        const parsed = JSON.parse(rawCustom);
        if (
          typeof parsed === "object" &&
          parsed !== null &&
          !Array.isArray(parsed)
        ) {
          customParams = parsed;
        } else {
          this.form.controls.custom_params_json.setErrors({
            invalidJson: "ظˆط±ظˆط¯غŒ ط¨ط§غŒط¯ غŒع© ط´غŒط، ظ…ط¹طھط¨ط± JSON ط¨ط§ط´ط¯",
          });
          this.isCustomParamsOpen.set(true);
          return;
        }
      } catch {
        this.form.controls.custom_params_json.setErrors({
          invalidJson: "ط®ط·ط§ ط¯ط± ط³ط§ط®طھط§ط± JSON: ظپط±ظ…طھ ظˆط§ط±ط¯ ط´ط¯ظ‡ ظ†ط§ظ…ط¹طھط¨ط± ط§ط³طھ",
        });
        this.isCustomParamsOpen.set(true);
        return;
      }
    }

    const creds: Record<string, unknown> = {
      username: val.username,
    };
    if (val.password && val.password.trim()) {
      creds["password"] = val.password;
    }

    const request: ConnectionCreateRequest = {
      name: val.name,
      engine_type: val.engine_type,
      host: val.host,
      port: val.port,
      database_name: val.database_name,
      default_schema: val.default_schema?.trim() || undefined,
      owner: val.owner,
      category_id: val.category_id || undefined,
      credentials: creds,
      custom_params: customParams,
      cron_expression: val.cron_expression?.trim() || undefined,
    };

    this.save.emit(request);
  }

  imports: [
    CommonModule,
    FormsModule,
    RouterModule,
    ConnectionDialogComponent,
    ConnectionDiagnosticDialogComponent,
    HasPermissionDirective,
  ],
  templateUrl: './connection-list.component.html',
  styleUrls: ['./connection-list.component.css'],
  changeDetection: ChangeDetectionStrategy.OnPush,
})
export class ConnectionListComponent implements OnInit {
  private readonly connectionService = inject(ConnectionService);
  private readonly syncJobService = inject(SyncJobService);

  readonly connections = signal<DatabaseConnection[]>([]);
  readonly categoryTree = signal<CategoryTreeNode[]>([]);
  readonly isLoading = signal<boolean>(false);
  readonly isLoadingTree = signal<boolean>(false);
  readonly showDialog = signal<boolean>(false);
  readonly showDiagnosticDialog = signal<boolean>(false);
  readonly diagnosticConnection = signal<DatabaseConnection | null>(null);
  readonly syncingConnectionId = signal<string | null>(null);
  readonly syncSuccessMessage = signal<string | null>(null);
  readonly connectionToEdit = signal<DatabaseConnection | null>(null);
  readonly preselectedCategoryId = signal<string | null>(null);
  readonly testingConnectionId = signal<string | null>(null);
  readonly testResults = signal<Record<string, ConnectionTestResult>>({});
  readonly errorMessage = signal<string | null>(null);

  // Delete confirmation
  readonly connectionToDelete = signal<DatabaseConnection | null>(null);

  // Category Tree Navigation Signals
  readonly selectedCategory = signal<CategoryTreeNode | null>(null);
  readonly expandedCategoryIds = signal<Set<string>>(new Set<string>());
  readonly categorySearch = signal<string>('');

  // Table state: filters, sorting, pagination, expanded rows
  readonly searchTerm = signal<string>('');
  readonly engineFilter = signal<string>('ALL');
  readonly statusFilter = signal<'ALL' | 'ACTIVE' | 'INACTIVE'>('ALL');
  readonly sortKey = signal<ConnectionSortKey | null>(null);
  readonly sortDirection = signal<SortDirection>('asc');
  readonly currentPage = signal<number>(1);
  readonly pageSize = signal<number>(10);
  readonly expandedRowIds = signal<Set<string>>(new Set<string>());
  readonly availablePageSizes: number[] = [10, 20, 50];

  // Map of category_id -> count of databases assigned
  readonly categoryDatabaseCounts = computed<Record<string, number>>(() => {
    const counts: Record<string, number> = {};
    for (const c of this.connections()) {
      if (c.category_id) {
        counts[c.category_id] = (counts[c.category_id] || 0) + 1;
      }
    }
    return counts;
  });

  // Flattened hierarchical tree items with indent levels and leaf detection
  readonly flattenedCategoryTree = computed<CategoryTreeItem[]>(() => {
    const raw = this.categoryTree();
    const expanded = this.expandedCategoryIds();
    const counts = this.categoryDatabaseCounts();
    const term = this.categorySearch().trim().toLowerCase();

    const items: CategoryTreeItem[] = [];

    const traverse = (nodes: CategoryTreeNode[], level: number) => {
      for (const node of nodes) {
        const isLeaf = !node.children || node.children.length === 0;
        const dbCount = counts[node.id] || 0;

        if (term) {
          const matchesSelf = node.name.toLowerCase().includes(term);
          const hasMatchingDescendant = this.hasMatchingDescendant(node, term);
          if (matchesSelf || hasMatchingDescendant) {
            items.push({ node, level, isLeaf, dbCount });
            if (node.children && node.children.length > 0) {
              traverse(node.children, level + 1);
            }
          }
        } else {
          items.push({ node, level, isLeaf, dbCount });
          if (!isLeaf && expanded.has(node.id) && node.children) {
            traverse(node.children, level + 1);
          }
        }
      }
    };

    traverse(raw, 0);
    return items;
  });

  // Helper to collect a category ID and all its descendant category IDs
  private getDescendantCategoryIds(node: CategoryTreeNode): Set<string> {
    const ids = new Set<string>();
    const collect = (curr: CategoryTreeNode) => {
      ids.add(curr.id);
      if (curr.children && curr.children.length > 0) {
        for (const child of curr.children) {
          collect(child);
        }
      }
    };
    collect(node);
    return ids;
  }

  // Connections of the selected category (parent branch with all descendants, or leaf) or all
  readonly filteredConnections = computed<DatabaseConnection[]>(() => {
    const selected = this.selectedCategory();
    const all = this.connections();
    if (!selected) {
      return all;
    }
    const allowedCategoryIds = this.getDescendantCategoryIds(selected);
    return all.filter((c) => !!c.category_id && allowedCategoryIds.has(c.category_id));
  });

  // Engines present in the current scope (for the engine filter dropdown)
  readonly availableEngines = computed<string[]>(() => {
    const set = new Set<string>();
    for (const c of this.filteredConnections()) {
      set.add(c.engine_type);
    }
    return Array.from(set).sort();
  });

  // Search + engine + status filters, then sorting
  readonly tableConnections = computed<DatabaseConnection[]>(() => {
    const term = this.searchTerm().trim().toLowerCase();
    const engine = this.engineFilter();
    const status = this.statusFilter();
    const key = this.sortKey();
    const dir = this.sortDirection();

    let list = this.filteredConnections().filter((c) => {
      if (engine !== 'ALL' && c.engine_type !== engine) return false;
      if (status === 'ACTIVE' && !c.is_active) return false;
      if (status === 'INACTIVE' && c.is_active) return false;
      if (term) {
        const haystack = [c.name, c.host, c.database_name, c.owner, c.category_name, c.default_schema]
          .filter(Boolean)
          .join(' ')
          .toLowerCase();
        if (!haystack.includes(term)) return false;
      }
      return true;
    });

    if (key) {
      const factor = dir === 'asc' ? 1 : -1;
      list = [...list].sort((a, b) => {
        const av = String(a[key] ?? '');
        const bv = String(b[key] ?? '');
        return av.localeCompare(bv, 'fa') * factor;
      });
    }
    return list;
  });

  readonly totalPages = computed<number>(() =>
    Math.max(1, Math.ceil(this.tableConnections().length / this.pageSize()))
  );

  // Current page clamped to a valid range (e.g. after deleting the last row of a page)
  readonly safePage = computed<number>(() => Math.min(this.currentPage(), this.totalPages()));

  readonly paginatedConnections = computed<DatabaseConnection[]>(() => {
    const start = (this.safePage() - 1) * this.pageSize();
    return this.tableConnections().slice(start, start + this.pageSize());
  });

  readonly pageDisplayStart = computed<number>(() =>
    this.tableConnections().length === 0 ? 0 : (this.safePage() - 1) * this.pageSize() + 1
  );

  readonly pageDisplayEnd = computed<number>(() =>
    Math.min(this.safePage() * this.pageSize(), this.tableConnections().length)
  );

  ngOnInit(): void {
    this.loadConnections();
    this.loadCategoryTree();
  }

  loadConnections(): void {
    this.isLoading.set(true);
    this.errorMessage.set(null);

    this.connectionService.getConnections().subscribe({
      next: (items) => {
        this.connections.set(items);
        this.isLoading.set(false);
      },
      error: (err: unknown) => {
        const msg = err instanceof Error ? err.message : 'ط®ط·ط§ ط¯ط± ط¨ط§ط±ع¯ط°ط§ط±غŒ ظ„غŒط³طھ ط§طھطµط§ظ„ط§طھ ظ¾ط§غŒع¯ط§ظ‡ ط¯ط§ط¯ظ‡';
        this.errorMessage.set(msg);
        this.isLoading.set(false);
      },
    });
  }

  loadCategoryTree(): void {
    this.isLoadingTree.set(true);
    this.connectionService.getCategoryTree().subscribe({
      next: (tree) => {
        this.categoryTree.set(tree);
        this.isLoadingTree.set(false);

        // Expand root categories by default
        const initialExpanded = new Set<string>();
        tree.forEach((t) => initialExpanded.add(t.id));
        this.expandedCategoryIds.set(initialExpanded);
      },
      error: () => {
        this.isLoadingTree.set(false);
      },
    });
  }

  private hasMatchingDescendant(node: CategoryTreeNode, term: string): boolean {
    if (!node.children || node.children.length === 0) return false;
    for (const child of node.children) {
      if (child.name.toLowerCase().includes(term) || this.hasMatchingDescendant(child, term)) {
        return true;
      }
    }
    return false;
  }

  // â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€ Category tree â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
  onCategorySearchInput(event: Event): void {
    const input = event.target as HTMLInputElement;
    this.categorySearch.set(input.value);
  }

  toggleExpandCategory(categoryId: string): void {
    this.expandedCategoryIds.update((prev) => {
      const next = new Set(prev);
      if (next.has(categoryId)) {
        next.delete(categoryId);
      } else {
        next.add(categoryId);
      }
      return next;
    });
  }

  selectCategory(node: CategoryTreeNode | null): void {
    if (!node) {
      this.selectedCategory.set(null);
      this.resetTableView();
      return;
    }
    this.selectedCategory.set(node);
    this.resetTableView();
  }

  // Reset engine filter (it may not exist in the new scope), page and open rows
  private resetTableView(): void {
    this.engineFilter.set('ALL');
    this.currentPage.set(1);
    this.expandedRowIds.set(new Set<string>());
  }

  // â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€ Table: filters, sort, pagination, rows â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
  onFilterChanged(): void {
    this.currentPage.set(1);
  }

  toggleSort(key: ConnectionSortKey): void {
    if (this.sortKey() === key) {
      if (this.sortDirection() === 'asc') {
        this.sortDirection.set('desc');
      } else {
        // Third click clears the sort
        this.sortKey.set(null);
        this.sortDirection.set('asc');
      }
    } else {
      this.sortKey.set(key);
      this.sortDirection.set('asc');
    }
  }

  sortIcon(key: ConnectionSortKey): string {
    if (this.sortKey() !== key) return 'pi-sort-alt';
    return this.sortDirection() === 'asc' ? 'pi-sort-amount-up-alt' : 'pi-sort-amount-down';
  }

  goToPage(page: number): void {
    const target = Math.min(Math.max(1, page), this.totalPages());
    this.currentPage.set(target);
  }

  changePageSize(size: number | string): void {
    this.pageSize.set(Number(size));
    this.currentPage.set(1);
  }

  toggleRow(id: string): void {
    this.expandedRowIds.update((prev) => {
      const next = new Set(prev);
      if (next.has(id)) {
        next.delete(id);
      } else {
        next.add(id);
      }
      return next;
    });
  }

  // â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€ Dialog â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
  openCreateDialog(categoryId?: string): void {
    this.connectionToEdit.set(null);
    this.preselectedCategoryId.set(categoryId || this.selectedCategory()?.id || null);
    this.showDialog.set(true);
  }

  openEditDialog(conn: DatabaseConnection): void {
    this.connectionToEdit.set(conn);
    this.preselectedCategoryId.set(null);
    this.showDialog.set(true);
  }

  closeDialog(): void {
    this.showDialog.set(false);
    this.connectionToEdit.set(null);
    this.preselectedCategoryId.set(null);
  }

  onSaveConnection(request: ConnectionCreateRequest): void {
    const editConn = this.connectionToEdit();
    if (editConn) {
      this.connectionService.updateConnection(editConn.id, request).subscribe({
        next: (updatedConn) => {
          this.connections.update((list) =>
            list.map((c) => (c.id === updatedConn.id ? updatedConn : c))
          );
          this.closeDialog();
          this.loadCategoryTree();
        },
        error: (err: unknown) => {
          const msg = err instanceof Error ? err.message : 'ط®ط·ط§ ط¯ط± ط¨ط±ظˆط²ط±ط³ط§ظ†غŒ ط§طھطµط§ظ„ ط¯غŒطھط§ط¨غŒط³';
          this.errorMessage.set(msg);
        },
      });
    } else {
      this.connectionService.createConnection(request).subscribe({
        next: (newConn) => {
          this.connections.update((list) => [newConn, ...list]);
          this.closeDialog();
          this.loadCategoryTree();
        },
        error: (err: unknown) => {
          const msg = err instanceof Error ? err.message : 'ط®ط·ط§ ط¯ط± ط«ط¨طھ ط§طھطµط§ظ„ ط¬ط¯غŒط¯ ظ¾ط§غŒع¯ط§ظ‡ ط¯ط§ط¯ظ‡';
          this.errorMessage.set(msg);
        },
      });
    }
  }

  // â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€ Delete (in-app confirmation instead of window.confirm) â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
  requestDelete(conn: DatabaseConnection): void {
    this.connectionToDelete.set(conn);
  }

  cancelDelete(): void {
    this.connectionToDelete.set(null);
  }

  confirmDelete(): void {
    const target = this.connectionToDelete();
    if (!target) return;

    this.connectionService.deleteConnection(target.id).subscribe({
      next: () => {
        this.connections.update((list) => list.filter((c) => c.id !== target.id));
        this.connectionToDelete.set(null);
        this.loadCategoryTree();
      },
      error: (err: unknown) => {
        const msg = err instanceof Error ? err.message : 'ط®ط·ط§ ط¯ط± ط­ط°ظپ ط§طھطµط§ظ„ ط¯غŒطھط§ط¨غŒط³';
        this.errorMessage.set(msg);
        this.connectionToDelete.set(null);
      },
    });
  }

  // â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€ Diagnostic Dialog & Manual Sync â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
  openDiagnosticDialog(conn: DatabaseConnection): void {
    this.diagnosticConnection.set(conn);
    this.showDiagnosticDialog.set(true);
  }

  onManualSync(conn: DatabaseConnection): void {
    this.syncingConnectionId.set(conn.id);
    this.syncSuccessMessage.set(null);

    this.syncJobService.triggerSync(conn.id).subscribe({
      next: (job) => {
        this.syncingConnectionId.set(null);
        this.syncSuccessMessage.set('ظ‡ظ…ع¯ط§ظ…ط³ط§ط²غŒ ظ…طھط§ط¯ط§ط¯ظ‡ ط¯ط± طµظپ ط§ط¬ط±ط§ ظ‚ط±ط§ط± ع¯ط±ظپطھ');
        setTimeout(() => this.syncSuccessMessage.set(null), 5000);
      },
      error: (err: unknown) => {
        this.syncingConnectionId.set(null);
        const msg = err instanceof Error ? err.message : 'ط®ط·ط§ ط¯ط± ط«ط¨طھ ط¯ط±ط®ظˆط§ط³طھ ظ‡ظ…ع¯ط§ظ…â€Œط³ط§ط²غŒ ط¯ط³طھغŒ';
        this.errorMessage.set(msg);
        setTimeout(() => this.errorMessage.set(null), 5000);
      },
    });
  }

  // â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€ Test connection â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
  onTestConnection(id: string): void {
    this.testingConnectionId.set(id);

    this.connectionService.testConnection(id).subscribe({
      next: (result) => {
        this.testResults.update((prev) => ({
          ...prev,
          [id]: result,
        }));
        this.testingConnectionId.set(null);
      },
      error: (err: unknown) => {
        const errorResult: ConnectionTestResult = {
          success: false,
          latency_ms: 5000.0,
          dialect: 'POSTGRESQL',
          message: err instanceof Error ? err.message : 'Connection test failed',
          tested_at: new Date().toISOString(),
        };
        this.testResults.update((prev) => ({
          ...prev,
          [id]: errorResult,
        }));
        this.testingConnectionId.set(null);
      },
    });
  }
}

import {
  ChangeDetectionStrategy,
  Component,
  OnChanges,
  SimpleChanges,
  inject,
  input,
  model,
  output,
  signal,
} from "@angular/core";

import { FormsModule } from "@angular/forms";
import {
  DescriptionDriftDetailResponse,
  DriftResolutionAction,
  DriftService,
  ResolveDescriptionDriftRequest,
} from "../../core/services/drift.service";

@Component({
  selector: "app-drift-resolution-dialog",
  standalone: true,
  imports: [FormsModule],
  templateUrl: "./drift-resolution-dialog.component.html",
  styleUrls: ["./drift-resolution-dialog.component.css"],
  changeDetection: ChangeDetectionStrategy.OnPush,
})
export class DriftResolutionDialogComponent implements OnChanges {
  private readonly driftService = inject(DriftService);

  readonly tableId = input<string | null>(null);
  readonly visible = model<boolean>(false);
  readonly resolved = output<void>();

  readonly isLoading = signal<boolean>(false);
  readonly isResolving = signal<boolean>(false);
  readonly driftData = signal<DescriptionDriftDetailResponse | null>(null);
  readonly selectedAction = signal<DriftResolutionAction>("RETAIN_APPROVED");
  readonly customDescription = signal<string>("");
  readonly errorMessage = signal<string | null>(null);

  ngOnChanges(changes: SimpleChanges): void {
    const tableId = this.tableId();
    if (changes["visible"] && this.visible() && tableId) {
      this.loadDrift(tableId);
    }
  }

  loadDrift(id: string): void {
    this.isLoading.set(true);
    this.errorMessage.set(null);

    this.driftService.getTableDrift(id).subscribe({
      next: (data) => {
        this.driftData.set(data);
        if (data.table_approved_description) {
          this.customDescription.set(data.table_approved_description);
        } else if (data.table_source_description) {
          this.customDescription.set(data.table_source_description);
        }
        this.isLoading.set(false);
      },
      error: (err: unknown) => {
        const msg =
          err instanceof Error
            ? err.message
            : "ط®ط·ط§ ط¯ط± ط¨ط§ط±ع¯ط°ط§ط±غŒ ط§ط·ظ„ط§ط¹ط§طھ ظ…ط؛ط§غŒط±طھ طھظˆط¶غŒط­ط§طھ";
        this.errorMessage.set(msg);
        this.isLoading.set(false);
      },
    });
  }

  onSubmitResolution(): void {
    const tableId = this.tableId();
    if (!tableId) return;

    this.isResolving.set(true);
    this.errorMessage.set(null);

    const action = this.selectedAction();
    const payload: ResolveDescriptionDriftRequest = {
      resolution_action: action,
      custom_description:
        action === "CUSTOM_MERGE" ? this.customDescription() : undefined,
      column_resolutions: [],
    };

    this.driftService.resolveDrift(tableId, payload).subscribe({
      next: () => {
        this.isResolving.set(false);
        this.resolved.emit();
        this.close();
      },
      error: (err: unknown) => {
        const msg =
          err instanceof Error ? err.message : "ط®ط·ط§ ط¯ط± ط«ط¨طھ ظˆ ط­ظ„ طھط¹ط§ط±ط¶ طھظˆط¶غŒط­ط§طھ";
        this.errorMessage.set(msg);
        this.isResolving.set(false);
      },
    });
  }

  close(): void {
    this.visible.set(false);
  }
}

import { Injectable, inject } from '@angular/core';
import { HttpClient, HttpParams } from '@angular/common/http';
import { Observable } from 'rxjs';
import {
  CompletenessReport,
  ClassificationReport,
  ReportRefreshResponse,
  ReportPreviewItem,
} from '../models/report.models';

@Injectable({
  providedIn: 'root',
})
export class ReportService {
  private readonly http = inject(HttpClient);
  private readonly baseUrl = '/api/v1/reports';

  /**
   * Retrieves aggregated metadata completeness metrics across all or selected databases.
   */
  getCompletenessReport(connectionIds?: string[], excludeLowRowTables: boolean = false): Observable<CompletenessReport> {
    let params = new HttpParams();
    if (connectionIds && connectionIds.length > 0) {
      connectionIds.forEach((id) => {
        params = params.append('connection_ids', id);
      });
    }
    if (excludeLowRowTables) {
      params = params.set('exclude_low_row_tables', 'true');
    }
    return this.http.get<CompletenessReport>(`${this.baseUrl}/completeness`, { params });
  }

  /**
   * Retrieves security classification and PII distribution metrics across all or selected databases.
   */
  getClassificationDistribution(connectionIds?: string[], excludeLowRowTables: boolean = false): Observable<ClassificationReport> {
    let params = new HttpParams();
    if (connectionIds && connectionIds.length > 0) {
      connectionIds.forEach((id) => {
        params = params.append('connection_ids', id);
      });
    }
    if (excludeLowRowTables) {
      params = params.set('exclude_low_row_tables', 'true');
    }
    return this.http.get<ClassificationReport>(`${this.baseUrl}/classification-distribution`, { params });
  }

  /**
   * Triggers non-blocking concurrent refresh of all reporting materialized views.
   */
  refreshMaterializedViews(): Observable<ReportRefreshResponse> {
    return this.http.post<ReportRefreshResponse>(`${this.baseUrl}/refresh`, {});
  }

  /**
   * Fetches data dictionary preview items including both source and approved descriptions.
   */
  getReportPreview(connectionIds?: string[], limit: number = 100, excludeLowRowTables: boolean = false): Observable<ReportPreviewItem[]> {
    let params = new HttpParams().set('limit', limit);
    if (connectionIds && connectionIds.length > 0) {
      connectionIds.forEach((id) => {
        params = params.append('connection_ids', id);
      });
    }
    if (excludeLowRowTables) {
      params = params.set('exclude_low_row_tables', 'true');
    }
    return this.http.get<ReportPreviewItem[]>(`${this.baseUrl}/preview`, { params });
  }

  /**
   * Exports executive reporting summary to JSON, CSV, or XLSX format.
   */
  exportReports(format: 'json' | 'csv' | 'xlsx', connectionIds?: string[], excludeLowRowTables: boolean = false): Observable<Blob> {
    let params = new HttpParams().set('format', format);
    if (connectionIds && connectionIds.length > 0) {
      connectionIds.forEach((id) => {
        params = params.append('connection_ids', id);
      });
    }
    if (excludeLowRowTables) {
      params = params.set('exclude_low_row_tables', 'true');
    }
    return this.http.get(`${this.baseUrl}/export`, {
      params,
      responseType: 'blob',
    });
  }
}

      PUBLIC: "#10b981",
      INTERNAL: "#3b82f6",
      CONFIDENTIAL: "#f59e0b",
      RESTRICTED: "#ef4444",
    };

    const pieData = items.map((item) => ({
      name: item.classification_level,
      value: item.column_count,
      itemStyle: {
        color: colorMap[item.classification_level.toUpperCase()] ?? "#8b5cf6",
      },
    }));

    return {
      legend: {
        bottom: 4,
        left: "center",
        textStyle: {
          fontFamily: "inherit",
          fontSize: 12,
        },
      },
      tooltip: {
        trigger: "item",
        formatter: "{b}: {c} ط³طھظˆظ† ({d}%)",
      },
      series: [
        {
          name: "Classification",
          type: "pie",
          radius: ["48%", "72%"],
          center: ["50%", "46%"],
          avoidLabelOverlap: true,
          label: {
            show: false,
          },
          emphasis: {
            label: {
              show: true,
              fontSize: 13,
              fontWeight: "bold",
            },
          },
          data: pieData,
        },
      ],
    };
  });
}

@Component({
